row.name: Ex Vitro
row.detailed_description: FEATURES: A retro love letter to the Metroid series, with a few quality of life adjustments, such as teleporters, rechargeable ammo, item collection tracking by area, and more Discover journal entries hidden throughout the facility, explaining the grim fate of humanity and its war against the galaxy Uncover the nature of the main character and their role in the conflict Collect and upgrade powerful weapons Traverse 8 different biomes, each with their own inhabitants, secrets, and traps Fight multiple massive boss enemies Unlock 2 endings based on item completion Original music tracks by Sam Bionn STORY: By the end of the twenty-second century, Earth was a dry, arid husk. Billions of humans were crowded into overpopulated shelters, rife with disease and death. Just as their ancestors did so long ago, humanity looked to the stars for salvation. Using incredible technologies designed out of desperation, billions of people forged journeys into the darkness, establishing vast networks of interstellar colonies. The discovery of countless forms of alien life was met with indifference - an indifference that quickly turned to contempt. A powerful human military, honed by centuries of warfare, overpowered and conquered isolated alien worlds, claiming them as new territory for the massive human diaspora. Humanity had avoided extinction and resettled itself, but had made a galaxy of enemies in the process. Survivors of countless fallen alien worlds banded together, and launched a suicidal campaign of revenge against the upstart race. All of humanity’s military and technological advances crumbled under the fury of an enraged galaxy, and soon, only a few million people remained, hidden in isolated pockets across the stars. Once again faced with extinction, humanity turned to the tool that had brought them to the stars: innovation. But now, surviving military leaders were uninterested in saving lives or defending worlds. Their focus was far more singular - the eradication of everything. Terrible, reality-warping weapons were created by bending the very laws of nature. Captured alien species were spliced together and twisted into genetic abominations. Artificial intelligences were designed and built to brutalize their enemies, stripped of any ethical or moral restraint. But there were a few dissenters. Not everyone believed that humanity’s last acts should be dedicated to nihilism. Some tried to reason with those in charge. Some refused their orders. And a small number decided to act. DEVELOPER’S NOTE: Ex Vitro began its development many years ago as a tribute to one of the greatest games of all time: Super Metroid. I quickly realized any fangame would be squashed with legal trouble, so I shifted the graphics to my own design and tried to ride the line between ‘tribute’ and ‘knock-off’. It remains to be seen how successful I was, but as a solo developer, I learned a lot about game design in the process. It was the first game I started making, and it contains all of the lessons I learned along the way. Due to its origin, I feel that it’s unfair to charge for it. But I’ve included a bonus pack to go with it, if you want to support future development of new games by me! BONUS PACK INCLUDES: Instructions on how to build your very own Terrarium! (with special tips from the Facility Administration on how to care for genetic abominations) 3 original music tracks by Sam Bionn High res concept art images of the character, final boss, and ending slides High quality wallpapers with various resolutions Royalty-free sprite sheets of unused graphics that never made it into the game, and behind-the-scenes descriptions of why they weren’t included 8 Royalty-free tilesets of every environment from the game
row.short_description: EX VITRO is a dark sci-fi 2D platformer where you delve into the ruins of a military research facility and discover the horrors within. Whether machine, creature, or something else entirely, you’ll face the violent legacy of the last survivors of humanity.
row.notes: Gameplay consists of killing and/or injuring enemies using sci-fi themed weapons, resulting in them emitting yellow or red blood and leaving behind corpses. Datalogs found throughout the game contain cursing, references to violent or dangerous behavior, and mention murder, suicide, and genocide.

row.name: The Alpine Express
row.detailed_description: Too poor to travel? Or don't have time at all from your busy schedule? Don't worry, this game takes you on a journey to the famous summit - Jungfrau - located close to Interlaken, Switzerland. Visit the Glacier Café and complete the travel log. Chopper down and go for a stroll and don't forget to bring some warm clothes because you are gonna need it.
row.short_description: Experience the majestic Jungfrau summit in this short walking simulator.

row.name: A Steamboat Willie
row.detailed_description: Sail a steamboat and movecargo for profit Cargo Cargo can be bought and sold at different ports for money. Some places are illegal to move cargo between but give a higher resale value. Be carefull tho because the customs enforcers may seize your cargo if they catch you. Upgrades Your steamboat can be upgraded at any shipwright in the world. Things such as the cargo hold and speed can be increased for money; Features Sailing Openworld Economy Upgrades
row.short_description: Sail as mikey mouse with steamboat willy. Move and sell cargo for money but look out for customs officers as they are out to confiscate your illegal cargo.

row.name: Pact of Joy: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Prologue: -Jack Argyle, a skilled contractor, arrives at Phorcys Station accompanied by his trusty robotic assistant. Their objective: repair the station's malfunctioning communications system and return home. What should be a straightforward job becomes twisted when they're confronted by the dangers aboard the station. Setting: -Set in the same world as Test of Courage and Born Into Fear, carefully navigate the underwater ex-Aegis facility, Phorcys Station, in the near future of the year 2043 while you attempt to restore its communications. Gameplay: -Piece together the fragments of the station's history and uncover the truth behind its troubled past through dialogue, terminal entries, and more while you attempt to accomplish your mission. -Overall, the gameplay combines atmospheric exploration, survival elements, and an engaging narrative to provide a thrilling and immersive experience within the haunted depths of Phorcys Station. - Repair control panels to restore access to locations around Phorcys Station. - Meet some of the colorful souls who lived in Phorcys Station. - Learn about the past lives of the Children of Joy through their personal computer terminals. Features: - Visions : Get a glimpse of something otherworldly happening in the station. - Variety of characters : Speak to various NPC's and avoid the failed experiments of the Ambassador. - Randomized solutions : Each console will have a different solution for everyone. - Drone Companion : Your constant companion throughout the game, Robuddy will speak to you and give you advice on your quest. He’ll also serve as your flashlight and can highlight interactable objects/objectives using Enlightened Vision. Can you bring the Children of Joy the peace they seek?
row.short_description: As Jack Argyle, you are tasked with restoring communication at the underwater ex-Aegis facility known as Phorcys Station. Be careful, or risk joining the spirits trapped inside.

row.name: Road to Top G
row.detailed_description: Road to Top G is an intense and action-packed game that combines the thrilling elements of a zombie survival game with the added twist of defeating the notorious antagonist Top G. In this game, players are tasked with surviving relentless waves of zombies and ultimately confronting the formidable Top G in an epic boss battle. The gameplay revolves around the player's journey with hordes of undead creatures. To reach the final confrontation, players must demonstrate their survival skills and reach Wave 10, unlocking the elusive boss door. Each wave presents increasingly challenging hordes of zombies, requiring players to strategically utilize their resources and abilities to stay alive. Are you ready to take on Road to Top G and face the infamous boss in a battle for survival and dominance? The fate of humanity rests in your hands!
row.short_description: Survive waves of zombies, collect perks, unlock boss door, and face the Top G in an intense showdown.
row.notes: In the boss fight the bosses may use some words that can offend sensitve people but it is for meme purposes, (please do not take it seriously).

row.name: 2 Minutes 16 Seconds (2分16秒)
row.detailed_description: This is a 2D Pixel Top-Down Space Shooter Game. The game implemented Rogue-Lite elements, like the survivor series. 'Captain, every 2 minutes and 16 seconds, the Alien Mothership catch up with us using Spatial Jump. Luckily, we analyzed their technology so that we can also perform Jumps to escape from them. However, it's necessary for us to collect fuels in the space, in order to move and jump. We could also rescue lost people and ships, and add them to our fleet. With our advanced Initializer, we can Initialize ships' weapon system and invite them into our battleship fleet; we can also Initialize people's Implanted learning devices to let them join as crew members. But PLEASE remember, Initialization cost TIME, and jump during Initialization would abandon what's being Initialized. Control: WASD/Arrow + Enter/Mouse' Hope you enjoy this game!
row.short_description: This is a 2D Pixel Top-Down Space Shooter Game. The game implemented Rogue-Lite elements, like the survivor series.

row.name: 小拾逅 Gathering Our Childhoods
row.detailed_description: Theme Concept 'Do you remember what innocent acts you did as a child?' We present childhood memories that resonate with the 2000s generation with games and illustrations, and by exploring the game, the audience are reminded of their own unique childhood memories. We also want to convey the notion that even if you are still on the journey of growing up, don't forget the spirit of dreaming boldly when you were a child. Leader plot One day when the player was tidying up the room, he was accidentally hit by the 'friend address book'. After opening it curiously, it suddenly emitted a strong light and sucked the player in! When he woke up again, he found that he had traveled through time and space and returned to the elementary school classroom, and a stranger appeared behind him...! ? Gameplay and features After entering the game, the player needs to interact with the students or solve problems in order to obtain 'Memory Fragments' and 'Memory Power' to return to the original world. There are also many 'hidden easter eggs, achievements' or BL books (!?) in the game waiting for you to explore, let's take a childhood journey together!
row.short_description: The story of the game is about the player traveling back to the childhood campus. Players are required to complete all kinds of tasks, so as to collect the memory points to be able to return to the original world. Let's have a childhood journey together!

row.name: Block Tower: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Full Game About the Game Block Tower: Prologue is only part of the gameplay that awaits you in the full game. There are 8 towers available in the prologue and 25 waves of enemies out of 50 in the full game. Block Tower TD is a roguelike tower defense strategy game with interesting innovations. Build a world out of blocks, choose random upgrades to make every run unique. CREATING THE WORLD The world consists of blocks that you can place anywhere. Thanks to this, you will be able to think over a defense plan. BUILD TOWERS Tower locations are the most important aspect in tower defense games. This aspect becomes even more valuable in Block Tower: you can build towers on high ground, leave free blocks for resource extraction or later strong towers. In addition, all towers have an experience bar, the earlier you build it, the stronger it will be in the late game. CHOOSE UPGRADES The order in which upgrades are chosen in each game is very important. You can choose resource-based upgrades, magic tower upgrades, or upgrades for strong early defense, which will allow you to safely move into the late game. Combined with randomly generated blocks, this gives infinite replay value. RESOURCE MINING Think over your economic strategy. Early construction of economic buildings is risky, but gives a big boost in the late game. The random location of resources in each game sets new strategic questions that you will have to answer each time.
row.short_description: Block Tower TD is a roguelike tower defense strategy game with interesting innovations. Build a world out of blocks, choose random upgrades to make every run unique.

row.name: Heróis de Noname - Acesso Antecipado
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the Early Access of Heroes of Noname! During Early Access, you'll have the opportunity to be a part of the game's development and even leave your mark on it, with your name in the credits or an in-game tribute based on your contributions. Heroes of Noname is an RPG focused on exploration and combat. Explore a massive, ever-expanding world. Recruit unique characters. Find and combine various items to customize your characters. Multiple minigames and seasonal content. Join our Discord and become a part of our growing community! Share your experience, report bugs, and send suggestions to help us build this world together with the community. Still planning an english version...
row.short_description: Heroes of Noname: A casual, open-world fantasy RPG. Explore forests, ruins, and caves in search of treasures, using them to defeat powerful enemies and uncover every mystery of the world of Noname.

row.name: Santa's Monster Shootout
row.detailed_description: Snowy valleys, Christmas bells and Santa Claus is preparing gifts for Christmas. A normal December. Really? No, something is different this year... Monsters and Zombies from all the world are trying to steal the gift packages, they want it all and they want it now. But Santa don't own just a sack full of gifts and a rod... he also has guns, big guns. Guns to defeat infinite waves of monsters to protect the gift packages. Help Santa to get rid of the evil breed and bring us happy holidays! How to Play: The primary weapon has infinite ammo, it is not very strong but always available. Shoot as many enemies you can to earn money for purchasing new pistols, guns and refill ammo in the shop. Pick up ammo clips and health packages to keep you alive while playing a level. On each level, you must fight against a big end monster to go to the next level. From level to level the game gets harder.
row.short_description: Monsters and Zombies from all the world are trying to steal the gift packages, they want it all and they want it now. But Santa has guns, big guns!
row.notes: This game has mature content and contains Fantasy Comic Violence, Blood and Crude Humor!

row.name: Tattoos and Tulips
row.detailed_description: Tattos and Tulips is a feel-good BL visual novel featuring a budding romance between a grumpy florist named Chrys, and a friendly tattoo artist named Shay! Story: Chrys is jaded and unlucky in love. He just wants to focus on being 20—hanging out with friends, working in customer service, and trying not to get his heart broken for the millionth time. Everything changes for him the day a friendly tattoo artist named Shay comes into his shop to sketch the tulips. A kinetic visual novel (no choices). That doesn't mean there aren't twists and turns however! Features: 60K words (18 Chapters + Epilogue) 8 Gorgeous CGs! Original artwork throughout made by real people! Original soundtrack! Partial voice acting! Characters:
row.short_description: Follow Chrys as he declares to swear off dating in favor of focusing on himself and hanging out with friends. That is until a very sweet, and very hot tattoo artist named Shay enters the picture. Has Chrys' bad luck gone away?

row.name: Magnir Saga Part 1
row.detailed_description: There is a story on a planet called Magnir which has a magnetic field of the planet necessary for life. Without a planet's magnetic field, high-energy particles from the sun and space, also known as plasma energy coming from the solar wind, hit the star's surface. But the King of Alexania doesn't care. Despite knowing because he believes in his science and abilities that if he can possess the energy of the entire star, he will be able to create a magnetosphere, which is a neighborhood with high-power magnets around it. It increases the energy of the magnetosphere that originally covered the surrounding planet. The stars are so powerful that they can block plasma energy coming from the solar wind. And he himself will be able to take over this planet. -------------------- Main Features -------------------- - Melee Battle - Inventory System - Quest System - Cooking System - Skill System -------------------- Walkthrough -------------------- Escape From Leitu Mining Walkthrough >>>>>>>>>> Find Infiltrated Soldier Walkthrough >>>>>>>>>> Ride On Air Walkthrough >>>>>>>>>> Bandit Village Argyros Walkthrough >>>>>>>>>> Bandit Village Entrance Walkthrough >>>>>>>>>> Help Blacksmith (random key) Walkthrough >>>>>>>>>> Back To Town (Fallen Barbarian) Walkthrough >>>>>>>>>> Find Lost Area (Hidden place) Walkthrough >>>>>>>>>> Find Lost Area (Wall Remove) Walkthrough >>>>>>>>>> Find Lost Area (Fallen Assassin) Walkthrough >>>>>>>>>> Volcano King Walkthrough >>>>>>>>>> Stop Boars Walkthrough >>>>>>>>>> Bomb Arrow and Dragon Hideout
row.short_description: Magnir Saga is an action adventure game. Which our hero was reincarnated as a magic sword man. He will journey across the planet of Magnir to revenge for his father and save the planet.

row.name: 垂钓日记 The Sailor’s Guide to Game Design
row.detailed_description: You have to travel across the ocean. On the beach, you meet the only sailor. After you met the sailor, the sailor got this new identity: sailor. Before you realize that you have been trapped in the tangled web that the words weaving, you already fall into the mist valley of the anonymous memory, that is the place where the silence rest… Game features: - Fishing -Simulated fishing - Point and click simulate fishing -Several fixed animations of different fish, catching some things that cannot be caught in reality (probably) - And meanwhile listening to a ghost talk for an hour without any clue
row.short_description: The Sailor’s Guide to Game Design is an interactive visual novel try to use a 'Dialect' narrative style in games, Writing from the Margins.

row.name: Neonscape
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Neonscape. The simulation awaits, beckoning warriors like you to prove their mettle and etch their names into the annals of glory. Enter the Simulation Immerse yourself in the captivating world of Neonscape, a thrilling battle simulation that thrusts you into the shoes of Onyx, a formidable warrior harnessing the extraordinary power of the Black Lotus. Prepare to face relentless waves of enemies as you embark on an adrenaline-charged journey like no other. Master the Power of Karma Combat in Neonscape is a symphony of skill and strategy, where mastering the art of Karma is paramount. Unleash the potent abilities bestowed upon you by the Black Lotus, slicing through the fabric of space itself to wreak havoc upon your adversaries. Swiftly maneuver the simulation room with finesse, utilizing your advanced reflexes to execute lightning-fast attacks, evasive dodges, expert parries, and gravity-defying wall-runs. Every move you make is crucial in outmaneuvering your opponents and emerging victorious. Challenge Your Limits The true test lies in the ultimate question: How long will you survive? Keep track of your progress and challenge yourself to beat your personal best! Neonscape features a locally saved score system that allows you to save your hard-earned score and strive for greater achievements. Push your limits and discover the depths of your abilities as you strive for greatness within the confines of your own achievements.
row.short_description: Embrace Onyx, the master of the Black Lotus, in intense first-person hack n' slash combat. Maneuver compact battlegrounds, unleash spatial manipulation, and showcase unmatched agility. How long can you survive the relentless waves? Brace for an adrenaline-pumping test of mettle!

Just move fast. Please. Please. I am begging you. HIGHLIGHTS: - 5 Guns: - Minigun - 'Surgical' DMR - 'Spitfire' Shotgun - 'Destroyer of worlds' Exploder - Rocket Launcher - Unique enemies (take that tachyonest!!!) - Mission based campain - Zero gravity! - Florop Geegle doop

row.name: Town of Dusk
row.detailed_description: The Town of Dusk is a text-based adventure game of mystery, suspenseful, puzzle and slightly horror Set in the backdrop of Japan in the 1990s, two teams accidentally find themselves in the Town of Dusk, which was built just before the fall of the Empire of Japan . There, they embark on a journey of reasoning and adventure. Players take on different roles and influence the story's direction through their choices, leading to different endings. Players need to: Avoid being killed by other characters Solve all the puzzles, find the truth Uncover the mastermind behind everything Ultimately escape the Town of Dusk As an Adventure Game, players can save and load their game at any time, fast-forward through conversations, view dialogue history. This game provides the functions of: Plot Progress Flowchart to jump to any experienced plot point After ending, automatically return to the choice that affect the ending More about the background of this game: 'As secrets buried underground in the Town of Dusk come to light, a shocking conspiracy emerges. Players join the other characters and enter the Town of Dusk built on the eve of the Empire of Japan's defeat. Everyone's identity is shrouded in mystery, and dangerous individuals hide among them, carrying out their hidden agendas. Players embark on a journey of deduction, adventure, and wit that takes them to the brink of death. Please avoid being killed by other characters! Survive until the end, solve all the puzzles! Find the mastermind, thwart all the conspiracies, and uncover the 'real' truth! Then escape the Town of Dusk! If a controlled character deceives you, don't be surprised.'
row.short_description: Players will enter the Town of Dusk, built on the eve of Empire of Japan's defeat in World War II, along with other characters. Avoid being killed by other characters! Find the mastermind behind the scenes, unravel all the conspiracies, and uncover the truth! Ultimately escape the Town of Dusk!

row.name: Light of Coco
row.detailed_description: Light of Coco is a 3D puzzle platformer, played as a feline star creature named Coco. IMMERSE YOURSELF IN THE STORY Light of Coco is a story about love, lonelines, hardship and determination. As you play, you will uncover little pieces of the story delivered via gameplay, level/character design, cinematics and interactive illustrations. The original soundtrack is designed to set the mood and guide the player through an emotional journey. SOLVE PUZZLES WITH THE HELP OF YOUR COMPANIONS Coco is small and gentle, and she has the most adorable, angelic meows. Use her voice to ask your butterfly companions to assist you with activating totems, opening doors, clearing ruble, lifting/carrying items, and so on. Aside from basic movement, you will have to rely on always having a butterfly around you to interact with the puzzles. HEAL, PROTECT AND NURTURE Your butterfly companions might get attacked, trapped or injured. It is your duty to keep them out of danger and use Coco's voice to shoo away any hostiles. Mistakes happen, and that's okay! That's because her voice has healing abilities and can help out those in need. Don't be shy to share your meows with other plants and creatures as well. BEWARE OF THE SHADOWS When there is light, there are also shadows. What evil creatures might be hiding in the darkness? No matter what, Coco must keep moving forward as her love is stronger than anything else. Be ready to hide, run and face her fears.
row.short_description: Play as Coco - a feline star creature. Use Coco's gentle meows to nurture the environment and ask your butterfly companions to assist you. Beware of the creatures lurking in the shadows.

row.name: New Day
row.detailed_description: Welcome... to New Day! New Day is an upcoming life simulation game where almost anything can happen! Create your own islanders, design their apartments, and get involved with their day-to-day life as they divulge into unexpected friendships, problems, and more! Within New Day, you'll be able to use the Islander Creator to create your very own original islanders! The Islander Creator features different eyes, mouths, eyebrows, hairstyles, species, and even a makeup creator -- where you can create custom faces of your own! The Islander Creator is filled with endless possibilities and creative freedom so that you can make the islander you want. The Room Editor is a tool in New Day that you'll use to create custom apartments for your islanders. You'll be able to add up to 4 rooms per apartment, and will be able to decorate to your hearts content. Some pieces of furniture might host some... interesting lore... You'll be able to interact with each, individual islander, which will allow them to form their own opinion of you! Interacting with an islander allows you to access a variety of unique interactions, such as playing mini-games with them, solving a problem they might have, and more! Interactions don't stop at islanders, though, as you'll have access to multiple buildings on your island, such as a movie theater, an arcade, and a clothing shop! Each building will host an NPC that you'll be able to befriend, if you choose to. Befriending the keepers of each building might grant you additional rewards that you won't find anywhere else in the game! Islanders in New Day will be able to form friendships with other islanders, and even relationships, if it gets that far! Friendships/Relationships will form based on how much time islanders spend together, if they have common interests, and their personality trait. If all goes well, maybe two of your favorite islanders will end up together, get married, and... well... the rest explains itself. In New Day, it's entirely possible that a friendship is one-sided, and only one of the islanders enjoy the others company. This can lead to some interesting situations... Jobs are an essential part of New Day. It allows the player to earn money in order to buy furniture in the Room Editor, clothing for your islanders, and more! Each job has their own difficulty setting. With each difficulty increase, you'll earn more money, making the 'harder' difficulty choices more rewarding! In conclusion, New Day aims to be an amazing experience that's suitable for every players gaming preference. We strive to make this an amazing game, made purely out of love and motivation. To end this off, I'm giving a special thanks to everyone on the New Day staff team. (Active Staff Team): Furbies ( Programmer ) Potato Plays ( Artist ) Timtodile ( 3D Modeler ) LilanDeSilva ( Composer ) AjMamoru ( 3D Modeler ) Behon ( Voice Actor ) Rosie_Maybe ( Artist ) Raj ( 3D Modeler ) Anemo ( Artist ) Chamilionio ( Artist / UI Designer ) Valdemar ( 3D Modeler ) absonewtly ( Artist ) Casbastian ( Artist ) Leilanix ( Artist ) Kandy Kat ( Artist ) Zii ( Modeler ) just a fellow girl gamer ( Modeler ) Hunt Moped ( 3D Animator ) SilverBuudha ( Emotional Support )
row.short_description: New Day is an upcoming life simulation game where almost anything can happen! Create your own islanders, design their apartments, and get involved with their day-to-day life as they divulge into unexpected friendships, problems, and more!
row.notes: New Day contains slight violence against your islanders by allowing them to be dropped into the ocean to be drowned. New Day also includes guns, murder, and violence between islanders if the player so wishes to allow that on their island.

row.name: SWAT Commander: Prologue
row.detailed_description: SWAT Commander: Prologue is the FREE introductory version of our team tactical shooter and does not reflect the final version of the game. Check out its full version's page for a description of its features! In the prologue, you face the challenges of our second mission – Hot Reception. Team up with your friends in a SWAT squad or go in solo to investigate an auto shop where a violent shootout between rival gangs took place. Secure any evidence of criminal activity, bring the perpetrators to justice, and restore order! Make yourself familiar with the mission's briefing and find out what dangers emerged to threaten innocent civilians – you're about to face them yourself. Equip your SWAT operative accordingly with a selection of rifles, handguns, armors, and tactical gear to tackle the belligerent gangs. Create a multiplayer lobby to invite other players or go into the mission solo or   join the lobby of another SWAT commander . Coordinate and discuss your mission plan down to the equipment each of you will be bringing or the entry point you'll be choosing. Select one of the three available game modes to determine the type of mission you'll be embarking on – high-risk warrant , barricaded suspect , and bomb threat . Your operations' goals can change between bringing down dangerous suspects, neutralizing entrenched criminals, and defusing an explosive device. Enter the Bernard Tire & Auto Center to begin the SWAT intervention. Secure your mission objectives and earn an evaluation of your performance. Remember to keep your eyes open and use every tactical advantage you can think of. Defend the innocents and bring the perps to justice!
row.short_description: The FREE PROLOGUE version of our tactical squad shooter. In SWAT Commander: Prologue, you join an elite special forces unit. Team up with other operatives, manage your equipment, and most importantly – complete your mission successfully.
row.notes: The game features gun violence throughout its entirety – human characters killing and dying in firearm combat.

row.name: Des racines et des graines
row.detailed_description: Des Racines et des Graines (Roots and Seeds but in french) is a garden game where the player will explore an island with different species of plants and trees. Each day you're uncovering this new environment and its history. You will gather some seeds from the vegetation and re-plant them close to each other to get hybrids. Day after day, you will cross-breed the plants to create some new ones, to finally find and restore the ultimate tree : Yggdrasil. . Enjoy a free cozy game . Explore a beautifull hand-draw island . Experiment with mysterious plants . Gaming experience around 1h Please note, due to its short playing experience and its production over 48 hours, the game does not offer a saving system. Some sounds were produced by digifishmusic, klankbeeld, Noted451, DBS_Sounds, cupido-1 & jgrzinich and distributed by FreeSound.
row.short_description: A garden game where you will explore a calm and peaceful island. Gather some seeds from the vegetation and re-plant them close to each other to get hybrids. Day after day, you will cross-breed the plants to create some new ones, to finally find and restore the ultimate tree: Yggdrasil.

row.name: Rags to Liches
row.detailed_description: Rags to Liches is a small, third-person, action, tower defense game where you play as a peasant who gets tired of adventurers breaking into his house. Place down towers and fight off waves and waves of 'enemies.' Progress through the story and see just how far one man will go to protect his beloved llama. Features 5 Levels 4 Tower types Endless Mode Keyboard RGB If you find any bugs, please let us know. We hope you enjoy this game we made in 10 weeks.
row.short_description: A small, third-person, action, tower defense game where you play as a peasant who gets tired of adventurers breaking into his house. Place down towers and fight off waves and waves of 'enemies.' Progress through the story and see just how far one man will go to protect his beloved llama.

row.name: Daycare Descent
row.detailed_description: Naptime's over! With rumbling stomachs and no snacks in sight, explore a deserted daycare overrun by vengeful toys. From the nap room to the basement storage, navigate through the eerie corridors and relentless toy onslaught in your quest for snacks. Features: Crawling Babies: Play as one of four toddlers crawling around the daycare. Careful standing up though, as walking around can result in tripping. Tantrum-based Health System: As the players take damage, they inch closer to totally flipping out. Don't throw a tantrum for too long, or the attendant will take notice. Toy-filled Chaos: Battle through waves of mischievous toy enemies, ranging from pint-sized troublemakers to formidable toy bosses. Uncanny labyrinth: From the Daycare's nap room, traverse the halls and delve into the eerie cellar in search of snacks. Characters: Dillian: The French-Korean baby, self-appointed leader of the snack brigade Joah-Joah: The buff baby, muscle of the group Phoebe: The toy expert, hungriest of them all Travis: The lookout, aware of his surroundings
row.short_description: Daycare Descent is a co-op shooter inspired by Left 4 Dead. Take control of our four trepid adventurers as they battle toys throughout the daycare in search of snacks. Tighten your diapers, grab your pacifiers, and fill up your water guns. Playtime's just begun!

row.name: Valley of The Savage Run
row.detailed_description: Move both frogs in sync and try to reach the end of the level before the predator catches them. Only 5% of all players are able to activate their left and right brain hemispheres at the same time to move both frogs in sync. Are you one of them? You control a white frog and a black frog. They work as a team. The white frog hops on white tiles, and the black frog hops on black tiles. Sometimes one frog has to carry the other because there are no matching tiles. Other times, one frog has to unblock the tiles of the other, so both can continue forward. Teleports are tricky. The frogs may have to hop on each other's backs before and after entering the teleport in order to match the right tiles on the entrance and exit. Meanwhile, you have to move fast. A predator chases the frogs and tries to catch them. Sometimes you can deceive it and use it to unblock your way.
row.short_description: Move both frogs in sync to reach the end of the level before the predator catches them. Can you use your brain's left and right hemispheres simultaneously to move the frogs in sync? Only 5% are able to do it.

row.name: Caislean: Paranormal
row.detailed_description: Moloch Castle has a deep history and has recently gained attention through a viral video showcasing a haunting. It's up to the Ballymont Paranormal Group to investigate the castle. It appears that there is more than meets the eye... Place equipment and gadgets during the day in order to survive the threats of the night. Featuring: First Person day sections Point and Click night sections Custom Night game mode with 3 new enemy types Investigate the castle during the day and place cameras, sensors, and snares throughout the explored environment. You must use your investigation skills to determine the locations of paranormal hotspots and find clues about countering new enemy types. Unravel the mysterious downfall of the Moloch family and lay their souls to rest. [** From the developer **] This game was created over the course of 2.5 years by one person. Would love to hear constructive feedback!
row.short_description: A dynamic survival-horror game featuring gadget setup and point-and-click sequences. Investigate the castle during the day and place cameras, sensors, and snares throughout the explored environment. Locate paranormal hotspots and read clues about countering enemies.
row.notes: Psuedo-realistic violence and body horror.

row.name: Throne and Liberty
row.detailed_description: Join massive battles, transform into your favorite creatures, and wield powerful weapon combinations in Throne and Liberty, an unforgettable free-to-play adventure with seemingly endless activities for both PvE and PvP players. Interested in PvE? Challenge Raids, dungeons, Dimensional Trials, and more. Prefer PvP? Form alliances to rule together or betray your way to the top. Will you carve your niche as a solo player or leave your legacy on the world of Solisium alongside friends? The choice is yours. Throne and Liberty captures the essence of classic MMORPGs while introducing new gameplay elements, depth and excitement at every turn. Gather your guild, prepare for battle, and set forth for throne... and liberty! KEY FEATURES: Guild-Based PvP for Every Ambition : Capture control points in guild versus guild Conquest Battles, strike down Guild Raid Bosses, and claim the throne in massive Castle Sieges to carve your legacy on the world of Solisium. Where will your ambition take you? Slash through Dynamic Guild Events, complete Guild Contracts, or hang out in your Guild Base before cutting a path to the top of the Guild Leaderboard in higher stakes game modes.     Activities for Every Level of Adventurer : Journey into 6-player tiered Dungeons, vanquish monstrous, open-world bosses, or best other players in 3v3 Arenas. There are also solo dungeons that help ease you into more difficult group activities like Dimensional Trials. Looking for something even more intense? Venture forth into Raids for a true test of teamwork and skill. How about laid back experiences? Gather materials, build furniture, customize your house, catch fish, and cook local delicacies for buffs. Housing is more than just a place to hang out, it’s a personal space that grows with you throughout your quest.     Innovative Character Abilities, Morphs and Transformations : Interchangeable abilities on the battlefield include the dual-weapons system, player morphs for tactical advantage, and quicker travel or transform into the body of a fallen boss and turn the tide of the battle with Guardian’s Pledge.       Vast, Seamless, and Ever-Changing World : Expansive and immersive environment, with towering cliffs and cavernous dungeons with consequential day/night cycles and unpredictable weather that impacts your gameplay and abilities.       Forge Your Path to Glory : With four primary vertical progression paths interwoven together, players choose from a wide variety of options to determine their playstyle. With hundreds of combinations of builds, you can forge your own unique way to storm the battlefield.
row.short_description: Throne and Liberty captures the essence of classic MMORPGs while introducing new gameplay elements, depth and excitement at every turn. Gather your guild, prepare for battle, and set forth for throne... and liberty!
row.notes: Lots of battles, fights with other human like, animal like characters in the game. Cutscenes with sand worm, and monster like characters.

row.name: Effugium
row.detailed_description: 'Now I am become Death, the destroyer of worlds.' - J. Robert Oppenheimer Effugium is a first-person exploratory horror walking simulator with a heavy emphasis on atmosphere and immersion. Key Features : Navigate and search for a means for escape as you explore the cold and empty space facility. Immerse yourselves in the atmospheric sounds and world of Effugium! Uncover and piece together the mystery of the space facility. Effugium was developed by Team Glasses, a team of two students from USC Games in collaboration with the Berklee College of Music. Playtime is approximately 6-10 minutes. It is recommended to use headphones and an external mouse for the best possible experience of Effugium!
row.short_description: Explore a cold, abandoned, and dreary facility to piece together its mysteries and find a means for escape from the horror that lurks within.
row.notes: There is optional text dialogue describing scenes of unethical human experimentation.

row.name: Johnny Rocketfingers Complete Game Collection!
row.detailed_description: JOHNNY ROCKETFINGERS 1 & 2, GAME COLLECTION!! The internet smash hit Point & Click Adventure game, 'Johnny Rocketfingers,' is finally available to play directly from your desktop computer! With over 50 million+ plays world wide this viral Stick Figure flash game won the hearts of everyone who played it on Newgrounds back during it's debut in 2003! Enjoy replaying this classic series or playing for the first time! In this adventure game series you control the character of Johnny Rocketfingers. Move your cursor carefully around environments to walk through and explore your surroundings. Click on items you find on-screen to pick them up. These items go in your inventory for the use of solving in-game puzzles. Talk to characters to get clues for what to do next on your missions. This is your standard Point & Click Puzzle Adventure game but with a violent, gritty, Tarantino-esque twist - inspired by Monkey Island, Lucasarts and Sierra games of the 90's. Also inspired by films such as Pulp Fiction, Goodfellas and Menace II Society. WARNING: This game series is not recommended for young audiences or sensitive players. Contains extremely Crude Humor, Violence, Vulgar Language, Sexual Innuendos. Depictions of sexual acts and extreme violence. Depictions of drug and alcohol abuse.
row.short_description: JOHNNY ROCKETFINGERS 1 & 2 - GAME COLLECTION! The internet smash hit Point & Click Adventure game, 'Johnny Rocketfingers,' is finally available to play from your desktop computer!
row.reviews: “Gritty and Tarantino-esque views of the world with over the top visuals and violence accentuated by the chaotic art style.” 5/5 – Games Freezer
row.notes: Crude Humor, Violence, Vulgar Language, Sexual Innuendos. Depictions of sexual acts and extreme violence. Depictions of drug and alcohol abuse.

row.name: Forwards
row.detailed_description: Suggestion Of How to Play This: As the designer behind this, I suggest playing this alone where you can take your time and experience this. I'm hoping this adds a bit of positivity and brightness into your life. This is intended for 'First Person Shooter' players who use WASD controls... kind of... you'll see. --------------------------------------------------------------- Controls: The gameplay for PC players is looking around with the mouse and moving with the WASD keys, kind of. Players can use a controller, just use the joysticks for movement and looking around. There are Haptics for the controller --------------------------------------------------------------- Game Intent: As you move through the game, you'll 'Discover' things and through that discovery, I hope to take you on a journey of looking inside your life. 'Forwards' is an expression of my personal journey as a designer. --------------------------------------------------------------- Playtime: Approximately 1 Min Average playtime is about a minute with the game instantly starting and immediately closing when it's over. There is no menu. --------------------------------------------------------------- Note On Playthrough: Some people have gotten stuck and taken longer and some people have gone through missing parts of it. I took the consideration of making the game easier to playthrough at the potential cost of players going through it the wrong way. Still, I hope the majority of players are able to experience the fullness of this game. --------------------------------------------------------------- Reminder: This is an prototype for an experiential linear narrative walking sim. --------------------------------------------------------------- Spoilers and Inspiration: The Backwards level in The Beginner's Guide. I altered the level, the narrative, the controls, lighting and audio, that I hope, tells it's own story and differentiates it from that level. The environment feeling is suppose to be that of the The Stanley Parable which is the same developer as The Beginner's Guide
row.short_description: An experiential linear narrative walking sim

row.name: CATASS
row.detailed_description: CATASS is a game where you are a cat! Never let your human realize your feline plans. THROW THINGS! And many other important plans, of course. I mean... Meow. Complete the main storyline to declare yourself a supreme cat and show your human who's in charge. CATASS is a casual game where you can demonstrate your worth as a cat through different levels and extra challenges. An adventure filled with exciting levels, puzzles, riddles, humor, references to pop culture, and the internet. Complete all the achievements to become the greatest cat of all time and crown yourself as the master and supreme ruler of CATASS. CATASS is a personal project developed solo and made in my free time on weekends. And to provide a fun and exciting experience. This project is to prove myself by developing a solo game from scratch: Game design, graphics, logic, music, and animations. I've made everything except the sound effects and typography I bought in Envato Elements. If you play the game, I beg your pardon because of all the bugs. I'm not a programmer and an absolute noob developing. Surprisingly, many great people have finished the game, streamers, VTubers, and amazing gamers around the globe. The game works. IT WORKS! I really don't know how, but it works! Download CATASS now and experience the thrill of being a cat. You won't regret it!
row.short_description: CATASS is an indie game that is 100% free without ads. In CATASS, you'll be a cat and show your great superiority to your human through fun and short adventures, puzzles, achievements, and lots of humor. Play now!

row.name: Hauma - A Detective Noir Story - Prologue
row.detailed_description: ABOUT HAUMA Hauma is a noir deduction visual novel set in the heart of Munich. Step into the shoes of Judith, a former detective with a sharp wit and a knack for getting things done, as she uncovers a conspiracy amongst the city's upper echelons of society. Explore real locations in a unique art style, immersing you in the world of Bavaria's capital. From the historic House of Art to other unexpected locations, discover pieces of hidden history that shed light on the city's past. Collect items, solve puzzles, and overcome dialogue riddles as you make your own investigative deductions using the mindboard, the heart of the game which functions like an inventory containing items and thoughts. Featuring a diverse cast, Hauma is a fully voiced cinematic adventure with an intriguing story. Embark on a journey of deduction and intrigue, uncover the secrets of Munich's society and piece together the puzzle of the conspiracy that lies within. [❖] A thrilling noir-inspired journey through Munich [❖] The mindboard, an innovative inventory of interconnected items and thoughts [❖] Engaging investigation mechanics, including a variety of puzzles and challenging dialogue riddles [❖] A visually unique art style [❖] Fully voiced cinematic adventure, featuring a diverse cast
row.short_description: Hauma is a deduction visual novel set in Munich. Discover a conspiracy amongst the upper echelons of society alongside former detective Judith, while visiting real locations in a comic-inspired look.
row.notes: This game may contain content not appropriate for all ages. It contains swearing, description of violence and general mature content.

row.name: Code of War Gun Shooting Games
row.detailed_description: Team online shooting games - only action and nothing extra! Code of War is an online shooting game with the best 3D graphics, real physics and a huge selection of weapons. Test your skills in a dynamic online action against players from all over the world! Become the best and take the first places in the ranking table of the whole world! Improve the skill and skills of your fighter to become even stronger! Fight with your friends and reach the top of the rating table in the modern online action game Code of War! Invite your friends and play online with them! features: • Modern 3D graphics! • A large selection of weapons and leveling your fighter • Lots of camouflage and drawings • Multiple battle arenas • Intuitive controls that are suitable for both novice shooting players and hardcore gamers • Complete daily tasks and strengthen the fighter • A general chat that allows you to communicate with the players of your country • Dynamic fights and crazy action with no time for respite. • You can choose any game mode: team or individual. And all this is for FREE! BECOME THE BEST Join our fan communities. Be aware of the newest updates! Take part in gaming tournaments, take first place in the ranking! Fill your life with thrills, start your battle!
row.short_description: Code of War is an exciting online shooter. Show shooting skills, fight in multiplayer modes and upgrade your character. Addictive gameplay, high-quality graphics and adrenaline on the battlefield. Join the community and become a real hero today!

row.name: Striker Zone: Gun Games Online
row.detailed_description: Step into the thrilling Striker Zone – a cross-platform shooter game where heroism meets the heat of battle. Engage in heart-pounding warfare with soldiers from around the globe, each moment packed with adrenaline and the echo of gunfire. In Striker Zone, you are more than a soldier; you're a modern warrior, a hero poised to strike in the zone where war never ends. Your arsenal? A range of free, state-of-the-art weapons at your fingertips. Every battle is a chance to rewrite history in this world of constant war, where your army comrades become your brethren in arms. Battlefields come to life with the sound of shooting and the rush of survival instincts. Attack is more than a strategy; it's your second nature, honed to perfection in the zone where only the strongest persist. And as the gun smoke clears, will you stand as the ultimate survivor? The game's essence is warfare, but the experience is pure adrenaline. Striker Zone offers a free PvP environment that challenges your shooter instincts at every turn. Each battle, each skirmish, each silent takedown could tip the scales in this relentless world war. With every fight, you climb the ranks of the army elite, proving your mettle as a soldier, hero, and legend of the Striker Zone. Your weapon is not just a gun; it's an extension of your will, modern machinery of warfare that brings the concept of attack to a whole new level. So, prepare to immerse yourself in Striker Zone, where the action never stops and the next battle is just a heartbeat away. Will you answer the call of duty and become the hero this world needs?
row.short_description: Join in with friends in a online shooter about modern warfare!
row.notes: This game may contain content that is not appropriate for all ages or for viewing at work: Violence or abuse, adult content!

row.name: War Gun: Shooting Games Online
row.detailed_description: Join War Gun, an exciting shooter that will give you unforgettable moments on the battlefield! Go into the world war and become an irresistible warrior, ready to face any challenges. War Gun is a story about brave heroes and exciting battles. You will have to fight in epic online battles in which every shot and every decision matters. Choose your side and join the battle full of adrenaline and dynamics. From the moment the game starts, you will plunge into the incredibly realistic world armed conflict. Stunning graphics and high-quality visual effects will allow you to fully immerse yourself in the atmosphere of war. The environment comes to life before your eyes, creating the illusion of presence on the battlefield. The game offers you endless opportunities for strategic thinking and tactical reasoning. A variety of game modes and maps will allow you to choose the perfect battlefield for your style of play. Whether it's stormy street battles or a clever operation in the snowy mountains, armed conflict will provide you with an unforgettable experience. A huge selection of weapons and equipment will allow you to customize your character and create unique battle tactics. From powerful assault rifles to deadly sniper rifles, you will be able to choose what is right for you. Gradually unlock new items and upgrade your weapons to become a real military expert. War Gun also offers an exciting multiplayer mode that allows you to challenge players from all over the world. Join a team with your comrades in arms and apply your skills and tactical thinking to achieve victory.
row.short_description: Join War Gun - an epic war game! This is the place where your skill and tactical skills will determine the outcome of the battle. Fight with players from all over the world, diversify your arsenal with weapons and prove your superiority on the battlefield. Are you ready for War Gun?

row.name: Time Raiders
row.detailed_description: Delve deep and explore the vast eastern undergrounds. Treasures? Monsters? Who knows what awaits you... [Create all types of new equipment] The best equipment determines whether you win or lose. What kind of weapon will you rely on? [Experience a deep, intriguing story] Mysterious undead dens, dangerous blood zombie catacombs, there are endless new places to explore. [Discover historical treasures] Discover buried treasures, use your unique sight to authenticate them, and battle against the undead. [Team up with allies to defeat bosses] Gather a trustworthy team and battle against all types of undead creatures and ghosts. [Have no regrets!] Say goodbye to the games where you can't change classes! You can start off as an unstoppable martial fighter and change into a gunslinger, or even a mage! [Customize your vehicles] You'll need a vehicle to travel across the world, and what better is there than to customize your ride? Travel to ancient catacombs in style!
row.short_description: Delve deep and explore the vast eastern undergrounds. Treasures? Monsters? Who knows what awaits you...

row.name: Family Arcade
row.detailed_description: 'Tis the season to be gaming 🎄 Looking for a way to make your next game night or family gathering even more fun? Look no further than Family Arcade. Our jam-packed collection is the ultimate stress reliever, guaranteed to bring out your inner child and have you laughing all night long. Make your holiday season unforgettable with our selection of games that are sure to get everyone into the Christmas spirit 🎅 Our games are perfect for all ages and skill levels, so everyone can join in on the fun. From classic party games to the latest hits, Family Arcade has something for everyone: 🎲 Scavenger Hunt is tailored for young minds. 🎲 Pop the Pumpkin is a great game for teens who are looking for a fun and more challenging experience. 🎲 Hyperdrive is crafted for mature players seeking an adrenaline-fueled experience. 🎲 Wordsmith is designed to appeal to seniors who are looking for a fun and mentally stimulating activity. In addition to our wide selection of Christmas games, our Home screen also features over an hour of Christmas songs to get everyone in the holiday mood! Perfect for family game nights or solo holiday cheer, this pack will bring hours of fun and nostalgia to your home!
row.short_description: With our Holiday Games Bundle, you'll get access to an insane variety of fun and festive games that are perfect for getting everyone into the Christmas spirit. 🎄

row.name: Strongblade - Puzzle Quest and Match-3 Adventure
row.detailed_description: Strongblade is a vibrant, match-3 puzzle adventure with an irresistible charm. As Sean the Mouse, you'll navigate through a stunning world full of puzzles and obstacles, make friends with lovable animal characters, and outsmart crafty villains. The game features over 30 distinct mechanics and thousands of levels, each packed with thrilling power-ups and combinations. Beyond just solving puzzles, you'll be exploring new territories, setting up and decorating unique campsites, and unearthing treasure chests filled with coins, power-ups, and boosters. The excitement doesn't stop there. Strongblade lets you compete in heart-pounding in-game events against players from all over. With each level completed, you help brave Sean on his adventurous journey. So dive into Strongblade's colorful world today. It's not just a game; it's a thrilling adventure filled with fun, challenges, and delightful surprises around every corner.
row.short_description: Strongblade is a match-3 puzzle game where you play as Sean the Mouse. Travel through a captivating world filled with puzzles, outsmart cunning villains, befriend charming animals, and build unique camps.

row.name: Sea of Chaos
row.detailed_description: 'The Sea of Chaos' is a casual real-time strategy game where you can develop characters. In this game, you are born into a chaotic sea with a small floating land. You need to: 1.Collect resources and expand your land. 2.Recruit members and build defensive structures to fend off randomly generated enemies, each unique. 3.Construct various buildings to strengthen your base and unlock technologies to enhance structures. 4.Choose members with excellent traits, arm them thoroughly, and venture into the depths of the sea to gain greater power. 5.Defeat enemies and imprison them. During battles, you can release them from prison, and they will fight for you. 6.In addition to these, you can also: surround your base with sturdy walls and engage in street fighting with enemies, encounter various interesting or dangerous random events. Your character will not truly die, and you will not be completely defeated. You can play freely and casually. More content is currently in production and optimization...
row.short_description: 'Chaos Sea' is an easy real-time strategy development game, where you play a land floating in chaotic waters. Build your base, recruit your heroes, defeat and capture monsters, match traits and equipment, and reach the depths of the sea.

row.name: Unknown FPV: FPV Drone Simulator Playtest
FISHGUN
row.detailed_description: FISHGUN is a chaotic fish-person shooter. The evil fruit have taken over and drained the ocean. Use your fish gun to defeat the fruit and confront their queen. Evade enemies with a fluid, fast-paced movement system. Eat upgrades to change what and how the fish gun shoots. 5 levels and multiple bosses. Bring meaning to your life
row.short_description: FISHGUN is a chaotic fish-person shooter where you feed your sentient gun random upgrades to defeat hordes of evil fruit.

row.name: Procrastinaut
row.detailed_description: Stare down the vast abyss of the unkown until the abyss stares back at you, and the prolonged eye-contact is kind of awkward. Then do something about it! Like, not now , but very soon. Just one more good stare is not going to kill you. Explore A malfunctioning ship and the loss of most of your equipment doesn't even slow you down. What secrets will await you in the foggy expanse of this failed star? Excitement? Danger? Maybe there's snacks? Explore some more You're definitely not just putting your mission off, you're charting new territory! It's time to face the elements with nothing but a high tech space suit and a healthy curiosity. Key Features Smooth platforming gameplay An interactive environment Procedual-ish storytelling A wholly unproductive time-sink Achievements, but you can do them later Space-beer
row.short_description: Stranded for unknown reasons in the lower orbit of a purple gas giant, you are kind of just chilling out. You should probably get on with your mission. There's still plenty of time, though.

row.name: ANYU
row.detailed_description: ANYU is a 3D third-person narrative exploration game, set in a frozen wasteland where an ancient civilization fell. Centered around movement puzzles and dealing with environment mechanics. Ikku will face an arctic world and must reach the top of the mountain to finally get a glimpse of the northern lights. During the journey, he will encounter some helpful friends and the remnants of an ancient civilization. Explore the frozen wasteland with your skis: Interact with the world to progress: Climb! This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: A 3D third person narrative exploration game, set in a frozen wasteland where an ancient civilization fell. Centered around movement puzzles and dealing with environment mechanics.

row.name: Cat-aclysm
row.detailed_description: In a peaceful rhythmic city run by music beats, lives a cat who is fed up with his owner constantly annoying him, and decides to run away from home, starting a revolution to take over the city. Vexa, desperate to hold Catuccino again, decides to follow him and get him back. Traverse the beautiful city while you interact with it! Get Catuccino back! Battle the evil robocats and save the city! This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology Europe - Bilbao and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: A 3D isometric action-adventure game where the player must use different abilities throughout the game to defeat enemies and solve puzzles.

row.name: Galactic Grinder
row.detailed_description: Galactic Grinder is a fast paced 2.5D side-scrolling skateboarding game, where the player skates through different planets while performing tricks to gain points to attain the best possible score. This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: Rider, skateboarder extraordinaire, is about to embark on a journey across the solar system after a catastrophic event sets him on a course to save us all.

row.name: MagicArchitect
row.detailed_description: ...Which character will you use to construct the magic? One Thousand and One Shooting! Choose magic to earn a living, nurture and master it, and earn money! You Can select magic and build! Let's enjoy this roguelike...... Furthermore, you can choose your character! Challenge yourself in a new world and try various combinations of magic. Defeat enemies and obtain orbs to enhance your abilities as an adventurer! With different characters and magic, players can customize their gameplay style. Each playthrough lasts only 3 minutes, allowing for trial and error! Now, dive into the world of magic and utilize your unique strategies and skills to become the ultimate sorcerer! A new adventure awaits!
row.short_description: One Thousand and One Shooting. Cultivate magic, sell it off, and make a profit! you can choose your character!

row.name: BlueSuburbia
row.detailed_description: BlueSuburbia is interactive poetry and literature. It is a haunted dreamscape where you explore poems through immersive environments. Wander through the world of poetry, seek out dark secrets, confront your demons, and delve deeper into a dream that dances between beautiful and terrible. Forgotten dreamscapes and open worlds are yours to explore as you venture on your quest to find hope in the darkness. BlueSuburbia is about struggle, survival, tenacity, strength, and hope... along with a healthy dose of existentialism. It is a commentary on strength and persistence despite the world trying to destroy you... the light you feel inside that does not let you give up, even when the world around you is at its darkest. It is a beautiful horror. Features include large open worlds to explore, with poetry and writing that you uncover in these haunted spaces. It is immersive literature. This is a reboot of the 1999 cult classic Flash website. It is currently under production. Regular updates to the demo will be released until it is finished.
row.short_description: BlueSuburbia is a haunted world where you explore poems through immersive environments. Seek out dark secrets, confront your demons, and delve deeper into a dream that dances between beautiful and terrible. Explore forgotten dreamscapes and open worlds on your quest to find hope.
row.reviews: “It's exciting and chilling all at the same time, as you never really know what you'll stumble across next. Walking through doors, clicking on words or otherwise discovering a new area initiates a short scene interspersed with text. They're all different, they're all a little breathtaking, and they're completely fascinating to watch.” Jay Is Games “It’s a mystifying, confusing, stunning and captivating game that does a great job of taking short form writing and placing it in environments that really elevate the experience. A powerful and poignant poetic experience well worth diving into.” Alpha Beta Gamer “BlueSuburbia takes you to a place that is filled with a lonely kind of menace – an oppressive fear that crushes you as it tells you that no one will come save you.” Indie Games Plus
row.notes: There is insinuation of violence and described violence in writing. This is a horror. Some of the themes will be unsettling and describing physical harm.

row.name: ikuzo
row.detailed_description: For players using the English version, I'm sorry that the F1 button help does not have an English version, so I will list the corresponding content in the following description A casual game designed to experience the feeling of winning or losing a real sword. The enemy and player are on the same starting line, and both sides use the same mechanism to play games. Without hard opponents, there is no high value, and both sides are completely fair in the game. This is a game that is difficult for ordinary players, and some players may find it relatively simple. However, it is stated in advance that before fully mastering the adversarial mechanism, you may feel a sense of frustration and must also learn combo methods from monsters during the process of death. Please think carefully before downloading. There are complex move release systems in the game, with a bit of Roguelike (random store) and a bit of growth system (random growth). For brave players who want to try this category of games for the first time, please be sure to drag to the bottom to watch the guide description, which can effectively improve your gaming experience! F1 is the help in the game, and the specific button operations can be directly viewed from the help interface. TAP can see the unlocked skills and button methods. F2 can take on BOSS challenges. The BOSS in the challenge level will be stronger than those in the main level, and it comes with superior (or inferior) environment scenarios. If you feel that the challenge is not enough, you can challenge the BOSS! After clearance, screenshots of the second level scene where the character is located can be sent to the customer service email. When a certain number of people pass, the content of the second level can be published as soon as possible. We will continue to update gameplay and levels, and add new combat methods and skill modules in the future. All bugs, feedback or suggestions related to the game can be sent to the customer service email and will be continuously optimized when available. If the frame drops, you can try to find a 'save point' nearby and restart the game to effectively alleviate the frame drop (not metaphysics, which is related to the optimization solution I am currently using). If it still cannot be solved, you can provide feedback on the area and configuration information where the screenshot is located, so that the author can confirm the areas with poor optimization. As long as someone plays the game, it has value, and earning or not is added value! So the game is free! Just have fun! ================================================================================================================= Suggestions for novice players 1. Dodge can interrupt any offensive or defensive behavior, which can quickly cancel your attack recovery 2. During an enemy attack, you can press and hold the right mouse button, and the character will automatically enter defense during the gap between enemy combo errors, interrupting the enemy combo (you are very confident in your own operation, and you can also use the enemy's actions to determine the defense timing and trigger precise defense) 3. Don't be impatient during the Footsies stage. If you make a mistake in the combo, please distance yourself as soon as possible 4. Don't face multiple enemies at the same time, don't turn your back on your enemies! 5. Do not engage in ineffective attacks during enemy defense, otherwise the enemy will dominate and counterattack during the attack gap! 6. The concept of combo is to keep the enemy in a state of being attacked and stagger continuously! When the enemy breaks away from the stagger, please judge it as a combo error 7. When the enemy is in stagnant air, the counterattack ability will be significantly reduced! 8. Enemies standing on the ground are subject to less buoyancy than those in the air. For example, when an enemy is hit on the ground, it can only rise by 2 meters, and when it is hit in the air, it can reach 4 meters 9. You can use the grappling hook to find treasure chests scattered in the scene, effectively improving your abilities Basic combo Left click * 4 → W+Right click → Left click * 2 → S+Right click → Left click * 2 → W+Right click Left * 3 → W+Right → Left * 3 → S+Right → Left * 2 → S+Right → Left * 2 → W+Right The above two types of combos can be used continuously, but the number of hits may fluctuate depending on the battle situation. If you can monitor the exact timing, the effect will be better ================================================================================================================= F1 content W. A, S, D: Move Left click: Normal attack Right click and long press: Defense Left shift: Run Left CTRL: Squat down Direction key+Q: Dodge TAB: Status bar CTRL+Z: Wait for 3 seconds before returning to the birth point, used to disengage from the stuck state R: Push back the enemy (with CD, it can also be used when attacked, and cooling monitoring can be seen in the lower left corner) F: Locking hook (needs to be unlocked) 1: Blood Bottle (remaining quantity displayed in the lower left corner, restores maximum health by 20% after use) E: Interacting with objects or Backstab (Backstab needs to be unlocked, press E when behind enemies to backstab) H: Optimize frame count (press again to cancel optimization) Falling or jumping state, press W when facing the wall: climbing the wall (needs to be unlocked)
