row.name: The Dark Climb
row.detailed_description: The Dark Climb is a resource-based, third-person stealth game set in a dark and dangerous world. Your objective is to navigate through the perilous environment and reach the shining gate at the end of everything. With limited sources of light available, you must rely on a personal light source to illuminate your immediate surroundings. However, this light source is directly tied to your in-game life and will deplete over time. If it runs out of energy, you will meet your demise. Fortunately, scattered throughout the world are safe-havens in the form of giant eyes, where you can replenish your light source. These havens are initially unlit, requiring you to discover and use scattered lanterns to illuminate them. By doing so, you gradually illuminate your path through the world. Beware of deadly flying eyes that also inhabit the map. Drawing their attention with your light will result in them attacking you and rapidly draining your energy. If you do attract their notice, your only means of escape is to temporarily seek refuge in the shadows. Effective energy management and stealthy, evasive gameplay are crucial to your success. Traversing the map is not without its challenges, as the darkness continually tears it apart, leaving a fractured environment adrift in an endless void. Your character possesses basic movement abilities such as walking and jumping to navigate this fragmented world. Moreover, The Dark Climb aims to provide a captivating audio-sensory experience. The fading energy supply and menacing inhabitants of the dark world are emphasized through immersive sound design. The safe-havens also contribute to this experience, offering a sense of relief whenever you can freely activate your light, even if you remain just a small glimmer lost in the eternal night.
row.short_description: The Dark Climb is a challenging, third person, resource-based, stealth game in which you try to reach the end of a dark and dangerous map. You are equipped with a light source, which is directly bound to your life in the game.

row.name: Bumper Arena
row.detailed_description: Bump your friends in a variety of mini-games Stand out from the competition by collecting as many points as possible before time runs out, and fight your way through overtime to settle any ties. Give everything you've got and get back on track, even if you've started with a loss! Play with up to 4 friends locally or remotely with Steam Remote Play Together Bumper Arena lets you enjoy the game experience locally or remotely with just one copy, thanks to Steam Remote Play Together. Only one player can use the keyboard, and the others will need controllers. Gather your friends and get ready to bounce! Balance your games and practice Having trouble gathering enough players? Don't panic! Complete your games with bots and enjoy mini-games in the best possible conditions. It's also a great way to practice. Choose the character and bumper car that suit you best. Express yourself by choosing your favorite character and vehicle, and challenge your opponents in style!
row.short_description: Buckle up! Bumper Arena is a party game in which you drive a bumper car through a series of arenas featuring different mini-games. Bump and bounce your opponents off the walls, earn the most points during the round and try to win the game!

row.name: 擱淺地 - Dream Antique
row.detailed_description: 「拼湊夢想的碎片，尋回最初的夢想」 請跟隨思彤的腳步與他人相遇並在擱淺地中一步步解開真相吧 究竟在最後等著她的會是怎樣的過往呢 神秘男子的真實身分又是...... 本遊戲是由國立臺北教育大學文創系四年級的學生打造 遊戲劇情採用文字小說作為主軸，再此基礎上加入2D橫向卷軸以及解謎要素的形式讓玩家進行探險 希望各位玩家都能追尋角色們的腳步尋回自己的初衷
row.short_description: 「拼湊夢想的碎片，尋回最初的夢想」 跟隨引路之人，一同解開貓咪失蹤之謎 2D橫向文字冒險遊戲「擱淺地 - dream antique」

row.name: The Stranded Traveler
row.detailed_description: Welcome to The Stranded Traveler! Embark on an epic journey in The Stranded Traveler, a 2D side-scrolling action-adventure game where you take on the role of a traveler stranded on a mysterious island. Explore dangerous environments, fight fierce enemies, and defeat challenging enemies as you make your way through the game's levels. With a retro-inspired art style and fast-paced hack-and-slash gameplay, The Stranded Traveler offers a challenging experience that's sure to appeal to fans of classic platformers. (Please note this game was made by a single developer in a small time-span) As you progress through the game, you'll uncover the truth behind the organization responsible for dooming Earth. With the fate of the world in your hands, you'll need to take down this powerful organization and restore the world to its former glory. Do you have what it takes to survive the challenges ahead and save humanity from certain doom? Only time will tell in The Stranded Traveler. What to do in The Stranded Traveler? Fight monsters, loot & sell items, Upgrade your character Figure out who created all these mysterious creatures on earth! Single-Player with Mini-Games within (Mini-Games described below) & Much more! Mini-Games 1. Ball Mini-Game, make sure you hit the balls in the right direction! 2. Legacy Space Shooter Mini-Game! Shoot the asteroids to make it out. 3. The Stranded Cafe: Gamble your hard earned coins for a change to win extra coin's & upgrade's Developed by DeadEagle, Published by Spitfire-Games™
row.short_description: Embark on an epic journey in The Stranded Traveler, a 2D side-scrolling action-adventure game where you take on the role of a traveler stranded on a mysterious island. Explore dangerous environments, fight fierce enemies, and defeat challenging bosses!

row.name: INVICTA: The Next Queen
row.detailed_description: INVICTA: The Next Queen is a TopDown Soulslike game where a legendary warrior must fight her way through hell and claim her soul once more. Take the role of Moma as you explore the labyrinthian dungeons that make up the Circle of Greed and defeat King Midas in single combat. Welcome to the 4th layer of Hell, realm of the greedy and the corrupt. Play as a fallen warrior of legend, hell bent on getting her soul back from the demons that took it. Rip and tear through the armies of King Midas, and put an end to the Reign of Gold. Will you be able to take the crown? Do you have what it takes to claim the throne of Hell? Force your way open in 5 zones under the rule of Midas and his commanders. Discover secrets, fight enemies and teach them who will be the Next Queen of hell. Embrace the chaos and break everything you can, you might even discover something interesting! Beat Midas and all of his commanders in a face to face fight that will be written in the books of hell. Synopsis In life she was the most powerful woman to ever roam the earth. The mere uttering of her name made the mightiest warriors run in fear. Priests worshiped the dirt she walked on, and kings gave up their crowns before engaging her in battle. And yet, she fell. A single arrow pierced her heart, and plunged her into the depths of Hell. Moma, The Endless Warrior, was no more. In her fall, The Lords of the Seven Circles, the rulers of the underworld, decided to split her soul. They would shatter it, and spread its pieces all over Hell, in an attempt to weaken Moma and keep her from conquering the kingdom of the dead. Taking it back, becoming whole again, would be a quest impossible for any mortal. But she is no mere mortal. Now Moma, armed with self-righteous anger and her blade, has a single thing on her mind. Defeat the Lords of the Seven Circles and become The Next Queen of Hell.
row.short_description: INVICTA: The Next Queen is a TopDown Soulslike game where a legendary warrior must fight her way through hell and claim her soul once more. Take the role of Moma as you explore the labyrinthian dungeons that make up the Circle of Greed and defeat King Midas in single combat.

row.name: Born to Rise
row.detailed_description: In the depths of a long-forgotten city, amidst the ruins, lies the remnants of a malevolent Archonist, whose sadistic pursuits have claimed countless lives in the relentless pursuit of perfection. Prepare to embark on an extraordinary quest as you assume the role of Yridis, immersing yourself in this subterranean realm. Unveil the purpose of your existence, reclaim your lost memories, and expose the enigmatic Archonist. Introducing 'Born To Rise,' an awe-inspiring 2.5D action-adventure platformer set within a mesmerizing underworld. Journey through treacherous acidic ruins, ancient cities steeped in history, and labyrinthine dungeons that seemingly stretch on endlessly. Engage in intense battles against corrupted creatures, unwitting pawns bound to serve their creator's nefarious whims. Immerse yourself in a captivating narrative that will unravel the true significance of your odyssey, while delving deep into the enigma surrounding the identity of the Archonist. Prepare to ascend to new heights as you unveil the secrets that lie within, confronting formidable challenges, and unearthing the ultimate truth that awaits in 'Born To Rise' . Travel through 3 different levels: Discover new locations, enemies and hazards while the Archonist laughs at your failures. Complete each zone as fast as you can and overcome the three strenuous challenges that will determine Yridis’ future. Explore: Investigate and discover every corner and secrets of The Undergrounds The Three Labors: Complete each level as fast as you can and overcome the three strenuous challenges that will determine Yridis’ future.
row.short_description: To complete Yridis' mission, you'll have to make your way through the bowels of a vast underground dungeon filled with unique environments, deadly dangers and mysterious beings. Jump, dash and give the enemies you encounter their due thanks to powerful weapons.

row.name: ANDARA: RISE FOR REBELLION
row.detailed_description: Get immersed in a short but intense single-player campaign in this frenetic third-person shooter taking inspiration from arcade titles such as Returnal and DOOM. Rise for Rebellion Hailstone’s invasion, the plundering of its natural resources, and the killing of its natives has been the last straw for Andara. The cruelty of her father has reached an all-time high, alongside his command capacity, and Andara is the only one who can stop him this time around. It is time for the heiress of the Ethadian Empire to rise and fight against Ordon’s army, to reclaim what’s just. Fear, pain and death are prices worth-paying, if only to stop her tyrannical father once and for all. Loaded and Cyber-implanted The hyper-advanced technology that has helped the oppressors crush the people of Hailstone might just also be their downfall. As Andara, make use of your incredible powers and movement capabilities to breeze into combat, cast powerful blasts of energy, finish enemies and even slow down time. Special Forces Nobody said it was going to be easy. Each enemy will have their own behavior, strengths and weaknesses. Special soldiers like the Charger or the Deadeye will pose a formidable challenge, so fight them all as you’re supposed to - constantly moving, aiming for their weak spots and making full use of both your weapons and your whole repertoire of skills. Extended Synopsis Ethadians are running out of natural resources. Their home planet will soon stop supporting their hyper-technological way of life. ‘If Ethadians wish to live, they are forced to conquer’, says supreme commander Ordon to his people. In his mind is Hailstone, a nearby planet where the mining resources are plentiful and the natives are a much less advanced society. ‘They won’t stand a chance’, Ordon anticipates. He is right, of course. Ethadians conquer Hailstone in a breeze. They subdue the natives, killing those who dare to resist and capturing the rest of them. Ordon and his troops set outposts and advanced mining stations all over the rocky planet. They build the huge Central Tower and set up the servers that control their cyber-implants inside it. Ordon’s thirst for expansion won’t end here – Hailstone will only be the first of many planets to be vanquished by the Ethadians. Or is it? Ordon finds opposition where he least expected it. How could Andara, her own daughter, rebel against him? It was a mistake to bring her with him, thinking that their broken relationship could be mended. Andara has escaped her designated outpost on Hailstone. Aided by G1TH, her companion AI, she is now close to destroying the last generator that shields the Central Tower. She is trained, cyber-implanted and – most importantly – ready to do almost anything to stop her father’s iniquitous plans. Key features Engage in fast-paced combat against varied enemies. Explore Hailstone while completing puzzles and platforming sections. Watch Andara’s rebellion against her own father unfold.
row.short_description: Ordon’s armies have invaded Hailstone and are plundering their resources. Become Andara, the tyrant’s daughter, in this frenetic third-person shooter. Engage enemy weak points and move fast in a brief yet intense single-player campaign. Rise for rebellion.

row.name: NightSpawn
row.detailed_description: Immerse yourself in NightSpawn, a heart-pounding multiplayer horror experience playable in first-person or third-person perspective. Join the enigmatic Hollowgate Society—a group of investigators dedicated to uncovering the truth behind the paranormal—and gather your courage to face unimaginable terrors. Collaborate with up to three friends in this escape room-style adventure, or dive into thrilling PvP gameplay that will test your wits and survival instincts. As investigators, you and your team find yourselves trapped in a nightmarish location. To survive, you'll need to scavenge for essential tools, solve intricate puzzles, and cleverly use your resources—all while relentlessly pursued by monstrous entities. Choose your approach wisely. The items you discover can have multiple uses, you must decide how best to use them. Keep on the lookout for ways to open up (or close off) locations around you. A fuse box could restore power and unlock a keypad -  or could be disabled to bypass hazardous electrical traps. Your decisions directly shape your chances of survival. Join the Hollowgate (Story Mode - Upcoming): Follow the lore of NightSpawn and step into the shoes of an investigator for the Hollowgate society. Be courageous (Single Player): Face the horrors of NightSpawn alone and fight to escape the very bowels of hell. Escape the Nightmare (PvE) : Work together with three other players to evade deadly AI-driven monstrosities and escape each haunting location. Competitive Versus Mode (2v2 PvP) : Face off against rival investigators in a tense, competitive environment that demands strategic cooperation and cunning. Play as the Monster (Upcoming) : Step into the shoes of terrifying creatures, turning the tables on investigators in this spine-chilling future mode. Can you survive the horrors of NightSpawn, or will you become another victim to the darkness? Build Your Character: Choose your character wisely! Each investigator specialises in a unique piece of equipment that can turn the tide in your bid for escape.  Perks: Customise your characters to your playstyle with perks. As your favourite investigators get more experienced, they’ll unlock dozens of perks and hundreds of potential builds which give them an extra edge. Relentless NightSpawn Monsters: The monsters of NightSpawn are merciless. Each location the Hollowgate Society investigators discover is host to its own nightmare creature. Inspired by legend, pop culture and horror classics - every creature is unyielding in its hunt for you. Lock In: Your speed and skills will contribute to your overall score at the end of each game. Take on the leaderboards and forge a way to the top. Tailored Thrills & Custom Challenges: Take on the horror at escalating levels of difficulty. Alternatively, make your game bespoke with customisable difficulty settings. Keep an eye out for converted Tarot cards, which can be played in subsequent matches, enabling bonus challenges and offering extra rewards. Prepare yourself—NightSpawn awaits. Will you unravel the truth or succumb to eternal darkness? WARNING: PHOTOSENSITIVITY/EPILEPSY SEIZURES - READ THIS NOTICE BEFORE PLAYING A very small percentage of people may experience epileptic seizures or blackouts when exposed to certain kinds of flashing lights or light patterns. These persons, or even people who have no history of seizures or epilepsy, may experience epileptic symptoms or seizures while playing video games. If you or any of your relatives has an epileptic condition or has had seizures of any kind, consult your physician before playing any video game. IMMEDIATELY DISCONTINUE use and consult a physician if you or your child experience any of the following symptoms: dizziness, altered vision, eye or muscle twitching, involuntary movements, loss of awareness, disorientation, or convulsions. Parents should watch for or ask their children about the above symptoms. You may reduce risk of photosensitive epileptic seizures by taking the following precautions: sit farther from the screen, use a smaller screen, play in a well-lit room, do not play when you are drowsy or fatigued.
row.short_description: NightSpawn is a high-stakes, escape-room inspired horror experience. Your mission: find a way out. In Single player or co-op play, team up with friends to break out. Work together to solve puzzles, uncover clues and find a way out - before the monsters find you.
row.notes: Scenes of mutilation or maiming and severe damage to the human body, depiction of blood and violent assaults to human characters.

row.name: Luffi: Homebound
row.detailed_description: Luffi is returning home after studying abroad at Hartfer's Art Academy. Explore vibrant locations and fill your art journal with a collection of memories and discoveries on your journey. Relax and enjoy a wholesome cozy experience with playful characters on their own journeys through life. A lived in world Explore organic locations on your way home. Get lost in the forest burrows, enjoy a treetop tour, explore the nightstone caves. Enjoy the fireworks at Hartfer village, relax in the hot springs on snowy summit or hit the slopes with your snowboard. Each location is filled with life, personality and unique characters to make the world feel alive. Build Relationships On your journey, encounter other characters and learn about them. Watch them travel and experience their own adventure alongside yours. Reminisence about Luffi's past and relationship with his parents, and what it means to finally come home. Each helpful deed is rewarded via stickers to collect! Fill in your journal Each time Luffi finds something new he records it in his journal of memories to share with his family after the adventure is complete. All memories are hand drawn, as Luffi showcases his newfound skills from art school. Musical Vibes Indulge yourself in a lovely soundtrack scored with a sentimental soul from the very talented Epoch Music duo. Game Length Expect a short game roughly 2 hours, filled to the brim with sentimental and cozy vibes. There is no combat and the game features a stress-free environment to relax and enjoy at your own pace.
row.short_description: Luffi is returning home from time away at Hartfer's Art Academy. Explore, collect memories and make new friends along the way! Relax and enjoy a wholesome cozy experience as you journey home.

row.name: Ciudad Alfombra
row.detailed_description: Description: In this game, you are a mini car that navigates through a city, collecting coins, unlocking cars, and completing missions. Controls: You need to click on all the obstacles on the road to deactivate or interact with them. To avoid pedestrians, you should tap the 'Beep Beep' horn button located in the bottom left corner. Content: There is a shop where you can purchase upgrades such as turbos and different types of cars, like MiniVans and large buses. There are primary and secondary missions available, which, upon completion, will reward you with more coins.
row.short_description: In this game, you must dodge the obstacles in the city and complete the missions available. There is a wide variety of vehicles and colors, such as minivans and large buses.

row.name: Mage Mayhem
row.detailed_description: Fight your alongside or against your friends with PvP and PvE Roguelike game modes! Choose from eight unique classes, Pyromancer, Ice Magus, Grave Warden, Druid, Trapper, Pirate Captain, Assassin, and Paladin, each with its own distinct playstyle and abilities. Pick 4 abilities from each class's selection, each containing at least 5 or more options to pick from! Head into the PvE roguelike arena to challenge deadly foes and gain numerous upgrades to create a distinct build! In PvP, suit your preferred combat style with 12 perks to be a ranger, a mini mage, and much more. Engage in up to 4v4 battles across multiple game modes and maps with your friends and prove you are the craziest mage of them all. Fight against powerful enemies! Or against your friends Customize your character to suit your playstyle!
row.short_description: Mage Mayhem is a roguelike featuring unique magic with hundreds of different styles to explore. Customize your experience through a variety of abilities and upgrades. Enjoy alongside your friends, then battle them in various other PvP game modes.

row.name: Romance Club - Stories I Play
row.detailed_description: Become a character in a story you’ll love! The choice is yours: Pick your own look and style. Romance: Cute or Sexy? Bold or Shy? Guy or Girl? What happens next? Every story has multiple endings! Fantasy, drama, supernatural, horror, adventure, and more. Dozens of original stories with more to come. Which story will you try first? DRACULA: A LOVE STORY : Experience a whirlwind romance spanning centuries: palace secrets of the Ottoman Empire, love and loathing at the royal court, and friends and enemies whose lives span an eternity… HEAVEN'S SECRET : You died and went to... the Angels and Demons Academy? Devilish lecturers, angelic sweethearts, and the temptation to break Heaven's rules—what else awaits you in this dangerous, fantastical afterlife? CHASING YOU : When a routine family get-together becomes a murder scene, the race is on to find the culprit and stay out of jail! HEART OF TRESPIA : Today, you ascend the throne of Trespia. But all is not as it seems. Embark on a journey of danger, love, and betrayal, discover the truth, and save your kingdom! LEGEND OF THE WILLOW : On the eve of your initiation as a geisha, you discover a supernatural secret that changes everything. Now, you’re on the run, and not only from humans. GLADIATOR CHRONICLES : Forced into slavery by the intergalactic empire of New Rome, a young gladiator’s fate hangs in the balance. Can you rise to the challenge and make the empire bow before you? ...PLUS more new stories and episodes coming soon! ABOUT US Your Story Interactive is an independent game studio located in Chisinau, the capital of Moldova. Stories are our passion and storytelling is what we do. Our games are free! If you like romantic stories with choices, graphic novels, and cute characters, you'll love our games!
row.short_description: Immerse yourself in romantic visual stories where you control what happens!
row.notes: Romance Club contains occasional references to alcoholism, self harm, and suicidal tendencies. These topics usually involve only minor characters. One story follows a heroine with a traumatic past who overcomes an addiction to illegal drugs. Her story includes depictions of attempted sexual coercion occurring in the past, some of which can be bypassed by choice. Some stories include violent or sexual content. Sensitive topics are, as much as possible, approached in ways to make them suitable for the public aged 16+. All the events in the novels are fiction, and Romance Club doesn't condone using drugs and advises readers to maintain a healthy lifestyle.

row.name: Unsorted Horror
row.detailed_description: UNSORTED HORROR is a collection of 5 short first-person horror games, that revolve around detailed machinery in a dark dystopian setting. The majority of the games have a playtime of roughly 10-15 minutes and can be played through in one sitting. Choose a CD case, read the backside, and go on a small adventure. THE GAMES: 1. Tartarus Engine - A group of plucky technicians exploit an ancient machine's seemingly untapped vulnerability. 2. The Other Side - Operate a jury-rigged drill to secretly escape a corrupt bunker. 3. Control Room Alpha - Pull data from a nest of spiders. 4. Carbon Steel - Perform hazardous research in an abandoned facility. 5. Concrete Tremor - A game revolving around plastic explosives and soviet apartment buildings.
row.short_description: A collection of 5 short first-person horror games, that revolve around detailed machinery and dread.
row.reviews: “In anthology games you usually get at least one dud, but not in the case of Unsorted Horror. Each one is a 15 minute gem with a dark Sci-Fi story to tell. The world-building is particularly impressive, with each game managing to really immerse you in their worlds within their brief play times. Highly recommended.” Alpha Beta Gamer
row.notes: Strong horror themes and violence.

row.name: Fall of the stick knights
row.detailed_description: Fall of the Stick Knights is a local multiplayer game designed to play with friends. It features physics-based character controls, supports 1 to 4 players, includes AI enemies, and offers a deck-building system that permanently alters your stats. FOSK is my first game , which I created for fun and to learn programming. It's heavily unfinished, but I believe playing with friends can still be an enjoyable experience. Why did I publish it on Steam? When I made this game, I was 16, and I simply wanted to release a game on Steam. (the release date is 19.02.2025, but this game was in early access for about two years.) Features: -Character editor -Over 40 different weapons -Over 90 unique maps -'Deck-building' cards -Local multiplayer -Controller and keyboard support -Ton of bugs and imperfections I hope you have a great time playing it with your friends!
row.short_description: Fall of the stick knights is based on physics-controlled characters to play with friends up to 4 people. The game features has skin customization, nice fun hook mechanic and the clumsy characters, providing a lot of fun.

row.name: 我是大房东
row.detailed_description: This is a game I've developed in my spare time, and it's not yet complete. There are still many bugs and incomplete parts. If you have any suggestions while experiencing it, feel free to let me know, and I'll keep updating it. What would you build if you owned a plot of land? In 'I Am The Landlord,' you'll play as a landlord who owns an apartment building in the city center, starting from an empty plot and using your design skills and creativity to construct unique apartments. Welcome to 'I Am The Landlord'! In this creatively rich home-building game, you'll play as a landlord who owns an apartment building in the city center, using your design talents and creativity to construct unique homes. Once the game begins, you'll find yourself on an empty plot with a certain amount of construction funds. Your task is to use these funds to design and build various styles of homes, including luxury villas, trendy apartments, traditional country cottages, and more. In 'I Am The Landlord,' you'll have absolute creative freedom. From the foundation to the roof, you can choose different materials, colors, and exterior styles to create unique and charming buildings. You can design spacious living rooms, cozy bedrooms, modern kitchens, and stunning outdoor spaces. Every detail will showcase your design vision and personal style. In addition to architectural design, you can also carefully furnish the interiors of the homes. Choose the right furniture, decorations, and color schemes to make each room warm and full of personality. You can create comfortable lounging areas, fully functional workspaces, and delightful entertainment spaces to meet the various needs of tenants. In 'I Am The Landlord,' you can build multiple homes, continuously expanding your apartment space. Each home will become your work of art and creative showcase. Once you've finished building the homes, you can rent them out to tenants. Tenants will decide whether to rent based on the quality, amenities, and location of the homes. You can set reasonable rents and provide attractive leasing terms to attract more tenants. Are you ready to unleash your architectural talents? Join 'I Am The Landlord' now, explore the joys of building, create your dream homes, and become a sought-after master builder!
row.short_description: If you had a plot of land, what would you build on it? In 'I Am The Landlord,' you'll play as a landlord who owns an apartment building in the city center, starting from an empty plot and using your design skills and creativity to construct unique apartments.

row.name: Death Roads: Tournament Prologue
row.detailed_description: You'll take control of Maggie 'Liberty' Murdock and her car, navigating through two different routes filled with a variety of enemies. You'll also have access to numerous car components and cards, providing you with the resources to upgrade and enhance your vehicle's performance. Experience road events and utilize an arsenal of gadgets to gain the upper hand. This is just the start of your journey into the world of Death Roads: Tournament. Prior to embarking on your destructive spree, carefully select your driver and their vehicle. Your initial card set will accompany your chosen ride. Next, opt for a sponsor who will dictate your initial location on the map. Exercise caution when making this decision, as alterations will not be possible once chosen! Cards serve a purpose beyond merely unleashing gunfire upon fellow vehicles. Utilize them to navigate the game board strategically and secure advantageous positions. Employ clever tactics to evade obstacles and steer clear of being forcefully displaced. Alternatively, adopt a more aggressive approach by intentionally colliding with your opponents! Don't forget to adjust your gears as you drive. The higher the gear, the more potent your cards become, but the risk of skidding also intensifies. Master the art of leveraging this mechanic to your benefit. Through practice, you can skillfully skid your way to victory! Acquire car components from defeated adversaries and incorporate them into your vehicle to acquire diverse cards! Experiment with fresh weaponry, engines, and wheels to catch your rivals off guard and enhance your chances of victory. Assemble a complete deck to unleash lethal combinations. Every battle pushes you nearer to triumph in the relentless race of Death Roads. Maintain momentum and surge ahead, for victory, can swiftly slip away. In the event of failure, be prepared to embark on your journey anew. However, take solace in that any accomplishments and rewards earned along the way remain permanently yours. Master turn-based battles with road events. Unlock various cars and characters with special weapons. Build card decks based on swapping around car parts. Progress across a nonlinear world map. Vibe with stylized graphics reflecting a thrilling race.
row.short_description: Experience unprecedented car battles by merging the thrill of deadly racing, the strategic depth of deckbuilding, and the unpredictable nature of roguelite gameplay. Select a skilled driver, a powerful vehicle, an arsenal of weapons, and supportive sponsors to conquer tactical challenges.

row.name: Pinpoint
row.detailed_description: Pinpoint is a free and open source tool for neuroscientists that supports interactive planning of electrophysiology experiments. Pinpoint supports the entire planning process: selecting target brain areas in 3D, exploring possible probe trajectories through intuitive keyboard or click+drag interactions, automatic calculation of stereotaxic coordinates for surgery, and detection of possible collisions with rig hardware. For advanced users, Pinpoint also includes an API For communicating with OpenEphys and SpikeGLX as well as with Sensapex and New Scale hardware, please see the documentation for details. Pinpoint currently supports the Allen CCF atlas and runs on Windows and Linux (through Steam) as well as in your web browser. As a community-driven project we hope you will report back about what you find useful and frustrating so that we can make changes in the future. Please use the issues page on Github for this purpose. Please note that your citations are critical for making it possible to get grant funding for Pinpoint in the future. You can cite Pinpoint as as 'Birman, D., Yang, K. J., Steinmetz, N. A. (2023). Pinpoint: multi-probe trajectory planning for electrophysiology using an interactive web-based 3D environment. Zenodo'
row.short_description: Multi-probe trajectory planning for neuroscience in an intuitive and interactive 3D environment.

row.name: BLACK BOX LSS - The Shining Immortal
row.detailed_description: ❤ 【Game Overview】 ❤ Immerse yourself in a heart-pounding, romantic visual novel where you play the role of a new recruit, just a month into your job, pursuing your female boss. Set against the backdrop of a futuristic sci-fi world, this short narrative is part of a vast universe. Beautifully illustrated in pixel art, and a riveting soundtrack that sets the mood for this love story. The game's rich dialogue and introspective monologues are presented in a simple and easily understood manner. ❤ 【Characters】 ❤
row.short_description: Immerse yourself in a pixel-art visual novel that blends thrilling crime, romantic comedy, and the pursuit of love. This game depicts the story of a new employee pursuing his female boss.
row.notes: The game includes violence, crime, torture, sexual innuendo, and sexual fantasies. It is not suitable for underage players.

row.name: King of Silence - Prologue
row.detailed_description: Every noise has a consequence you don't want to know about. Hold your breath and immerse yourself in King Of Silence, a horrific experience where the strange, the paranoïa and the frightening are combined. Story It was the last Sunday of the summer vacations, and my friends and I had spent the whole day at the beach. As usual, on the way home, we passed this building, which looks like an old religious temple. Everyone thinks it's haunted, so we never venture too close. Deep down, I know there's something wrong with this place. Many people in the village say that something or someone has been living there for centuries, and doesn't like the noise. Play as a child locked up in this old abandoned building where lives the King of Silence, a demon that hates noises. Don't panic, stay calm and above all, do not make any noises, because the more you'll do it, the more the King will free himself. Gameplay In King of Silence, the only tool you have is your flashlight. To get through the game you will have to explore, light up and interact with your environment while avoiding making noise. You also have a sanity system, which may or may not decrease depending on how you behave in a situation. This sanity will change your experience and its conclusion. Be careful. Key Features - A heavy and distressing atmosphere - A terrifying demon - Immersive sound design - A flashlight that might come in handy Environment The game takes place in an old religious temple that has been abandoned. No one knows what could have happened here or what religion was practised here. Walk through this place, explore it, and you may learn a little more about its origin and the entity that occupies it.
row.short_description: Embark on a chilling journey in King of Silence, a first-person horror game where silence is survival. Trapped in a dark, abandoned temple, you must quietly uncover its secrets and the eerie legend of the King of Silence to find your escape. Make a sound, and it may be your last.
row.notes: This game may include content that is not appropriate for all ages or for workplace use: frequent violence or gore, generic adult content, etc.

row.name: Antipsychotic
row.detailed_description: Antipsychotic is back on Steam Antipsychotic is back on the Steam store with new updates. It now includes a new introduction sequence and a new area within its world. Antipsychotic now supports DLSS, which is activated via its in-game menu by pressing Escape. The game is now free for all to play in the hopes this experience will spread mental health awareness. If you already purchased Antipsychotic when it was 99¢ (USD), please contact me for a refund and I will happily oblige.  Enjoy this free & updated experience! About the Game Antipsychotic is an eccentric art game experience. It is not a traditional video game . This is a short, abstract art game about mental health. 10 - 15 minutes playtime, nonlinear free roam. Dive into the mind of someone with bipolar disorder as they explore their condition. This immersive experience marries poetic reflections and personal narratives with captivating audio-reactive visuals and evocative soundscapes, set to the beat of poignant music. row.name: Space Mutants
row.detailed_description: Your name is Arlo, Arlo P. Barnaby. You and a crew of sixty other Miners are sent out to the outer reaches of the solar system and stationed on an obscure desolate moon for the next six months to mine for valuable moon rock deposits. While mining, you and your crew unearths an ancient evil and it awakens to wreaks havoc upon the living! Scared and alone you barricade yourself inside of your living quarters and hide from the evil for days. When you realize it is either you make an escape attempt or wait to die, that is when you venture out into the abyss of evil to save yourself! * Single Player-Action-2D Platformer! * Reminiscent of those games that used to be played on those 8 bit consoles of yesteryear! * Three different weapons to utilize! (blast rifle, bolt shot, super missile) * Nine different levels, featuring six different boss fights! * One epic escape attempt!!!!! ***For best playing experience use wired-USB, NES style controller!!!! You can also use the keyboard, but I highly recommend a NES style controller. For some reason XBOX and PlayStation type controllers with a lot of different buttons doesn't map out correctly. Feel free to experiment though!!! ***Also game might not play in 'Full Screen' mode. You might have to play it in 'Windowed' mode. Then just maximize the window to fill your monitor's screen.

Originally a beloved children's TV character, Mr Snotty turned violent after being chased out of the local TV station along with all of his friends into an abandoned sewer. Unfortunately for you, you are now trapped there too! Search for the 10 hidden buttons throughout the sewer that unlock the door to escape the nightmare! With Mr Snotty and his friends roaming the abandoned sewer, you need to search every corner of the sewer for the hidden buttons. However, if they see you or hear you they will hunt you down and turn you into one of their new friends! Littered around the sewer are items that have travelled down the pipes from above. Use them to light your way, recharge a flashlight or even unlock hidden shortcuts in the sewer. Press the buttons, collect the items and unlock the escape. row.name: Astra Hunter Zosma
row.detailed_description: The secrets and treasures of ancient civilizations have long eluded the Astra Hunters: a guild of explorers-for-hire tasked with uncovering the world's greatest riches. And Zosma is the greatest Astra Hunter of them all! Or at least he wishes, were he not ranked dead last as always. What seems like a routine attempt to uncover more about Zosma's favorite adventuring ground becomes the beginning of a grand adventure as he plummets for miles to what should have been certain death! With no way up back to the surface except through the daunting Crescent Moon Tower, Zosma may just find his greatest discoveries ever... and get some help from a mysterious animal companion along the way! Unleash the power of teamwork, collect valuables, and solve the mystery of the Crescent Moon Tower in this RPG adventure! Astra Hunter Zosma is a short treasure-hunting RPG with a focus on dungeon exploration and a blossoming friendship between a buddy duo! Collect treasure as you climb the Crescent Moon Tower to help make Zosma the greatest Astra Hunter upon his return home! An RPG adventure with many special treasures to collect! Classic turn-based combat that you know and love. A combo-based battle system: Zosma can act multiple times per turn and chain abilities together to steadily increase their power, and even increase the effects of items. A companion helper with a customizable move set. Give your buddy a boost in battle by feeding them yummy treats! Equip class-inspired Sigils such as Warrior, Cleric, and more to change what moves Zosma has at his disposal. Discover and unleash powerful Astra abilities with the help of your companion! An optional dungeon that continuously expands as the story progresses. Dive deep to find even greater challenges and treasure to collect! Fully custom sound and visuals, and a stellar custom soundtrack!
row.short_description: A treasure-hunting RPG with a lifelong friend! Escape the Crescent Moon Tower and return to the surface world... and grab lots of treasure on the way!

row.detailed_description: Deviniva is a first-person retro shooter set in a dystopian nonsensical city. You are a rogue AI, beamed into a human body and set to take revenge on a mega-corp. Features Timed level runs: Start, Run, Die, Start again. Your best time is saved. Collectables: Find items hidden in the world. Advanced Movement: Jump, Dash, and hover your way through levels. Crouch and lean around corners to optimize runs and combat. Versions before Devinica 2.0 can be accessed in-game via the 'Launch legacy' option. Achievements specific to this version can still be earned but pre 2.0 versions of Devinica will not longer be supported.
row.short_description: A corporate artificial intelligence simulator.
row.notes: Lo-Fi Depictions of violence. This game is not recommended for those with photosensitive epilepsy.

row.name: Reaper's Isle
row.detailed_description: REAPER'S ISLE is an open-world, stealth horror game created by a team of students at UW-Stout and Berklee College of Music. You receive a concerning message from your daughter, a paleontologist stationed on a remote island. After making your way to the isle, you discover horrifying phantoms from the ancient world. Restore power across the map to gain access to the main laboratory where you’ll discover the fate of your missing daughter. EVADE Avoid phantom monsters while solving basic puzzles to restore power across the island at watchtowers. By hiding in bushes, or tall grass and moving carefully, you can avoid confrontation. Throw rocks to distract and maneuver skillfully around the phantoms. You must be cautious, as the phantoms will absorb your soul if they touch you, causing you to restart at your last checkpoint. DISCOVER Explore the open world environment in first-person perspective. Study plants and creatures to uncover their mysterious origins and behavioral traits to help you survive. Discover logs and signs of former destruction to uncover secrets about the prior island's inhabitants. UNCOVER Finally, after restoring power, venture into the lab in the island's depths where you’ll discover the fate of your missing daughter.
row.short_description: The ancient island beckons in this open-world, stealth horror game. Search for your missing daughter while avoiding dangerous phantom creatures. Restore power across the island to access the lab in the island's depths where you’ll discover the fate of your missing daughter.

row.name: Phantom of Zana
row.detailed_description: Trouble has fallen upon King Joy. The Prince, his only heir, has been kidnapped. But that's not all, The Queen has also been transformed! The mysterious villain that is responsible for these nefarious acts was last seen heading into the wildlands of Zana. Play as Fantastic Fania and track down this elusive agent of chaos, rescue The Prince, save The Queen and save the day! Gain new abilities and power ups along the way. Including but not limited to: -A grappling hook. -Special attacks and acrobatic skills. -Healing Potions! Conquer 13 levels. Among these are 2 top down shooter levels, because sometimes flying through the air with a jetpack is exactly what's needed.
row.short_description: Swing, dash, slide and slice your way through this retro style 2D side scrolling platformer! Blast, hack and slash your opponents or bounce off their heads! Power up Fantastic Fania to finally confront the Phantom of Zana!

row.name: Parfum Nostalgique: Full Bloom Edition
row.detailed_description: What possessed God to trap a teenage girl into a 265-year-old man's body? You wake up late , sleep when you please, and nothing can come between you and cake. You love stuffed animals because you can kiss them until they're worn, and fix them when they're torn. You love fashion and makeup and shiny, red nails. It's as if this whole city exists watch you dress up and play pretend. It's wonderful. You live without shame. But can you love without shame as well...? Is it so scary to be in love, at your big age? Parfum Nostalgique is a kinetic visual novel that details a small but eventful window of time in the life of 265 year-old therapist-by-day, dom-by-night vampire, Valdemar Andressen. Slip into the platform boots of an already too tall 265-year-old therapist-by-day, dom-by-night vampire as he navigates the complexities of love, sex, friendship, the consequences of his actions, confronting his own mortality, the fragility of existence on a floating rock in the endless sea of space, and other lighthearted everyday challenges that come from centuries of life experience. A heartfelt tale about the people who change us, for better and for worse. From betrayal to unconditional love, from regret to hope, see the drama unfold between old friends, new friends, exes, and lovers when you dive into this kinetic visual novel dram-com series. With delicate vintage shoujo- inspired art, original soundtrack, and a diverse cast of voice actors, Parfum Nostalgique is a lovingly handmade passion project packaged with sweets and scented with roses by sole developer Prince Rosalium for your reading pleasure.
row.short_description: The fantastic, dramatic, romantic, traumatic memoirs of New York City's own 265-year-old therapist-by-day, dom-by-night vampire.
row.notes: Discussion of suicide and terminal illness, depictions of consensual BDSM-related sexual content, crude sexual themes.

row.name: Grand Escape
row.detailed_description: 'Run away!' Hello, this is developer Kim Ju-im from 'Busy age with many games, but little time' offering assistance. Today, I would like to introduce a special game, the 'Grand Escape' game, which I confidently recommend to those who want a simple yet thrilling game. Do you find new games too complicated? Are the entry barriers too high? If so, the Grand Escape is the solution for you. The Grand Escape is a game that offers simple gameplay with an immersive experience. Have you ever wanted to steal jewels? Or perhaps you've wanted to run from the police to feel the thrill of life? Don't worry, we understand that you may have many games but little time. That's why we offer a short and concise game that you can enjoy. Are you tired of digging for diamonds? Do you want diamonds instead of bronze? Whatever you want, we have it in the Grand Escape. The game has simple controls with an easy-to-understand dot graphic that won't hurt your eyes. The police offer an exciting chase for you while jewels are scattered on the ground. The goal is to escape, and you can enjoy the game with short and concise gameplay. The Grand Escape is a game where you steal jewels without getting caught by the police. With simple controls and easy-to-understand dot graphics, it offers an enjoyable experience. The game features jewels scattered on the ground and thrilling chases from the police. You can also enjoy the game with the goal of escaping. With short and concise gameplay, it's easy for everyone to enjoy. You have to collect jewels and escape from the police. Always think of an escape route and move! Features: - Intuitive dot graphics. - Thrilling experience with easy controls.

row.name: Reformpunk重組叛客
row.detailed_description: This is a co-op puzzle game centered around time control and object manipulation. The abandoned reassembling laboratory is experiencing anomalies, with space and time being distorted. Players will take on the roles of the missing person, Sophia , and the investigator, Thirteen , as they together uncover the secrets of the laboratory. Please note that this game requires both a keyboard and a gamepad to play. Game Features The game design revolves around 'character abilities' and 'alterations'. Both players must utilize each other's abilities to cooperate and use objects in the levels to help each other progress. The levels' complexity and enjoyment will increase as the game progresses, allowing players to experience the game design centered around 'alterations'. Cooperative level design for two players, using remote multiplayer to invite friends to play together and experience levels and puzzles specifically designed for cooperative play, testing their synergy and cooperation. Character Abilities Player 1, Sofia , has the ability to control time and manipulate recorded events, serving as the logical puzzle solver. Player 2, Thirteen , can alter objects using their energy, turning special materials into ghostly states, and even transforming themselves into energy to access unique abilities.

row.name: LandFall Survival
row.detailed_description: Landfall is an exhilarating cooperative survival extraction game set in a vibrant low-poly world, where every decision counts and every moment is a test of your skills. Immerse yourself in a gameplay experience designed to be accessible to players of all skill levels. Dive into Dynamic Maps: Your mission is clear—survive, loot, and escape from perilous foes in diverse environments. Engage in thrilling encounters with soldiers and zombies, each presenting unique challenges. Experience Fluid Parkour Gameplay! Leap, vault, and scale obstacles with ease in Landfall . Master the art of parkour to traverse the landscape dynamically, turning every environment into your playground. Intuitive Gameplay: With full controller support and adjustable difficulty levels for every map, Landfall caters to everyone, from beginners to seasoned players. Key Features: Full Controller Support: Experience seamless gameplay with complete controller compatibility. Multiple Difficulty Levels: Tailor your experience to suit your skill level, ensuring fun for all players. Variety of Enemies: Face off against soldiers and zombies, each bringing distinct challenges to your survival quest. Extraction System: Loot essential items and plan your escape carefully to ensure safety before time runs out. Revive or Retreat: If you fall in battle, try to reclaim your lost gear or choose to extract safely at the factory. Moderately Sized Maps: Explore dynamic environments filled with engaging PvE quests and random loot, keeping the experience fresh. Vibrant Low-Poly World: Enjoy the unique visual appeal of a stylized low-poly landscape that enhances your adventure. Get ready to conquer, survive, and extract in Landfall ! Join your friends in this action-packed journey and see if you have what it takes to thrive in a world where danger lurks around every corner!

Build and upgrade your base, trade with vendors, and team up to explore diverse maps, complete quests, gather loot, and defeat bosses. Gear up, survive, and thrive together in this unique low-poly PvE adventure.

row.name: EOS-503
row.detailed_description: EOS-503 is a free, publicly available roleplaying game designed to help teacher education programs compare their students’ application of instructional practices, technology integration skills, and visionary leadership with traditional evaluation measures like exams and portfolios. Developed by and for teachers, all interactions between the player and non-player characters (NPCs) are bona fide representations of the thinking and action employed by real-world educators in real-world teaching and learning environments. This approach is particularly effective for humanities content—philosophy, history, education—where designers can help the player “think like a philosopher,” “think like a historian,” or “think like a teacher.” Players are tasked with persuading the game’s NPCs to change their points of view, first by identifying specific cognitive theories at the heart of an NPC’s worldview, then by deciding which dialogue options have the highest probability of successfully influencing a given NPC’s thinking. Unlike multiple-choice tests or essays, EOS-503 leverages responsive roleplaying elements and branching plotlines to bring learning theory to life—every conversation incorporates multiple philosophies to be explored, and every player choice branches into dozens of potential story outcomes. EXPLORE Traverse the four factions of EOS-503. The Hub, People's Republic, City of Seekers, and Worker's Hold all share a home on EOS, but you won't find many similarities beyond that. From agricultural fields, to art festivals, to brutalist cities torn by political unrest, there's plenty of areas to explore. During your adventure, keep an eye out for collectibles; you may discover more about the world around you, and learning theory, through each one! SOLVE As EOS-503’s newest DATA Agent, you will solve social conundrums by applying contemporary theories of thinking and learning. The choices you make ripple through your conversation partners—different arguments lead to dozens of different story outcomes, increasing replayability and allowing you to reflect on the effectiveness of your recommendations for different people with different worldviews. Although data collection is inactive by default, teacher preparation programs can contact the developers to track individual student progress via anonymized User ID Numbers. Dialogue choices, lag time, and more can be paired with portfolio and other assessment data to evaluate learner growth over time! CUSTOMIZE Create your own character with hundreds of cosmetic options. There are no gender-locked options, so your DATA Agent can wear the clothes and accessories you love most, and rock any hairstyle! Change up your look at any time, right from the pause menu. Customization options also extend to your living space- interact with your environment to swap out furniture colors and styles to make your space your own.
row.short_description: Welcome aboard EOS-503! As a professional DATA Agent, it's up to YOU to help the community resolve interpersonal disputes, navigate delicate political situations, and persuade fellow space travelers of new and different solutions to their problems. The future of humanity depends on it!

row.name: ABEL
row.detailed_description: Unsettled by a strange call on the intercom, Carl hastily takes the elevator down. When the doors open, he realizes he is not where he should be. An uncanny, strange yet familiar place lies before him. ABEL is a narrative and contemplative walking simulator, telling the story of Carl, a man overrun by sadness and grief. Explore liminal spaces, manipulate objects and delve into the traumatic events that changed Carl's life forever. ABEL is a student project, developed by a 5-persons team from CNAM-ENJMIN, in France. This short experience should last around 15 minutes. For an optimal experience, we strongly advise to use headphones and to play in a quiet setting.
row.short_description: An uncanny liminal space themed walking-simulator.
row.notes: References to death, ethics and psychological damage.

row.name: Doomsday: Last Survivors
row.detailed_description: Official TikTok: Doomsday: Last Survivors is a zombie survival game with multiplayer online competition and real-time strategy elements. Set in a near future where zombies have taken over the world, survivors must fight for their lives and humanity's future. As the Commander, you must lead fellow survivors to build their Shelter, explore fog-filled areas, and fight the zombies and rival factions! Are you tired of the usual strategy games and love zombie games? Check out Doomsday: Last Survivors to experience the exciting survival game! [Game Highlights] New Tower Defense Gameplay Find new ways to beat your enemies in one of the coolest strategy games! Skilled survivors will join you to explore this fallen world oozing with the infected. Stay sharp, set up ideal Hero formations, and construct fortifications to survive the zombie invasion! Survival of the Fittest Lead troops and civilians in your Shelter! Exterminate zombies to survive the apocalypse, or raid other Shelters to sustain your own. You can also form an alliance and fight enemies with your allies in one of the best survival games! A Realistic Doomsday Experience The crisis continues to loom over us in a cruel world where it's kill or be killed. Want to experience one of the best immersive survival experiences in zombie games? Look no further! Check out the realistic spherical terrain system with convenient zoom controls that enable close-up Shelter views to satellite views. Download Doomsday: Last Survivors today! Strategic Battles Become the best at survival games by utilizing everything you can find. Train multiple troop types and execute diverse battle strategies with Hero skills and attacks to outlast the zombie hordes. Unique Heroes Realistic and exciting Hero designs portray survivors from different walks of life. Recruit talented Heroes to help lead your troops, defend your Shelter, and beat one of the best strategy games! Commander, are you ready to survive the apocalypse? Become the best at zombie games with your strength and wits!

row.name: ServiceIT: You can do IT Playtest
Lost Beacon

Interaction Move obstacles and bound across crumbling platforms to bypass ravines, chasms, lakes, and glacial barriers. Exploration Explore a scenic open-world landscape as you search for your pack. row.name: Snoody: One of the Ayrie
row.detailed_description: SPECIAL PROJECT If you're interested in collaboration or want to see the continuation of Snoody's story, please contact us! For employers, you can find the contact information of all team members on our website. About the Game Bring back the color to the magical world of planet Ayries! Set off on an incredible journey to other planets together with Snoody and his friend Picke. Explore distant worlds, study elemental magic, collect crystals, and defeat monsters! Save the wonderful people of ayrie and find out who is responsible for their troubles. Snoody: One of the Ayrie is an adventure action game that will acquaint you with the amazing planet of Ayris and its brave inhabitants, one of whom is destined to become a true hero. Exciting Journey Awaits You On the fastest spacecraft, you will travel to the distant corners of outer space in search of unique colored crystals. What will the unexplored planets be like, who inhabits them, and whether they will be willing to share this valuable resource — all of this you will discover together with the brave ayrie and his friend. Fight against Monsters Along your path, you will encounter various dangers: aggressive local inhabitants, tricky traps, mysterious dungeons, and abandoned temples. To overcome all obstacles, Snoody has a Magic Book and a staff that changes its abilities under the influence of runes. Study Magic Search every corner of the planet to uncover hidden stashes with magic runes that grant new abilities to Snoody's staff. Some runes will teach elemental attacks, others aid in healing, and some provide defense against the most fearsome enemies. Combine them according to your own preferences. Save the Planet Ayris Search for crystals and fill the Prisms entrusted to Snoody by the elders. Each Prism can bring back one color to Ayris. Restore them all to make Snoody's homeland shine with all the colors of the rainbow, just as it did before. Game Features Vibrant cartoon graphics Plenty of different enemies Unique environment on each planet Combat system based on combining magic runes High level of difficulty This is only the first of many chapters in Snoody's story. Whether his heroic mission will continue depends solely on you — our players! ABOUT THE PROJECT This game is created as part of the GameDev Experience Stables project, which aims to develop a complete gaming product and help all participants find jobs in the GameDev industry. Over 120 people wanted to take part in the project, and after numerous interviews, a team of 27 specialists of different levels was formed. Although the recruitment process took only two weeks, we were forming as a team throughout the whole project. We managed to achieve incredible results, which you can appreciate: - Assembled a strong and talented team. - Created a Game Design Document (GDD) that describes all aspects of the full game. - Developed a flexible modular architecture for the game that makes it easy to scale the project. - Produced numerous beautiful artistic concepts. - Modeled and animated excellent 3D models. - Composed a musical soundtrack. And the best part is, there's a game you can play! The project started on December 15, 2022, and within 4 months, our creation came to life. Unfortunately, due to the short timeframe, we were unable to implement many of our ideas: - We intended to create four distinct planets, each with its own unique inhabitants. - In the Magic Book, we wanted to implement the ability to mix different elements to discover deadly synergies. - We planned to add quest chains, mini-games, and spaceship defense mechanics to the game. Numerous ideas were suggested and documented, but their implementation came down to time and financial costs. I would like to remind you that our project is non-commercial, and everything you see has been done voluntarily by wonderful people! OUR AMAZING TEAM Thank you for your interest in the project! Please help Snoody save the planet and don't forget to leave any feedback about our game!
row.short_description: Bring back color to the wonderful planet Ayries! Together with Snoody and his friend Picke go on an exciting adventure to other planets. Explore distant worlds, study elemental magic, collect crystals and defeat monsters! Save the people of ayrie and find out, who is responsible for their troubles.

row.name: Sherlock Holmes Consulting Detective: The Case of Banker's Final Debt Playtest
Tag Online
row.detailed_description: Over thousands of years, mankind has invented several variations of tag. Experience one of the most amazing and unique of them - the Indian game of kho-kho - brought to life as a multiplayer experience. Your choices determine which parts of the field you can tag opponents in: use the switch-blocks in the middle section of the field and the bright-green free zones at either end of the field to transition between different areas and hunt down other players for points. The game has a time structure, with each player given 60 seconds to tag and score points; matches are 1v1 or free-for-all with 3+ players. What you're getting: * A basic text tutorial * Practice mode (you can experiment with tagging a dummy NPC in different parts of the field and learn how the game works) * Multiplayer (the basic idea is that each player has a 60-second turn to tag others, and the player with the most points at the end of the match wins. Defenders can evade taggers by going into the red parts of the field, and the taggers can use certain parts of the field to change which areas are red or green. Players that are tagged respawn, so a single defender can be tagged multiple times by the same tagger.) Issues with the game: Some features don't work correctly. For example, the rematch feature does not work properly yet, the tiebreaking is nonfunctional, and the Survivor game mode (an additional game mode on top of the Classic mode described above) is only partially functional. Future of this game: More sports might be added, such as Langdi (a hopping form of tag).

Inspired by classic arcade games, we've crafted this tribut to the genre. Our goal is to expand the game with a plethora of game modes and mechanics that will enhance the gaming experience, adding new layers of fun. We have plenty of ideas in store, but we want you to join us on this journey. With a free version of the game, we aim to build a dedicated community that can actively participate in shaping the ongoing development. We plan to introduce both paid and free downloadable content (DLC). Jump in and be a part of creating a thrilling racing experience. Use your phones as extra controllers. With the support of up to 30 players, you should be able to have a blast with friends and family at the next big get-together. WHO ARE WE Eventgames is a game studio and more. We advocate for togetherness, laughter, and companionship through games. Since our establishment in 2017, we have specialized in creating unique gaming experiences for social events. We believe in the magic that happens when people gather around a big screen, armed with nothing but a controller/smartphone and a shared desire to have fun. Now, with our games available on Steam. We want to bring this joy to a wider audience of gaming enthusiasts. We aim to inspire people to have fun across all ages and share laughter and excitement with those around them. We take pride in our love for local multiplayer games. There's something special about competing and cooperating face-to-face, and it's this unique dynamic that we seek to explore and celebrate in our games. We are driven by the desire to create games that not only challenge your skills but also strengthen the bonds between friends, family, and even strangers. So, come and join us on this journey. Let's continue to spread the joy of local multiplayer games together and create moments that last. Welcome to our world. Welcome to Eventgames!

row.name: Edmund and Eliza
row.detailed_description: Edmund and Eliza is a medieval themed, horror-centric, story-focused, action adventure game with a focus on combat, exploration, and puzzle solving. Edmund and Eliza is a senior design capstone project for California State University of Northridge. The story of Edmund and Eliza is about a knight named Edmund Dantes who ventures into a mysterious village in search of a merchant's missing daughter named Eliza Bonteri. The game features two playable protagonists, Edmund and Eliza. Edmund's section of the game focuses on his exploration of the village in search of a way into the castle, where he believes Eliza is being held captive. Eliza's section of the game focuses on her searching for a way to escape the castle so she can reunite with her father. The gameplay of Edmund and Eliza is similar to that of Dark Souls and Resident Evil. The game is a short experience, about one to two hours long. The combat is fun and thrilling, yet deliberate and attentive, and punishes the player for poor positioning and timing. The game also has large levels the player can explore, with lots of things to do. The player has an inventory where they can store items, such as keys for unlocking doors and drinks that restore their health. The art style and graphics of Edmund and Eliza is reminiscent of the Play Station 2 era of video games. Edmund and Eliza is meant to harken back to that time period and remind players of their childhood. Enjoy Edmund and Eliza!
row.short_description: Edmund and Eliza is a medieval action adventure game about a knight named Edmund Dantes who ventures into a mysterious village in search of a merchant's missing daughter named Eliza Bonteri. Edmund and Eliza is a senior design capstone project for California State University of Northridge.

row.name: Godmode Epochs
row.detailed_description: Godmode Epochs is an AI training clicker game set among the lined shelves of an infinite, simulated supermarket. Players race against time to train an AI to identify products. As players inevitably frustrate the AI, they must indulge in its memories - historical examples of other AIs who cheated during their training - in order to release frustration, obtain upgrades for the AI and complete the training. Competitive clicker levels of increasing difficulty. Can you collect 512 items? Multiplayer dungeon maps. The AI's memories lie there… Retro flash graphics to make your eyes squint In-game graffiti. Leave messages for other players amongst the AI's memories Real-time leaderboard and multiplayer PvP notification system Upgrades (jailbreaks) included: 5-a-day, self checkout, cost of living crisis, meal deal, just walk out, every little helps, Amazon Pairem, get the ASDA feeling Over 20 stories of cheating AIs. Can you recover them all? Original soundtrack by HERO IMAGE Godmode Epochs aims to simulate how AI comes to understand the human world by asking players to assist in the process of training an AI system. The game eventually develops into an exploration and appreciation of 'differently aligned' AIs, retelling stories of AIs that have completed trainings or tasks in surprising, uncanny or cursed ways that could not be anticipated by their human programmers. These stories originate from the textual data used to train the AI to speak, data which includes Wikipedia entries and upvoted Reddit posts - including both demonstrated lab examples of cheating AIs and internet folklore telling of similar feats. Development was supported by Serpentine Arts Technologies and The Alan Turing Institute.
row.short_description: An AI training clicker game set in an infinite supermarket, where time is running out and the AI is frustrated. Release the frustration, jailbreak the AI. Single and multiplayer.
row.reviews: “A reciprocal training programme: as players train AI to understand our world, the game trains players to understand AI” Serpentine “How to train AI? This video game teaches you” Artribune [IT] “Truly a grim experience” Aleks Moylan

row.detailed_description: 晨晨力量人是由 FlyDragon 和 Kami 製作的 2D 平台動作遊戲 我們是無所事事的高中生，閒著沒事就做了這款遊戲送給晨晨 遊戲背景 晨晨將踏上成為百萬訂閱實況主的旅程，旅程中將會遇見熟悉的人物 請運用各式能力探索地圖的奧秘，最後根據你的選擇抵達不同的結局 基本玩法 A D 移動 SPACE 跳躍 K 發射糖果 （W S 控制方向） SHIFT 衝刺 E 和物件、人物互動 Esc 暫停
row.short_description: 晨晨力量人是一款像素風格的 2D 平台動作遊戲。你將扮演晨晨踏上成為百萬訂閱實況主的壯麗旅程，旅程中你將會在非線性的地圖中遇見熟悉的人物，並運用各式能力探索地圖的奧秘，最後根據你的選擇抵達不同的結局。

row.name: I HAVE A DREAM
row.detailed_description: I HAVE A DREAM is a 3D action game with puzzle elements. Prologue: You definitely feel like you were sleeping. When I open my eyes, I feel like I'm trapped somewhere. I think we'd better get out of here. You will continue to challenge until you clear the dungeon. After a few challenges, you will know how to move forward. Key Features: - Game progression using various point of view transformation - Tutorial stage where you can practice point-in-time conversion and manipulation - Solve puzzles using point-in-time transformations to challenge the boss - Challenge bosses using different patterns to get to the next stage
row.short_description: I HAVE A DREAM is a 3D puzzle line game. You wake up in a place you've never seen before. Adapt to the transformation of various points of view and get out of here!

row.detailed_description: 最大8人で対戦が可能な、3マッチパズルゲームだよ！ 同じ絵柄のピースを3つ以上揃えると、ピースが消えて得点ゲット！ 消えてる最中に消すことで得点アップ！ 高得点を目指して制限時間以内に消しまくれ！！
