row.name: Drag Her!
row.detailed_description: Drag Her! Failure to Launch Edition is us turning our lemons into gay ass lemonade and sharing our highly-acclaimed, highly-unpublishable fighting game with you all. She's fast, she's frenetic, she's a 2D fighter featuring real drag stars duking it out to find the true top in a world full of bottoms. Fight your friends, neighbors, enemies, and she-roes (sometimes all at once with 4-player mode). The only thing you can't fight is the inevitable foreclosure of your game studio. Alaska 5000: An alien from Planet Glamtron, this strange and striking diva is known for her humor, her anus, and for the fact that, this is her hair, she don’t wear wigs. Kim Chi: A 7 foot tall anime character, this Korean queen showed us that beauty comes in a towering and tantalizing package. Laganja Estranja: From her splits to god’s ears, Laganja Estranja showed us all that marijuana wasn’t just a downer, it was also a come-upper. Destroy your bestie/partner/enemy-to-lover in local versus mode Fight anyone, anywhere with our online multiplayer rollback* netcode! (*backrolls not included) Pregame a fun night out at the club with our round-robin 4 player mode Lab with the girls in our training room, replete with frame data
row.short_description: Drag Her! Failure to Launch Edition is a skinny version of our fast, fabulous and frenetic 2D fighter. Featuring a roster of real-life drag royalty, including the iconic Alaska 5000, Kim Chi & Laganja Estranja.
row.notes: Drag Her! contains frequent mentions of adult humor, sexual innuendo, and lewd behavior. Drag Her! also contains infrequent mentions of alcohol and drug use.

row.name: Monster Tiles TD: Tower Wars
row.detailed_description: Join millions of others - Play Monster Tiles TD: Tower Wars for free today! Forget the boring old days of defending a fixed path that the developers created for you 👎. Monster Tiles TD offers a breath of fresh air in the tower defense genre, allowing you to build your own path to defend 💪! After completing each wave, you gain a new randomly generated tile to place wherever you want (try to be smart and strategic about it, though 😛). Building your own custom tower defense allows you to play how YOU want , with the characters and strategies that YOU enjoy the most, and on a map that YOU created . This dynamic base-building mechanic creates endless replayability with every single game being different than the last! ✨✨✨ 🔥 FEATURES 🔥 A fleet of medieval space pirates are invading the monsters' base, and it is up to you to stop them! Unlock, upgrade, and evolve your monsters to defend the base from spacefaring knights, mages, pirates, and countless other unique enemies. Build and defend a custom tower defense maze. Roguelike progression and upgrades. Over 35 monster tower types to build, each with unique skills and synergies. Evolve monsters to greater forms for powerful stat and skill bonuses. Multiple RPG and TD classes and specialties. Optimize tower placements to activate powerful synergy effects. Equip monsters with epic gear dropped from bosses. Conquer different maps, difficulties, and game modes. Unlock, upgrade, and evolve your monsters to defend against spacefaring knights, mages, pirates, and more! 🛠️ BUILD YOUR BASE 🛠️ Monster Tiles TD features a unique tower defense mechanic where you manually rotate and place a randomly generated tile after each wave to control the enemy path. Each game starts off easy, with only one enemy spawn location and a simple straightforward path. However, as you reach higher waves, the path will branch off into dozens of spawn points, increasing the difficulty and number of locations to defend. Strategically placing tiles to optimize tower placements and enemy spawn locations is key to a successful defense. Influence your defensive positions and enemy pathing by choosing where to place the next tile and expand your base after each wave. Branch out to loot Treasure Islands for huge rewards, while still maintaining a strong, consolidated defense. Each new tile is randomly generated, meaning every single game you play is different! Roguelike and RPG base defender mechanics. 💪 EVOLVE & UPGRADE 💪 Improve your defense and speed up your gameplay by researching countless upgrades that affect nearly every aspect of the game. Strengthen your monsters, bolster your tower defenses, debuff your enemies, and influence the tiles on the map with several hundred upgrade combinations. Unlock and upgrade countless artifacts, spells, specialties, and technologies. Collect and upgrade dozens of powerful equipment, ranging from common to divine. Upgrade your player level and collect rewards by completing games. Upgrade monsters by collecting gold, energy, credits and PvP Tournament points. 🚀 ENDLESS PROGRESSION 🚀 Progress through multiple difficulty modes ranging from easy to impossible. Then, spice the end-game up with the unique endless and score attack modes. Each game mode adds new powerful enemy types and additional challenges. Reach higher waves on each difficulty to unlock new monster towers and upgrades, and compete against others on the leaderboards! The fun never ends in Monster Tiles TD! Reach higher waves and difficulties to unlock new monsters, upgrades, and rewards. Each game mode adds new enemy types and challenges. Unique Endless, Sudden Death, Score Attack, and Swarm game modes. Competitive PvP game modes. Compete against other players for the highest rank on the leaderboards. Customize your personal leaderboards look by completing challenges to unlock custom leaderboard icons, titles, and backgrounds. Complete daily tasks and achievements to bolster your towers. Enjoy free rewards from regular in-game events and gifts. In Monster Tiles TD: Tower Wars, you're not only defending, but also building a custom maze, evolving monsters, and strategizing for the next level. The dynamic roguelike base-building system makes each wave unique and unpredictable, requiring you to adapt your tactics on the go. Unleash a variety of monsters, each with its own evolution path and unique skills, and evolve them into legendary creatures. Synergize your towers to defeat even the toughest foes. Build and guard your base, evolve your monster towers, defend against the attacking space pirates, and compete in PvP Tournaments. The fun never ends in Monster Tiles TD! Chat with the developer and other players, and get more information on our Discord!
row.short_description: Free Tower Defense game with unique roguelike elements. Custom base building mechanics allow you to create your own base and maze with tiles earned after each wave. Unleash a variety of monsters, each with its own evolution path and unique skills, and evolve them into legendary creatures.

row.name: Hyakki Yako: OH&S
row.detailed_description: YOU WANDER FOREVER IN UNDEATH Hyakki Yako: Operational Health and Safety is a first-person horror game. You play as Haramita Renkai , salary-man by day, exorcist by night. Renkai is trapped somewhere deep in the underworld after a ritual gone awry. Armed with naught but his wits, his talismans and a burning desire for self-criticism, Renkai attempts to flee the grasp of the ravenous Demon Parade and escape back to the mortal plane. Wander a Labyrinthine Dreamscape Collect Precious Few Talismans Escape The Ever-Encroaching Demon Parade Exorcism's one h̶̥̤̹̲e̤͞l̹͙̼̖̙̣͞ḷ̱̪͎̹̞ of a job.
row.short_description: Haramita Renkai is trapped somewhere deep in the underworld after a ritual gone awry. Armed with naught but his wits, his talismans and a burning desire for self-criticism, Renkai attempts to flee the grasp of the ravenous Demon Parade and escape back to the mortal plane.

row.name: Roving Rovers - Australian Rover Challenge 2025
row.detailed_description: Play as a lonely Lunar Rover whose job is to prepare the moon for habitation. There has been a recent crash of a space shuttle and with man's arrival on the horizon it's time to explore and use the available resources to ensure their safe arrival. Roving Rovers started as a replica of the internationally recognised Australian Rover Challenge, enabling players to understand the complexities of the lunar and otherworldly rover missions. Developed with the support of The Andy Thomas Centre for Space Resources, University of Adelaide and Flinders university, it is based in the realities of the space industry. Features: Rover customisation First and Third person views Drive across an imported scan of the moon
row.short_description: Ensure the moon is safe for man's inevitable lunar habitat. Drive and interact as a Lunar Rover with crashed ships, the natural resources and explore the nearby landscape to determine the suitability!

row.name: Knight Overloaded
row.detailed_description: Knight Overloaded is a roguelight survival game that reinforced strategic choices. Beat enemies falling from the sky endlessly, and expand your inventory! Arrange Compose - Arrange weapons to attack enemies, deploy items to strengthen weapons. - Pick up gold and buy, merge, and place items. - 15 waves in total - 170+ items (including weapons) - 10 levels of re-playable difficulty
row.short_description: Knight Overloaded is a roguelight survival game that reinforced strategic choices. Beat enemies falling from the sky endlessly, and expand your inventory!

row.name: 疾风猎人-上线送V10，超变独家版本
row.detailed_description: 《疾风猎人》是一款全新的以魔幻题材为背景的RPG游戏。 在一个充满着未知的魔幻大陆等待着勇者探索，探索魔幻大陆，挖掘未知的秘密，荣耀将加冕于你！ 您将扮演一位来到魔幻大陆的探险家，通过在大陆不断的探索，解开魔幻大陆未解之谜，同时传承龙戒，立于大陆之巅。 精美的人物刻画、丰富真实的魔幻大陆场景、热血刺激的打斗渲染，绝对会给你身临其境的直观游戏感受，欢迎勇士前来探索魔幻大陆！ 超值福利 上线就送 上线即送极品翅膀，无须任何花费便可领取超值奖励。王者之路、勇士指南等引导内容带你免费领取豪华钻石礼包，助力实力急速提升。 团队竞技 玩法多样 经典玩法悉数登场，血色城堡、恶魔广场还是原来的味道；赤色要塞、狼魂要塞团结协作，共抗邪魔；单人PK、组队团战、战盟攻城战、跨服竞技等多样PVP玩法，和好朋友一起冒险、一起战斗才有趣！ 超高爆率 自由交易 超高爆率，自由交易，所有装备全靠打！游戏内所有装备完全靠手打爆出，小怪也能爆出带有极品词条的神装！更有卡利玛专属地图等你开启。 特色玩法 命定欧非 特色鹿影迷踪玩法，随机刷怪，掉落高阶装备材料，全服玩家随机抽取，欧皇与非酋在这一刻觉醒血脉。更有刺激藏宝图玩法，根据藏宝图提示的地址前往寻找大天使宝藏！
row.short_description: 《疾风猎人-福利版》上线送V10+百万钻石+无限抽奖 礼包一：钻石*1000，装备之匙*5，坐骑培养石*5…； 礼包二：钻石*1000，装备之匙*5，坐骑培养石*5…; 礼包三：钻石*1000，异界召唤券*1，传说宝玉*5…； 更多免费礼包请通过下方联系方式添加客服领取。

row.name: Burger Zombies
row.detailed_description: Step into a thrilling world of chaos and survival in this top-down, free-roaming shooter. Take on the role of a courageous burger delivery man, braving the zombie apocalypse to complete your orders. But this isn't your ordinary delivery gig—this is a fight for survival! As you navigate through the city streets, your mission is twofold: pick up and deliver orders while fending off an ever-growing horde of ravenous zombies. Strap in for heart-pounding action as you skilfully shoot and drive your way through the relentless undead. Experience the adrenaline rush as you balance the need for speed with precision marksmanship. Each delivery becomes a high-stakes race against time, where the fate of your customers and your own survival hangs in the balance. Can you keep your cool under pressure and make it through the chaos? Current features: Endless Free Roam Test your survival skills in this mode where you must deliver packages against an ever-growing horde of zombies. See how many deliveries you can complete before becoming their next meal. Tutorial Dive into a short but comprehensive tutorial that introduces you to the game mechanics. Learn the ins and outs of burger delivery, combat, and navigation. Master the essential skills needed to navigate the zombie-infested world and increase your chances of survival. Customize Express your personal style with a range of customization options. Change colors, swap skins, and select from a variety of hats. Utilize your hard-earned cash to unlock and purchase new customization items, allowing you to stand out in the apocalyptic chaos and showcase your unique character. Are you up for the challenge? The fate of the burgers—and the world—rests in your hands. Grab your keys, load your weapons, and prepare to take on the undead in 'Burger Zombies'!
row.short_description: A top down free roaming shooter where you play as a burger delivery man who is completing his orders during the zombie apocalypse. Pick up and deliver orders while shooting and driving against a ever growing horde of zombies.

row.name: Soul Detective
row.detailed_description: Troubles brewing in the land of the dead, the Soul Detective Agency is on the case. Meet our Detective, truly a specter whose unable to rest his soul until evil is vanquished in this realm. There are demons that managed to make their way into limbo, stopping pure souls from moving on into to the lower depths of the nine realms. The Detective and his dear friend Magnus, who's enraptured in the detectives magnifying glass creating a truly ghoulish weapon that is capable of sending demons back to their fiery grave, are on the mission to assist. Help this duo fight the demons and find whose behind it all. In this game you will fight through three realms, run into friendly spirits that will guide you on your way, and utilize the Detectives Spectral Powers including Telekinesis, Ranged Attack, and Possession. Dodge, Dash, Swipe and Attack enemies that flood the three levels and make your way to the bosses holding the area in order to progress further below Limbo. Student lead game learning the capabilities of game engines, and our ability in art code and design, hope you enjoy!
row.short_description: Worthy Souls are being held back from moving on the land of the dead, the Soul Detective Agency is on the case! Our Detective and his trusty partner Magnus, enraptured in the magnifying glass creating a ghoulish weapon of destruction, are here to defeat the demons who are causing this catastrophe.

row.name: Snapback
row.detailed_description: Snapback is the ultimate speedrunning puzzle platformer. It takes place in a dystopian world ruled by an authoritarian regime. You are a robotic citizen presented with the opportunity to fight against the oppressive system. A mysterious hacker gives you missions to rebel against the regime you live under. Each level presents a different challenge. Gameplay features a unique ability that allows you to traverse levels with careful teleports, only to be pulled back to that location after a set period. Every second counts. Speed is the puzzle. Features: Teleport - You have the ability to teleport instantly to any point you can see within range, but only for a period of time before you trigger a SnapBack. Snapback - After teleporting, you will return to your previous location after a set period, traveling through space and colliding with everything between your current location and where you teleported from. This can also be triggered manually. Punch - You can break objects, including, but not limited to, doors, windows, and enemies. Movement - As a robot, you have an increased ability to move quickly through space and advanced servos to increase your ability to jump and traverse large distances. Reset – To help facilitate speed runs and stumped puzzlers, you have the ability to reset a level at will to help get the best time possible. Tier System – Our tier system scores the player based on performance while playing any given level. Try to reach S Tier in everything to achieve true mastery of the game.
row.short_description: Snapback is a Speed-Runner Puzzle Platformer set in a robot dystopia where you are recruited to rebel against the evil GovCorp overlords, break the rules, and join the resistance!

row.name: TRY AGAIN
row.detailed_description: You play as Benny , a video game character whose testing days appear to be over as he teeters on the brink of obsolescence by a mercurial, unseen Designer, crunching to meet a deadline. Set in a bunker-like, test facility, you must grapple with challenging platforms, fast-paced puzzles, and an ever-changing facility dictated by the whims of the insecure Designer. With time running out, navigate the gray-box labyrinth of development, upend the norms of character progression, and champion Benny to solidify his place as the game’s lead character. Your mission is more than just survival in this fast-paced, 2.5d platformer. You are trying to break free from your 'temporary' status as a test character. Claim the title you've always desired - the main character. Master the gameplay, exploit the rules, and seize control of your narrative. But this isn't just about winning—it's about breaking the Sisyphean hell Benny is trapped in. Challenge the limits of your coded existence and break the chains of pre-determined outcomes. This is your chance to redefine what it means to Try Again.
row.short_description: You're Benny, a test character trapped in an unfinished game by a figure called The Designer. She's up against a deadline for her publisher which means it's your last day as a test character. Navigate the facility, dodge game-dev chaos and defy expectations to become the main character.

row.name: Oberak (Prelude)
row.detailed_description: Oberak is a stylized genre mashup of action adventure RPG and Social School Sim with a dash of Roguelite spice, set in a Sci-Fantasy world inspired by Wuxia stories, Shonen martial arts anime, and the style of hip-hop culture. As a powerful Qi warrior, your journey will focus on nurturing and training students in order to activate their superhuman Kung-Fu abilities. You’ll master a myriad of skills including martial and athletic training, hunting, gardening, cooking, foraging, and crafting, which you will pass along to your student. You and your students’ abilities will be put to the test through up-close, hyper-stylized combat with deadly rogue clans that have threatened the lands of Ti-an. Challenging combat, exciting narrative, and satisfying cultivation are combined in a refreshing new spin on a Cultivation Sim. Explore the beauty of Ti-an on this exciting adventure. Collect, forage, hunt, and garden along the way. Hanato is your home! With the rogue clans on the rise causing an upheaval, it's up to you to keep it safe. [build your legacy gif] Nurture and train your students in a variety of skills from martial and athletic training to hunting, gardening, cooking, foraging, and crafting to make them stronger and well-rounded to protect Hanato alongside you. [connect and conquer gif] Connect with your fellow Oberaks to train and adventure together through Ti-an.
row.short_description: Oberak is a third-person Action Adventure RPG and Social School Sim mash-up, set in a Sci-Fantasy world with hip-hop influences. As a powerful Qi warrior, nurture your students, master skills from martial arts to crafting, and defend Ti-an from the deadly rogue clans that are on the rise.

row.name: Ticy Adventure Club : Queen of the Spring
row.detailed_description: ◆ 先行游玩本作的序章：《提西探险社》◆ 提西探险社 《提西探险社：春日女王》的序章《提西探险社》已于2022年12月在Steam发行，玩家可以在游玩本作之前选择先行游玩序章《提西探险社》。 通关序章的剧情再游玩本作，会有更好的游戏体验。 About the Game 提西探险社：春日女王 一群聚集在提西中学 “探险社” 的天才少年们，找到了关于三年前的一桩失踪案的线索。 但在他们思考如何采取进一步行动的同时，一个关于 “春日女王” 的传言，给提西城带来了史无前例的大危机，也让探险社陷入困境…… 不过，事情并不会到此结束，因为提西城探案界冉冉升起的新星—— “提西侦探社” 的加丝蒂思与其伙伴们，也接下了这个案件。 最后的谜团将由谁来解开？提西城的命运又将会怎样呢…… 操作说明 方向键 - 操控角色行走 空格键 / Z键 / Enter键 - 进行对话 / 交互 ESC / X键 - 打开菜单栏 存档 Shift + 方向键 - 跑步 请注意，本游戏 没有自动存档 ，需要手动存档。 控制角色自由调查的时候可以 随时存档 ，打开菜单栏找到对应选项即可。 另外，每个章节中间也会有存档提示，还请注意保存好游戏进度，非常感谢。
row.short_description: 本作是一款RPG恐怖解谜游戏。在游戏中，玩家将扮演一群以解决灵异事件为课外实践活动的学生，在提西城里调查有关“春日女王”的事件。随着调查的深入，一场巨大的阴谋正徐徐展开……

row.name: 环形杀手 Circle Killer
row.detailed_description: This is a musical action game with multiple gameplay attempts Introduction In the game, you play as the 'original', dodging blocks in different levels, surviving for a certain amount of time or achieving certain conditions to achieve victory The current levels in the game have different operating skills, including 'time dilation', 'time stop', 'time travel' and so on In different levels, the above abilities will also change. The game has multiple levels to play, each of which contains different random elements Fall Level - You need to avoid enemies generated according to the music frequency and survive for a specified time until you win Shuttle Level - You need to travel through a time tunnel, according to the rhythm of the music to use the ability to travel through time, reach the end to win Vampire Survivor Level - Vampire-like survivor's meat pigeon level, you need to ensure your survival while fending off the constant arrival of monsters. There are three development routes to choose from, develop your survival strategy, and survive long enough. Art style The game uses a unified - Cyberneon, steam wave style It is called 'light pollution', which also means that if you have a series of complications such as 'photosensitive epilepsy', discomfort and play this game Special mechanism Time dilation - When you use this skill in a certain level, it will slow down the time flow of all objects except your main character. It can help you create time to think about countermeasures, and using this ability will also slow down the time count. Time Stop - This ability is similar to DIO's ability in JOJO, as the name suggests, it is quite powerful, but you are also affected by the time stop, which pauses the time count. Time Switch - This ability allows you to travel through different dimensions of time and space while exposing yourself to different challenges. Properly used, this ability can greatly reduce the difficulty of playing a level
row.short_description: play the role of 'circle' to avoid incoming blocks with rhythmic music now have two different levels Fall Level: Accompanied by dynamic music you will move freely around the area, avoiding falling blocks Traversal Level: You will continue traversing a section of road with rhythmic music

row.name: Project Fireball
row.detailed_description: Event & announcement Dear Project Fireball Community, We regret to inform you that the journey of Project Fireball will be coming to an end on December 2nd 2025, 4:00PM CET. This decision was made after careful consideration, and we would like to warmly thank all of you who joined us on this adventure and supported the game since day one. As Project Fireball concludes, our team remains dedicated to delivering meaningful and engaging gaming experiences. Follow @Gameloft on our official networks to stay tuned to our latest news & updates.   Again, thank you to all players for your support & enthusiasm; we look forward to seeing you in our other games & upcoming projects! About the Game ENTER THE ARENA Project Fireball unites the best of the heart-pounding world of sports with the show-stopping power of magic to create a lawless footbrawl-like battle arena game. A roster of first-class heroes are dying to unleash their ultimate superpowers to help you crush your opponents! Let none stand in your way to the top, but watch out—there is no mercy in the arena. Anything goes. 2 V 2 REAL-TIME BATTLES Think you and your team have what it takes to become Project Fireball champions? All you need to do is fight tooth and nail through the other team’s defenses (no sweat) to score goals in their net (nothing to it). Use any means necessary—the environment, your super abilities, and your skills— and remember: the best defense is an aggressive offense. FUTURISTIC FANTASY ARCADE FOOTBRAWL Get ready for the event of the century in a futuristic open-air arena with the most heroic of heroes, each with their own twisted super abilities. Transform the ball into an unstoppable charge of energy and score. This is the height of entertainment. FUN AND SERIOUS GAME All champions have to start somewhere, so don’t take it too hard when you’re obliterated by your opponents. Get back up and start strategizing with your teammates. Whether you’re looking to master the world of Project Fireball or are a curious casual who just wants to pull off some wild stunts, you’re in the right place. BORN IN FRANCE, RAISED WORLDWIDE Project Fireball is brought to you by the brilliant minds of a small but mighty international group in France who can’t wait to see everyone duking it out in the arena in a display of guts and glory. Keep in touch by joining Project Fireball’s official Discord, and 'wishlist' and 'follow' on Steam for all the hottest news.
row.short_description: Let’s get ready to rumble! Take to the arena in the one and only Project Fireball, a rowdy fantasy-arcade footbrawl game where there are no rules. Choose your hero and use their super abilities to show everyone who’s boss in epic 2v2 matches.

row.name: Non-Virtual Reality Games
row.detailed_description: Experience VR like never before. Without the headset! ! Required Steam VR system with Base Stations / Outside sensors, like HTC Vive or Valve Index ! Collection of non-virtual, reality games! All games are played in the real world All necessary information is conveyed through controller vibration and sound! Play locally with your friends. Each using one controller Wide variety of games How To Play Put your VR headset to the side, where its still visible to the trackers. Then turn up your volume, so you can hear the game. Finally give each player one of the controllers. Now you are ready to go! Game There are 2 games included in our collection: I Packed my Universe (2 Players, Versus) A fresh take on the classic I Packed my Suitcase game. Place planets freely in your room and keep track of their positions. Because you can only add a new one after confirming the positions of each previously placed planet. Ghost Hunter (2 Players, Coop) Free your room of spooky creatures in Ghost Hunter ! Use the virbations of the controllers to track their location and pull them apart! Supported Hardware We are currently only supporting Valve Index and HTC Vive systems, as these have external base stations for tracking. Background This project was created as part of the the Games Master study program at the HAW Hamburg University Of Applied Sciences.
row.short_description: VR without the headset. Games without visuals. Each player gets one of the VR controllers, no headset needed. All included games only use vibrations and sound to convey the game, while you play in the real world.

row.name: Town of Sins
row.detailed_description: Imagine yourself in a perfect town, where everyone’s a prim and proper lady, like they’re living a Victorian novel?! And then, there’s you… the one who got super drunk with a bunch of whores, and woke up the next day at snoozefest, in the middle of fucking nowhere. Your goal now? Shake things up or die of boredom trying! This town is about to get turned upside down, so get ready for a world of BDSM, seduction and power play! Seduce those uptight prudes and teach them a thing or two about real fun. It’s not about hearts and flowers, it’s about getting down and dirty. Every card in play must be evolved and learn special transformations to become stronger in battle. Every cute little lassie around must take it in every hole and become a strong, beautiful bitch in the process. There are four types of cards in the game: * Characters * Items * Residents * Combos The battle in this game is like nothing you have ever seen. The bitches... well, their name is legion. And there’ll be no shortage of very piquant and sexy stories on the way to every one of your conquests. That’s how it is going to be, every time, with every new event in the game. In every district that you make yours. With every new trick you teach your cards. The game features a huge collection of cards. There are over 700 cards and new ones are introduced every month. Don’t forget your girls aren’t “just cards”! All of them have at least 5 secret combo strikes up their sleeve and unique personalities. Characters – cards depicting girls of different occupations or types. They may be of five different rarities: common (gray), rare (green), epic (blue), legendary (red) or mythic (golden). During the battle, you can put together a Character card and an Item card for a more powerful combo. Items – cards depicting all kinds of things. Just like Character cards, they may be of five different rarities. During the battle, they could be combined with Character cards to produce a combo. Residents – cards depicting girls resident in a certain neighborhood. They have better health (HP) and unique skills. They are particularly useful as defensive cards, and their skills produce a strong effect on the outcome of the battle. Combos – cards featuring the fusion of a Character girl with some Item. Combos are investigated in the Workshop and are key to winning in battle. Combos are much stronger than the sum total of the cards used to produce them. You will not find such an abundance of choice porn anywhere! So many that we lost count of them ourselves. There are Comic Books in every district and event. Each card has at least 5 porn transformations built into it. Many MYTHIC CARDS have their own comic book. And all of this wholesome goodness is tidied up into one awesome storyline that will literally blow you away! Enjoy our unique combat experience that features an extensive array of combinations. It’s not just that every card has its own quirks and favorite strikes. The cherry on the cake here is that all of those cards could form combos, and that’s what really matters. Every combo unlocks the girl’s new porn transformation, which only makes her stronger. The game will have many combat leaders (avatars), each of them with their very own eccentricities. You will succeed by exploring the combos and crafting the best possible deck for every new situation you face. New Updates Every Week! If, at some point, you come to believe you’ve already had every girl in town - think again! Regular updates are posted to the game every two weeks, with new events, districts, cards and battle combos added.
row.short_description: Town of Sins is a cheeky card game with a unique battle system. Corrupt the city you stumble upon and recruit innocent babes to turn them into powerful women. Upgrade your cards, engage in steamy battles, enjoy epic adventures, and collect the sexiest girls.
row.notes: This game has adult themes, language, depicting non conventional kinks, explored in healthy ways, and fictional characters depicted in sexual situations. All characters depicted are over the age of 18.

row.name: Chase
row.detailed_description: 3 weeks ago, the Inquisition court sentenced Alice Kyteler to be burned at the stake, on suspicion of witchcraft and participation in the coven, but she managed to escape, on the way to the place of execution She hid in the forests of Blackwood and is probably still hiding there, until now As news arrives that residents of nearby villages are noticing strange phenomena in the forest and cases of missing childrenAnd livestock have become more frequent, You will have to take on the role of a mercenary of the Inquisition, go to the dark forest of Blackwood and fulfill the terms of the contract to find Alice Kyteler and enforce the sentence. You have to explore this gloomy and dark world, collect information, study various magical rituals, find new chemicals, and decipher the riddles and exterminate the wickedness that inhabited the Blackwood Forest in various ways. About the developers of the project - “Chase”: Artflux - is an independent two-person game development team based in Bishkek, and this is our first experience in developing our own game and our debut project called “Chase”.
row.short_description: Chase is a horror game with shooter and detective elements. The events take place in a dark and atmospheric world, you have to take on the role of a mercenary of the Inquisition, go to the dark forest of Blackwood and fulfill the terms of the contract.

row.name: My GF Doesn't Know What I'm Into
row.detailed_description: About the game: xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx 'I've always been looking at you from afar. I began to like you from the moment we first met, and I can't keep my feelings hidden anymore. Please come to the big cherry tree after class. I want to tell you how I feel.' xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx 🤍My new girlfriend is so cute and sweet. I can't believe such a nice girl likes me so much. But... would she still want to be with me if she knew what I'm into? 🤍 A heart-pounding horror visual novel telling the story of you and your new girlfriend. Pick the name of your friend and girlfriend, as well your own name. Your choices determine what kind of story you'll get to see in each playthrough. Featuring six different endings. Aim to see them all...? --------------------------------------------- About Meiri Games: I'm a solo Brazilian game developer who enjoys making cute horror games. MyGF is my first Steam release! I hope you enjoy this short adventure.
row.short_description: A visual novel about my cute new girlfriend, who doesn't know what i'm into!

row.name: LabyrInk
row.detailed_description: DISCLAIMER: This is the result of an internal five-day Game Jam @ Double Dash Studios! Made in a week by a team of five, LabyrInk is our very first attempt at making a multiplayer game in Unreal Engine. In its current state, our game provides a very compact experience. Between working on a new engine, implementing multiplayer features, and making sure we finished with as little bugs as possible, LabyrInk's content is bite-sized. We suggest you enjoy it with your friends for a good laugh! Now, about the game itself: LabyrInk is a PvP Shooter Arena where the arena itself is invisible. Customize your character's color to stand out in the chaotic mayhem; Paint the environment strategically to reveal hidden paths and gain an advantage over other players; Choose your playstyle: quickly ambush opponents or embrace stealth, covering your footprints and minimizing noise. Overload other Goblinks with your ink to make them explode in a spectacular display! Two game modes to choose from: Last Ink Standing and Deathmatch; In the spirit of a Game Jam, there were also plenty of features that were cut for time. Among them are: A Splatoon-inspired gamemode , where the goal is to paint as much of the map as possible; Team Deathmatch , where players team up under the same color; Ammunition and Powerups ; An option for all gamemodes that would make players invisible as well as the labyrinth, forcing players to adopt a more 'hunting' approach; Multiple premade levels , rather than just one, including a circular labyrinth; Sudden Death for all gamemodes, where after a configurable timer, walls would disappear to speed things up; Shifting labyrinth walls; Much-needed improvements to net code - from client side prediction to server-side rewind; Persistent data related features, such as player level and match rewards that would typically be used to unlock cosmetics and such; Join us on Discord and let us know if you'd like to see LabyrInk developed to its full potential!
row.short_description: LabyrInk is the result of a 5-day Game Jam. It's an exciting third person shooter where the environment starts out completely invisible. You and other Goblinks must paint it up in order to reveal a path to your opponents. Features two distinct game modes: Last One Standing and Deathmatch.

row.name: Aftershock: Coastline
row.detailed_description: Explore a post-calamity military bunker... Piece together a tragic mystery... Master 3 distinct weapons. .. Battle other-worldly monstrosities... Scavenge for resources... And get out alive!
row.short_description: A thrilling retro-styled shooter with survival-horror elements, inspired by the design of Resident Evil and the atmosphere of Bioshock. Spend an hour delving deep into a seaside bunker in an uncanny land, uncovering its secrets and surviving against the cosmic terrors which dwell within.

There is also an 'Ask the Spirit World' option, where you think of a yes/no question and the Spirit World (random number generator) will answer yes or no.

row.name: Trans Ops - Transitional Operations
row.detailed_description: Fun, Fast Paced, Third Person Tactical Shooter. 11 Original Maps (more to come!) with well-known game modes such as, Capture the Flag, Team Death Match, Control Points, and many more. Trans Ops is a Multiplayer Shooter that also offers Single player modes for those players who just want to 'warm up' against the in-game AI. BOTS! Both Single player and Multiplayer modes offer playing the Bots that use the same weapons you use and complete the same game mode objectives! Difficulty settings for bots, giving a fair chance or making things impossible! Trans Ops was created in Unreal Engine 5.1 and updated to Unreal Engine 5.4 with Lumen Global lighting and Lumen Reflections. This giving the game a smooth, clean, crisp look! - Currently Multiplayer Sessions are User Created. Lobby Sessions have been added to the game. The plan is to have dedicated servers running lobbies where players vote to transition in and out of maps and modes working as a team completing different operations. Features: Single player and Multiplayer! Bots, AI that will hunt you down and complete objectives in the game mode. Game Modes with Respawn and one life. 9 Game modes including, Team Deathmatch, Search and Destroy, Control Points, Team Elimination, Rush, Capture the Flag, Kill Confirm, and Free for All! More to come. 11 Original Maps and many more to come! 16 different characters, 8 SWAT 8 MERC. More to come including Female variant and customizations. Loadout includes, AR's, SMG's, Sniper Rifles, LMG's, Pistols, Shotguns, Grenades, Claymores and many more to come! Character Classes, Assault, Support and Medic offering different in game perks for players to use, ei: health, ammo. Pick up teammates or enemies weapons from ground after they die, ammo refills on select maps and modes. Kill Steaks and UAV's In game HUD that works with UAV System. Spectate Mode In game menus for options/setting, also allowing you to switch teams and load out User Created Multiplayer Sessions, Dedicated Servers will be coming soon.
row.short_description: Trans Ops, Fun, Fast Paced, Third Person, Tactical Shooter with 9 different Game Modes, and 11 All Original Maps!

row.detailed_description: Okashi Towers is a Real Time Strategy game with Tower Defense elements. Gather candy resources to build defensive tower units or go on the offensive and summon creatures to attack other player bases. A mixture of tower defense and RTS. Control a base and spend candy resources to summon upgradable tower units to build defenses and increase the amount of candy resources received over time. Spend resources to summon offensive units that can be controlled individually in an RTS style to find and destroy enemy units and their base through fog of war. Solo Story Mode Campaign Online Multiplayer Up to 8 Players Play with any combination of up to 8 Teams and 8 Players (or NPCs) Create custom designed maps in the Map Builder 4 Factions to choose from, each with a different play style Multi-language Support Artwork by Shiruht

row.name: RAINETTE
row.detailed_description: RAINETTE is a simple yet frustrating 3D platformer with a focus on smooth and tactile movement. Explore levels, set the best times, and get cool cosmetics! Movement Set the best times with precise and momentum based movements. Cosmetics Find hidden cosmetics in levels, or beat them to unlock colorful skins. All free. Game Features: Smooth movement: All the movement in RAINETTE is made to give the player unique controls. Free cosmetics: Every possible cosmetic in RAINETTE is freely attainable. row.short_description: Rainette is an indie 3D platformer. Explore levels, get cosmetics, and get the best times!

row.name: Starship Traders MMO
row.detailed_description: Surf the stars looking for Aliens, wormholes, and unclaimed loot. Trade with ports or excavate planets to earn money. With cash, you can buy drones for Alien hunting. Even low-level Aliens carry cash and may well have a better Starship than yours. Since combat costs resources, you'll want to ensure that you can win before engaging in battle. Even when you win, however, you won't always show a profit from the loot. Even so, an honorable kill will earn you experience and honor. Your ship will launch with a large amount of fuel, and you'll incrementally gather more fuel whether you're active or offline. Movement takes very little fuel, especially if you travel light. But some activities burn much more. Repeatedly scanning for nearby starships will consume fuel far faster than travel. Towing large objects around with your ship also costs a lot of fuel. One last bit of advice; don't attack any ships lower level than yourself until you're quite clear on the risks. You can become flagged as 'open loot' for that and it brings several disadvantages. First and most importantly, you'll become an honorable target for everyone -- which means that anyone can attack you without penalty and loot your cash and ship if they win. Avoid flagging yourself and your ship and cash will be safe in combat. Second, your ship normally disappears after a short cool down period when you log off. But if you're flagged, your ship remains visible until the flag expires. And, lastly, any stealth effects that you may have are disabled while you are flagged. Note that none of those penalties apply if you attack an 'open loot' flagged ship -- of any level. Flagged ships are easy to identify by their red nameplates. ~ ~ ~ A short introduction to Starship Traders MMO Starship Traders MMO looks like a cross between a modern MMO and a graphical version of a traditional MUD (Multi User Dungeon). The player starts out in an unknown galaxy in a minimalist space ship, having been lured there as a would-be colonist to an Earth-like planet that doesn't actually exist. The backstory is told by the mechanics at trading posts and is part of a mission (quest). As a stranded space ship pilot, the player's first goal is to learn to survive in their new environment, first trading among the ports and planets and, later, hunting aliens for cash and ship upgrades. Players can create corporations or apply to join an existing one. Members can share defensive resources and pool their power to monopolize a valuable star cluster. Wormholes to star clusters can ususlly be guarded and wormholes to other galaxies can be indirectly, but temporarily, guarded as well. The MMO requires a keyboard to play -- and is optimized for efficient play by fast typists. While it has full mouse support, it is not particularly suited to heavy mouse use.
row.short_description: A sci-fi sandbox MMO where players explore galaxies, hunt aliens, and form corporations to combine forces for larger opportunities.

row.name: TrainCraft
row.detailed_description: Step back in time with TrainCraft, the retro-style game that puts you in the driver's seat of a bustling railway operation. As the chief engineer, it's up to you to plan and execute the perfect train routes, avoid delays and keep your trains running on schedule. Experience the thrill of managing a complex network of tracks and delivery of goods. Plan your routes wisely to pick up and deliver goods and passengers, all while trying to keep on schedule. Manage resources and population to build thriving outposts and cities ... With retro-style graphics and a nostalgic chip tune soundtrack, Train Logistics is a game that will transport you back to the golden age of railroading. If you're a fan of strategy and simulation games, or just love trains, then TrainCraft is the perfect game for you. Download now and take control of your own railway empire!
row.short_description: A nostalgic, retro train management game.

row.name: WarSphere
row.detailed_description: You take the role of an NC3 AI-Chip that emulates the neural correlates of consciousness, an artificial brain, operating a highly effective Armed Spherical Robotic System, aka a WarSphere. An entity called 'Mother' overrides your purpose and sends you on a journey of destruction, the meaning of which will only unravel at your final destination. WarSphere is a game for those who like challenging, skill-based games, that are unforgiving, but rewarding. Death in WarSphere is permanent, which gives you an adrenaline-charged, high-stakes experience. Every run and every world is randomly generated, giving WarSphere a high level of replayability. ENDGAME Unlike other roguelikes, in WarSphere you get to keep a copy of the final setup and loadout with which you successfully beat a run. This storage is called 'The Archive'. Depending on the difficulty you played, you will be able to unlock and experience different end game activities, which include: 4 realms, with 4 tiers each, ranked arcade mode, daily time trials with leaderboards and community maps. EXPERIENCE the most presumptuous camera perspective since the existence of video games the adrenaline from nearly dying in higher levels the frustration of actually dying in higher levels the reward of completing a run successfully the pride in your unlocked Archive Entries the joy of beating endgame realms and community maps with your Archive Entries the affordable humor of random adjective/name combinations KEY FEATURES 4 BILLION seeded runs! 5 Worlds, with several Dungeons each (2 in free base game + 3 in DLC) 60+ Enemy Types (25 in free base game + 35 in DLC) Randomized Elite and Minion enemies 32 Elite Modifiers 10 Primary Weapon Types 10 Secondary Weapon Types 12 ACM Types (Special Abilities) 6 Upgrades Tons of item modifications 15 Character Multipliers, that are upgraded with items and chips Map Editor Extensive enemy modding, integrated in the Map Editor
row.short_description: WarSphere is a fast-paced, roguelike top-down shooter. As a spherical death robot, you blast, dash and loot your way through procedurally generated worlds. It's all about the pew pew.

row.name: The Case of the Serialized Killer
row.detailed_description: When a popular illustrator is found dead, disgraced demonologist Harold Ludicael is hired to summon her ghost. Ghosts are the one thing he can't summon, but with sharp insight, perhaps he can solve the mystery, and resurrect the most important thing: His career. We hope you enjoy our fantasy tale with creeping monsters, summoning magic, and a cast of rich, colorful characters. It has: 20,000 words/about 3 hours of playtime Point and Click Investigation Traditionally painted watercolor characters and locations A journal which keeps track of a colorful list of suspects and lore A variable set of bad endings, and one true ending, depending on which suspect you choose! Meet the cast:
row.short_description: Delve into a devilishly delightful world of mysticism and mystery as Harold Ludicael, the disgraced demonologist. After the untimely demise of a famous illustrator, you’re tasked with solving their murder in this point-and-click visual novel.

row.name: Fantastic Dream
row.detailed_description: A short story about ten minutes process. —————————————————————————— I dreamed of a girl. Meet, heart, hug, kiss, with her. I can't remember her face, but still remember her temperature. I want to see her again. 'It's just a man's fantasy.' I warned and laughed at myself. But since that day, I've seen her in my dreams every day. Is it that I'm so sick inside? Or is there something affecting me that I don't know about？ I have no clue. It's just that I'm starting to expect, except to seeing her every day in dreams.
row.short_description: I dreamed of a girl. From then on, I saw her every day in my dreams. I don't know why it happened. I can only keep telling myself that it is all false, all illusion. But on the other hand, I fell in love with it.

row.name: UnVoiced
row.detailed_description: human forest red wolf The green and red of the deep forest. Deep forest, green and red. forest green and red And did she find hope and shed tears?
row.short_description: The stage is the fairy tale 'Little Red Riding Hood' Two players work together and aim to escape from the forest by controlling 'Little Red Riding Hood' and 'Wolf', each with different actions.

row.name: Desktop Mark
row.detailed_description: This is Mark. And that's about it. Every time he hits a side of your screen, he rebounds, and speeds up just a little bit . Sometimes, however, he hits the exact corner in a satisfying bounce. That's a signal to stop the work you're supposed to be doing, and play a little game with Mark . Hit the corner? Procrastinate easily with 10 small minigames that are just fun enough to take your mind off your work. From classics like Snake, sneaking through mazes, skydiving, chess and even beating up your brother, Desktop Mark has just what you need to scratch your entertainment itch! Every minigame earns you Mark bucks, which you can then use to customise Mark with over 25 Marks, 40 hats and 10 corner-hit sounds. Make Mark your own, earn achievements and play games. Yeah, that's Desktop Mark. FAQ Does he bounce around your real computer? Yes ! He's always on top and transparent, so you can do anything else whilst he bounces. How often does he hit the corner? Depending on what you've got the acceleration set to, around every 15 minutes . Do I need to have a corner hit to play minigames? Nope! For a small amount of Mark bucks, you can play any minigame at any time, and even profit! How many hours of gameplay will I get? Don't expect hours of content. Depending on how you play, you can have Mark as a simple distraction widget or grind minigames to buy every costume you can.
row.short_description: Desktop Mark is a simple minigame-centric idler revolving around the silly character of Mark, a smiley that bounces all around your screen. Every so often, Mark hits the corner and prompts you to procrastinate & have some fun with Mark.

row.name: Mecha BREAK
row.detailed_description: After the Catastrophe, humanity harnessed the power of Corite—a mysterious carbon-silicon mineral, driving rapid recovery. But its fatally pathogenic nature and relentless spread threaten to consume Earth's last habitable spaces within decades. Should humankind resist? Adapt? Escape? Or follow Corite's call and forge a new path? Unveil the secrets of Corite and safeguard the future! Join S.H.A.D.O.W., and deploy your BREAK Strikers now! Choose from attackers, brawlers, snipers, defenders, or support. Battle at breakneck speed across three action-packed modes: Ace Arena (3v3), Operation VERGE (6v6), and Operation STORM (PvPvE). Evade beams, weave through explosions, and dominate the battlefield! 3v3 or 6v6 Dive into the 3v3 Ace Arena, where victory justifies any cost, or dominate the objective-based 6v6 Operation VERGE, where skill and strategy turn the tide! Brace for adrenaline-fueled battles featuring lightning-fast maneuvers and explosive firepower. Engage in close quarters with a battle-axe, halberd, or laser sword, mastering blocks and deadly parries. Prefer ranged combat? Snipe from the shadows, blast through defenses with energy beams, or rain down destruction with a missile barrage. PvPvE Extraction Go solo or squad up with three mechs to infiltrate the massive, Corite-rich Mashmak Islands and compete against rival teams for resources. Charge into action with your BREAK Strikers—seize supplies, take down colossal targets, infiltrate restricted zones, and annihilate enemy forces. With Pulse Storms spreading fast, it's a race against time. Complete your objectives, upgrade your arsenal with special materials, and return safely! Customization Make your mark on the battlefield with fully customized mechs and pilots! Choose from an endless array of colors, insignias, patterns, and accents to craft your unique mecha masterpiece. These aren't just war machines—they're the embodiment of your spirit! Characters Explore your base and uncover its secrets. Unlock and team up with elite pilots, each with a rich backstory, crucial to humanity's survival. Prepare to fight with your allies and forge a new future!
row.short_description: Squad up in Mecha BREAK, a multiplayer third-person shooter offering three intense game modes filled with ground and aerial combat. Pilot your Striker into the breach and neutralize enemies. Are you ready for the ultimate showdown?
row.notes: Some game content contains revealing clothing and general mature content and may not be suitable for all ages.

row.name: Land Above Sea Below Prologue
row.detailed_description: FULL GAME IS NOW AVAILABLE! About the Game Immerse yourself in the tranquil world of the eternal autumn, where your goal is to build and expand your self-built island as wisely as possible to avoid being washed away by the ever-rising sea levels. Land Above Sea Below is a fine-tuned mixture of the landscape builder, puzzle, and strategy genre, with fun and constantly challenging gameplay, yet with a nice and calm atmosphere. Your imagination is the only limit - from the infinitely available, procedurally generated tiles you can build the island of your dreams. Build majestic forests, cascading rivers, and lovely villages. Synergies can be created throughout properly placed groups of tiles, so your entire island can be positively affected by the placement of a single tile. Keeping this in mind from the very beginning of the game is a must. A forward-looking strategy is the key to success. With careful planning, you can place similar tiles that interact with each other in their best possible location. These interactions result in a height increase and award you with valuable points that can be transferred to essential aids during the game. By achieving certain score points, you can unlock different rewards, like extra steps in the season, a sea level decrease, or even a new Tree of Fall. The flood is coming at the end of every season. You need to ensure that your island - or at least your starting tile on which the Tree of Fall grows, is at a safe distance from sea level. Features Procedurally generated tiles - you will have infinitely available, procedurally generated tiles that you can lay on the map. This method ensures, that every island you create, and every new game you play, will be unique, and unrepeatable. Autumn groves, rivers, rocky mountains, forests, villages, and sea items will inhabit your map. Island extensions - as you progress in expanding your island and exploring undiscovered areas on the map, you might bump into lonely, tiny islands. If you connect your main island to them, these islands (its tiles) will be attached to your land. Infinite gameplay mode - your goal is to keep the Tree Of Fall alive. As long as this tile is above sea level, the game continues. The length of the game only depends on how long you can survive. Minimalistic style - we deliver precisely handcrafted beautiful biomes in the game, with the minimalistic style that we love so much. This demo showcases a work-in-progress game. We used a season cap as a limitation, and we have reduced the availability of tile versions, but you will be able to taste the atmosphere and dive into the game's world. Put us on your wishlist and join us on Discord if you have enjoyed this early release demo version to follow us on the journey of completing our game!
row.short_description: Land Above Sea Below Prologue is an atmospheric first chapter of the building strategy and puzzle game where you have to build your island from tiles in order to raise its height as much as possible, to avoid it getting flooded by the constantly rising sea level.

row.name: Just A Walk In The Park Playtest
Remains Of The Past
row.detailed_description: =| WELCOME TO FREDDY`S ARCHIVE |= A n old company focused on creating entertaining eateries featuring singing animatronics - closes down after a series of accidents. Several attempts to rebuild fail, the company's reputation is permanently tarnished, and they fade into the shadows. One of the former owners leaves town, and a warehouse is built on the site of his house to store the equipment and property of the former restaurants. After many years, an advertisement appears in the newspapers for a night guard position at the old abandoned 'Freddy`s Archive' warehouse -|[A QUIET CITY WITH A SAD PAST:]|- L ocal journalist Alex receives a letter from his long-missing father, asking him to visit an old family warehouse to learn more about his life. Fearing danger, he calls his friends to join him. Together, they travel far beyond the city to find something that was hidden long ago... Meanwhile, there are sudden earthquakes in the city, causing the inhabitants of the city to be in danger, and some are forced to leave the city, while the rest believe that something bigger is involved, and all the clues lead to an old cursed warehouse not far outside the city called 'Freddy`s Archive' ///Welcome to the Freddy's Archives:\[/i][/b][/h2] A n adventure where you'll delve into the tragic history of a once-popular company as you uncover more and more eerie secrets! Will you be able to live up to their reputation, or will you confirm the old legends that haunt this place! Something terrible is rising from the depths, something that should have been dead long ago is making itself known. trapped, you are not alone - old robots gripped by a strange energy are after you. Investigate the various locations, gather more details about the company's past affairs, and escape the clutches of creepiness and fear alive! - You are alone in a small room and they are coming for you! - Danger is behind every door, be more vigilant: - Explore, and hide, they are faster than you! You've never been alone...
row.short_description: Welcome to Freddy's Archives, an old abandoned warehouse with some of the creepiest legends around! Alex, Steve, and Jesse - investigating paranormal activity, decide to visit this creepy place to find something interesting

row.name: TECHNOPHOBIA: DO ANDROIDS GO TO HEAVEN?
row.detailed_description: General Description: ' Technophobia: DAgtH? ', is a science fiction story about a dystopian world where Androids , Cyborgs , and Nanomachines run rampant in society. To counteract the fear of these man-made horrors, the U.S. government established the 'Facility of Evangelical Science and American Computing' (or FESAC) to use humans and their own androids (known as (F)AENGI-Ls) to hunt down these creations, and either capture them or destroy them. You play as Jahmir, a teenage part-time college student, tasked with rescuing engineers from all-powerful androids known as 'DEMUNs'. 'Technophobia' at its core, is a criticism and analysis of the use of AI and Android technology in all aspects of society, and tries to highlight both its benefits and faults. Gameplay Description (Features): Estimated Playtime : 2 - 4 hours. General Gameplay Desc. - 'Technophobia: DAgtH?', is an open-world-lite, narrative FPS, with some aspects which can be considered 'horror'. This game is somewhat linear, but you are encouraged to explore the large, snowy forest you find yourself in. There are secrets and collectibles (which can influence the ending of your game if you find them all). Main Characters - You play as a human named 'Jahmir' and an AENGI-L named 'Ani-4' (Ania). They're tasked with going to the nearby national park and capturing/killing any android they find, and rescuing the kidnapped engineers. While there, they will need to fend off the robotic 'Mosquitos' and 'Weeping Angels' that plague the park. FPS Action - You use an M16 Rifle and an AA12 shotgun while out in the forest. Since you're a new hire, you aren't given much ammo, so it must be used sparingly. Not every enemy must be engaged. Multiple Enemy Types - There are 5 types of enemies with unique attributes about them that make them hard to kill. There are Weeping Angels, Fallen Weeping Angels, Mosquitos, Fallen Mosquitos, and DEMUNs, all patrolling and looking for unwanted visitors, aka, you. Dialogue - This is a narrative game. There are multiple people in the Hub area you can talk to to learn more about the world of Technophobia and the people themselves, before going on a mission. There are also dialogue choices. Your dialogue choices do not affect the ending of the game but are there to learn more about the story. Collectables - There are hidden collectables to be found in the forest. Finding them all will unlock the ability to have the true ending of Technophobia: DAgtH. PSX Graphics - This game has a PSX-lite style of graphics. The graphics are not true to the original PlayStation(s), but it takes inspiration from the style! Multiple Levels - There are 5 main story levels. Upon completing the game, you can choose to play through an extension of the story as the android, 'Ania'. Ania's extension has an extra 2 levels. There are 7 levels in total. A Punishing Game - If you get hit once, you die. Use the Watchtowers in the forest to save your progress as there is no autosaving! Note: Controls are able to be changed in-game. WASD - Move Left Shift - Run Space - Jump Left Control - Crouch Fire - Mouse Button 0 Zoom In - Mouse Button 1 Flashlight - F Reload - R Interact - E R.P.M.E. - V Waypoint - Q Info Screen - Tab or I Pause - Escape or P Change Weapon - Scroll Wheel or Number Keys 1-9 (Not changeable) Epilepsy and Content Disclaimers: Epilepsy Warning - This game CONTAINS fast and flashing lights. This may cause visual discomfort, and headaches, and/or could trigger seizures for those with Photosensitive Epilepsy. If you currently suffer or HAVE SUFFERED from Photosensitive Epilepsy in the past, please note that you may be at risk, and should reconsider buying and/or viewing this game. Content Warning - This game also contains vulgar and brash language, as well as violent acts, racist swears and racial themes, and some general topics that some may find offensive and not be comfortable with. Please understand this before continuing to play.
row.short_description: 'Technophobia: DAgtH' is a Narrative FPS Adventure where you're tasked with rescuing FESAC Engineers kidnapped by terroristic androids in a dark forest, all while discussing the ethics of using androids and AI in our daily lives. Is AI truly better than humans?
row.notes: This product contains depictions of violence, adult language, racial themes, and commentary on relevant social and cultural issues. Some players may find this content uncomfortable or off-putting.

row.name: The snow Reach
row.detailed_description: '雪境公园' is a highly customizable turn-based card battle game that enhances the traditional card game format. Players can control their own designed followers to defeat opponents in the enchanting world of 'Snowscape.' Personalized Character Design: Create unique characters by utilizing diverse skills. Diverse Character Collection: Collect various leaders and followers to create your exclusive team. Strategic System: You have the freedom to customize rules such as cost, health, and leader abilities. Adventure for Resources: Venture into the Snowscape to obtain precious resources and aid the growth of the asylum. Exciting Battle Experience: Challenge others with your customized team and strive for victory. With high customization, no two battles are the same. Daily Tasks and Challenges: Engage in a variety of daily tasks and challenges to ensure long-lasting enjoyment and constant freshness. Random Relics and Events: Discover mysterious relics and encounter rich events within randomized encounters, providing surprises in every game. The story combines elements of new folklore and the historical backdrop of the early 20th century, intertwining peculiar historical events with supernatural themes. Set in a closed and snowy environment, the game focuses on deep storytelling and intricate details, aiming to create a genuine psychological supernatural atmosphere. The unique aspect of the game lies in the refinement of CCG gameplay. Instead of creating a purely CCG game, we extract the captivating elements of CCG gameplay and combine them with Roguelike and turn-based mechanics, allowing more people to experience the charm of CCG games. The gameplay is simplified, yet offers multiple optional rules, making the basics of the game accessible while providing intriguing variations to explore.
row.short_description: '雪境公园' is a highly customizable CCG tactical strategy game. You can combine various unique abilities to create your own personalized followers. The game focuses on Roguelike elements and player versus player battles.

row.name: Yokai Art: Survival Prologue
row.detailed_description: WISHLIST THE FULL GAME About the Game Standalone survival mode from the original game Yokai Art: Night Parade of One Hundred Demons Story By accident, you broke the seal of the mysterious book in your household's storage. The mythical book contains enormous magical power that allows users to control any Yokai by defeating them and recording their names. This godly power is too much, which alerts all the Yokai. So they are coming for the power. You must find your way to defeat and survive. Roguelike Tower Defense Welcome to an engaging gaming experience! Strategically position units on a chess-based battlefield, defending territories while earning roguelike upgrade-items for leveling up. Discover over 30 unique equipment pieces that modify units, allowing for exciting customization. Each battle offers diverse strategies and experiences, ensuring endless excitement and replayability. Units and skills Unleash the power of 15 main and support units, each with unique specialties and diverse roles. From high-dps damage dealers to resilient tanks, healers, buffers, and masters of status effects, assemble a formidable team. Evolve your units to their final forms and harness their true potential. Utilize power stones to unleash their tailored and devastatingly powerful skills. Prepare to dominate the battlefield with your strategically upgraded and specialized forces. Boss Challenge Confront mini-bosses, prove your strategy skills, and face the ultimate challenge: the Skeleton King. Survive until the last minute and emerge victorious in this thrilling adventure.
row.short_description: Strategically position units on a chess-based battlefield, defending territories while earning roguelike upgrade-items for leveling up. Discover over 30 unique equipment pieces that modify units, allowing for exciting customization and ensuring endless excitement and replayability.

row.name: Moose Lost in the Woods
row.detailed_description: Get lost in a beautiful forest. Run around and have fun discovering new areas. Do it your way, at your pace! Collect different goodies such as pine cones for trading, wooden planks for building, and fun items like hats! How many pine cones can you find? This game is almost entirely illustration-based! No text = No problem! No matter who you are, what language you speak, or what level of reader you are - we want you to be able to enjoy this game! Collect cool hats and feel fashionable throughout your adventure! How many hats will you get? Find out by exploring every nook and cranny around the forest! Make new friends and help them along the way of your journey! We are Spång Studios, a tiny and close nit group of students studying game design in Sweden! We have come together during this three month long project to develop a fun adventurous game. We are super excited to work on more projects in the future and hope to see you once again soon!
row.short_description: Moose Lost in the Woods is a cozy 3D platformer without a language barrier. Explore by running, leaping, bouncing, and splashing around in Swedish forest environments, whilst stuffing your backpack with goodies!

row.name: Time Survivors: Chapter 0
row.detailed_description: This is the free Chapter 0 to Time Survivors , a rogue-like bullet hell game where you can play as legendary historical characters like Abe Lincoln, Tesla, Cleopatra, and more, each now wielding unique custom abilities that revolutionize gameplay. Transform into a flying ninja robot as Oda Nobunaga, create defensive barriers made of cherry trees as Abe Lincoln, or set the battlefield ablaze as Nero - the choice is yours. Each character brings a unique touch to every run , making each playthrough a unique adventure. Travel through time and fight hordes of memorable enemies as you unravel a mystery. With over 150 different weapons, items, Relics, and buffs to choose from, every run is a unique experience. Fight skeletons in the Medieval Age, Velociraptors and T-Rexes in the Stone Age, and discover plenty of quests and secrets along the way. But that's not all - Time Survivors: Chapter 0 presents a new meta progression system, allowing you to unlock and upgrade characters, weapons, and stages, even game mode modifiers , using gold and resources collected during your runs. Tailor your progression to your preferred playstyle and strategically allocate resources to create your own game-breaking build. 2 stages full of enemies, secrets, mini bosses and end-stage bosses: The Dark Age and The Stone Age 8 unlockable characters from the entire human history, each with their own unique ability ! 32 different weapons and buffs to choose from for a unique experience every run 8 Cursed Relics 41 different enemies 35 Unlockables Play as epic historic characters, each with their unique ability Tree-based meta progression for all elements in the game Casual quick 20 minute play sessions + plenty of quests and secrets to discover A Sandbox mode to test any overpowered build and train against any enemy And since you've come this far... don't forget to wishlist the full game to stay up-to-date on the latest features and updates!
row.short_description: Free CHAPTER 0 for Time Survivors, the Most Historically Inaccurate Roguelike ever. Slay hordes impersonating Lincoln, Tesla, Cleopatra, and other historic heroes with unique abilities! Collect resources, unlock secrets, and enhance gameplay through skill-tree meta-progression

row.name: After School
row.detailed_description: If you've ever dreamed of taking on your school teacher with your water gun, After School is for you! Play as a child in his playground in this dynamic third-person shooter! Confront numerous enemies with different behaviors! Collect cardboard boxes and craft powerful objects to survive the nightmare waves! Achieve the highest possible scores and beat the strongest competitors! Manage your water to survive as long as possible! This game was made as part of the Ubisoft 2023 university contest . It was made in 10 weeks with the Arcade theme. Thanks to our friends and family for playtesting and supporting us in this huge project! Also, a special thanks to: eSPACE for playtesting our game Centre Libourne kindergarden and the kids who made amazing drawings Ubisoft for organizing this contest To enjoy After School, it's important to play it with a controller.
row.short_description: If you've ever dreamed of taking on your school teacher with your water gun, After School is for you! Play as a child in his playground in this dynamic third-person shooter!

row.name: Motorbike Evolution 2024
row.detailed_description: I have been creating this game since high school and have worked hard through my studies at Charles University in Prague. My aim for this year is to carry over my Ph.D. research about procedurally generated terrains into my game. I aim to capture 150 years of racing in a game one day. Motorbike Evolution is a multiplayer racing game that uses principles similar to those of World of Tanks. With each race against 39 other players, you gain experience and credits, for which you can buy various upgrades for your vehicle or unlock newer vehicles. You start with machines from the 1900s. Can you get to the very top and ride on modern machinery? Controls are simplified enough to give you still the passion of riding but not too complex to take you hours to learn. It mainly focuses on providing players with the best enjoyment from racing fights. The game's core is short, dynamic races with a high action density. The feeling from the ride is very reminiscent of older games; do not expect a hardcore simulator. On the other hand, it's not a mario kart racing game - there are physics, and you need to keep that in mind. - 80 motorbikes from 120 years of history - 40 real and custom tracks - 1000+ various vehicle setups - 30+ vehicle patterns, each customizable - 10 different biomes Using a simple yet rich customization system, you can customize your vehicle and rider as much as you want. For example, you can paint your motorbikes with any combination of colors or use any of the available patterns to customize them! The game is based on custom cloud-saving technology. As part of that, it contains many classic MMO features like cloud save, leaderboards, daily missions, achievements, and stats! Compare yourself to other racers!
row.short_description: The first-ever true MMO motorbike racing game is here! Play with up to 39 friends!

row.name: Tempo Mayhem
row.detailed_description: Every character has a tempo that must be matched, but you must choose the correct attack. Choosing incorrectly can result in a penalty. In order to destroy a target, you must not miss a beat. Missing a beat or choosing the wrong attack resets the enemies health gauge. Fill the health gauge to destroy the enemy. The game has 15 rounds starting with a pre-tutorial round. There are various enemy types and each round has a unique combination that you must learn to overcome. There is also a dash movement ability that makes the game fast paced. Use this to avoid enemy attacks, or use it to close the distance so that you can land a melee beat.
row.short_description: Shoot, punch, and cast to the enemies beat. Survive chaotic and dynamic tempo driven rounds. Dash to keep within tempo range or dash to avoid incoming damage.

row.name: While waiting my turn
row.detailed_description: About Ever found yourself captivated by constructing small sculptures with board game pieces while waiting your turn to play? Welcome to this small sandbox game that embraces this very experience. Immerse yourself in the meditative process of building mesmerizing structures, allowing time to slip away unnoticed. Move and stack various pieces to construct captivating structures. Arrange and rearrange them to bring your imagination to life. Enter a realm of boundless creativity with in this sandbox game. In this unrestricted environment, there are no limits or constraints. Build to your heart's content, experiment with different designs, and let your imagination run wild. A stress-free experience with no time limits or puzzles to solve. A world where the only limit is your imagination. Explore endless possibilities and let your artistic flair shine. Stack , create , and enjoy the blissful process of building extraordinary structures in this captivating small game.
row.short_description: Discover the joy of building tiny structures with board game pieces in this relaxing and small sandbox game. Stack and create unique buildings. Construct whatever you want – no puzzles to solve, no races to win.

row.name: Cervus Blade
row.detailed_description: Cervus Blade is an enchanting third-person action adventure game that takes players on an epic journey through a deer-worship desert world. Engage in high-octane combat, testing your skills in challenging encounters, unleash the power of the Blade and become a legend in this captivating adventure. DEER HUNT Step into the shoes of a Hunter on a mission to rid the land of corruption and filth left behind by the ancient god Cervus in this action-packed adventure. BLADE UNLEASHED Prepare for a thrilling and challenging combat system that encompasses defense, dodging, summoning and more. Engage in epic battles, showcasing your skills and mastery as you navigate through an adrenaline-fueled world. SANDS OF REVELATION Explore a breathtaking yet perilous desert world, where a cult devoted to deer holds secrets. Unveil the truth behind their rituals as you embark on an immersive journey of discovery. Cervus Blade is an MFA thesis project at the University of Southern California by Tianyue Gu, developed with help of Team Blade. For more information, please visit our publisher page. To learn more about the USC Games program, the #1 Games Program in the world, check out the USC Games website, linked to the right.
