Make some noise (and some enemies) in this action-packed party shooter for 4! Utilize your unique energy shots, power-up your attacks with an array of pick-ups, and get set to take down the competition!! 4 players enter the arena…but the Curse of the Golden Idol demands that only 1 may leave. …will it be you? 🔷A 4-Way Battle Royale Shooter Extravaganza!🔷 You get a gun, they get a gun. Everybody gets a gun! Shoot your way to victory and be the last Hunter standing! 🔷Watch Your Back Out There!🔷 Who to aim for and when to do it, careful consideration of your and your enemies’ resources could nab you victory…or see you lose it all! Can you make the right decisions under pressure? Only time will tell… 🔷The Golden Idol’s Curse! 🔷 ime Hunters are equipped with special guns…and special bullets. Bounce shots off walls to catch your foes off-guard! And oh, what’s this? The Golden Idol demands a good fight! Pick up glowing, Golden Idols scattered round the arena, and augment your shots with various buffs for maximum mayhem! ＞BOMB Shot＜ Penetrates walls and SHIELDs. Use it for explosive results! ＞BIG Shot＜ Size matters. Fire away and leave them with nowhere to run! ＞3-WAY Shot＜ A 3-WAY spreadshot. Never let them know your next move! ＞BOUNCE Shot＜ More BOUNCE, more mileage. Ricochets 3 times for off-the-wall fun! ＞SHIELD＜ Protect yourself from devastation...once! (Look out for BOMBs though!) 🔷Two Buffs are Better than One!!🔷 Does the power of the Golden Idol know no bounds!? (2, the bounds is 2) Grab 2 different buffs, and reap the benefits of both at once. row.name: Dark Ride Simulator
row.detailed_description: Blue Squid Theme Parks presents the VR simulator of their most popular ride The Dark Zone. No need for long trips, now you can experience this iconic ride from the comfort of your own home. Point the torch at the animatronic monsters to earn points. Fun for the whole family! Ride length: 5 Minutes Features: - Immersive audio! - Realistic re-creation of the real Blue Squid Theme Park! - Minigame to point the torch at the animatronic monsters!
row.short_description: Blue Squid Theme Parks presents the VR simulator of their most popular ride The Dark Zone. No need for long trips, now you can experience this iconic ride from the comfort of your own home.

row.name: Game of Crafts: VR Immersion in the World of Russian Folk Art
row.detailed_description: Put on your virtual reality goggles and let your imagination run wild. Together with an AI named Kika, go from an apprentice to a real master of Russian folk crafts. Learn the secrets of ancient artists and save Kika by bringing colors and patterns back to her home. - Feel like an artist! Use VR controllers to select patterns and apply them to objects around you. - Do as you like! Change the size of patterns and choose how to combine them. Nobody prevents you from decorating Kiki's house with a mixture of Zhostovo and Gzhel bouquets. - Modernize traditions! Prove that folk crafts have not gone out of fashion. Paint a motorcycle under Khokhloma? Easily! Cover the sofa with Palekh miniatures? Why not! - Touch history! Find out together with Kika why Gzhel was not always blue and white, and how the Zhostovo and Tagil paintings are related. - Become an explorer! Explore the workshop and open secret niches to find new patterns. - Learn crafting skills! Assemble the painting blanks from the parts hidden all over the place, but make sure they fit together.
row.short_description: In your hands - a palette with dozens of patterns of Russian folk crafts! Discover their secrets with the magical bird Kika. Paint the world around under Gzhel or Khokhloma according to traditions or drop all the rules and form your own folk style to bring colors back to Kiki's house!

row.name: Block, Love, and Ancient Greece
row.detailed_description: A chaotic and entertaining educational game set in ancient Greece! Become the fictional philosopher Epistemonos and get some knowledge by defeating the scholars who stand in your way! Drag letter blocks to merge them and defeat the enemies. Immerse yourself in a topsy-turvy story set in ancient Greece, with a focus on the Acropolis. Developed as a graduation project by the 'The Oath of the Peach Garden' team from Jeonju University's Game Contents Department, this game is designed to provide players with an easier approach to subjects like philosophy, which is weighty and serious atmosphere. Merge the blocks and defeat your enemies! As you drag and merge blocks with the same letter blocks, your character, Epistemonos, immediately attacks against the enemies. Help Epistemonos defeat all the enemies and regain the lost scrolls! Exciting virtual dialogues with scholars! Click on the 'Index' menu on the starting screen to see brief information about the scholars you have defeated and their thoughts. Engage in fictional conversations with eight of these scholars. Through repeated play, unlock the profiles of 17 scholars and make your study of philosophy more enjoyable! Merge blocks and achieve the highest score! In 'Free Mode,' you can merge blocks alone without any battles, accumulating scores with each merge. Strive to set a new high score and challenge yourself to surpass it!
row.short_description: A chaotic educational game set in ancient Greece!Become the fictional philosopher Epistemonos and defeat the scholars who stand in your way!Drag blocks to merge them and defeat the enemies.Immerse yourself in a topsy-turvy story set in ancient Greece, with a focus on the Acropolis.

row.name: Joker Show - Horror Escape
row.detailed_description: Joker Show - Horror Escape - 3D FPS Hide&Seek Game Your parents left for the night, and you stayed at home alone, you were bored and you decided to call the Jester (Joker), but something went wrong... It looks like you succeeded, now the jester wants to play with you, hide and don't let him catch you, find a way to call the jester away. Description of the gameplay: You play as a teenager who is left alone at home and decides to try summoning spirits. Your task is to first find the necessary items for the ceremony, and follow the instructions to call the jester (joker). When you call the jester, he will trap you and lock you in the basement, try to find a way out and escape before the clock strikes 12, because at 12 o'clock at night, the jester will start a show where you will be the main participant! You have 5 hours to escape, or find a way to get rid of the jester, hide, run away, solve puzzles to find a way to escape. Features: Atmospheric graphics Interesting puzzles Excellent optimization
row.short_description: Your parents left for the night, and you stayed at home alone, you were bored and you decided to call the Jester (Joker), but something went wrong... It looks like you succeeded, now the jester wants to play with you, hide and don't let him catch you, find a way to call the jester away.

row.name: Dreamscape Abyss
row.detailed_description: In Dreamscape Abyss, your only goal is to walk and explore your dream worlds. When you fall asleep, you will enter your dream world and you can explore as much as you like before continuing on. Discover new areas and search for unique items that you can use to help your delve deeper into your dreams. Unlike most other games, you will not find any action or heavy dialogue present. Similar to games like LSD Dream Emulator or Yume Nikki, your only goal will be to visit each dream world as you encounter them. Walk through and explore 20+ unique dream worlds found in the game. Collect various items for you to use to navigate to previously unvisited areas. Discover new locations by interacting with objects in the environment such as doors, statues, mushroom creatures, kappa, ghosts, and much more. Most dreams are encountered semi-randomly. The same object you've interacted with before might take you to a new location next time you find it. Wake up and return to reality if you want to exit a dream world at any time. There is a large variety of dreams that you may encounter while sleeping, but there will be no combat or threats to be found. Once you explore every dream, you will know what to do next...
row.short_description: Dreamscape Abyss is a game where you explore the ever-changing and surreal worlds inside of your dreams. Collect items to help you discover even more obscure areas as you delve deeper into your dream world.

row.name: Slimegeon
row.detailed_description: Slimegeon is a 3D third-person roguelike dungeon-crawler game where the player runs through dungeons and possesses defeated enemies to use their abilities and takedown bosses to continue to the next floor. Through the dungeon, the player can level up the unique skill trees for each enemy. The player can also find items that will assist them on their journey.
row.short_description: Slimegeon is a 3D third-person roguelike dungeon-crawler game where the player runs through dungeons and possesses defeated enemies to use their abilities and takedown bosses to continue to the next floor. Through the dungeon, the player can level up the unique skill trees for each enemy.

row.name: Tay Son Dynasty
row.detailed_description: This game is no longer available. Thank you.
row.short_description: This is a fantasy, humorous game set in the Tay Son Dynasty.

row.name: Dungeon Stalkers
row.detailed_description: Join our official Discord Click the link on the right to join DISCORD! 'Dungeon Stalkers' is a PvEvP dungeon crawler game where you can experience the exploration of traditional dungeon RPG and the joy of the escape survival genre. You become a 'Dungeon Stalker,' venturing into dungeons to seek wealth, honor, and truth. Select Stalkers with their own stories and help them grow stronger, fighting alongside trustworthy companions in an ever-changing dungeon environment plagued by the witch's curse. Within the dungeon, various monsters and other Stalkers with their own objectives will threaten your life. Utilize the darkness to defeat them and earn rewards to escape the dungeon! Furthermore, grow stronger with the rewards and fight against the guardians of the witch who rule this dungeon. ・ Fun to play third-person PvEvP dungeon crawler 'Dungeon Stalkers' is a game that combines the essence of traditional dungeon RPGs with the thrill of escape survival, offering you a more enjoyable PvEvP dungeon crawling experience. Use the unique skills possessed by the Stalkers and uncover rare and legendary weapons hidden within the dungeons to defeat monsters and other Stalkers. Safely escape the dungeons with the loot and continue to grow stronger. Then, confront the former heroes deep within the dungeons who have become guardians of the witch's command. Remember, darkness is your ally, and bright places can become dangerous. ・ 'The Witch's Curse' that completely changes the balance of the game. The dungeon created by the cursed witch periodically bestows curses that can completely turn the game upside down. Stalkers must utilize or cope with these curses in order to survive. 'The Witch's Curse' offers a wide range of effects, and some of these effects will ensure that even the strongest stalkers cannot let their guard down for a single moment. ・ The core of strategic battle: 'Armor Destruction' For stalkers, armor is crucial equipment for their own protection. If the armor is destroyed due to enemy attacks, they become significantly unsafe. Without armor, even the strongest stalker can become extremely vulnerable, putting them at risk. Let me say it again! When the situation becomes unfavorable, utilize the darkness!
row.short_description: Dungeon Stalkers is a PvEvP dungeon crawler game where you can experience the joy of exploration and survival in a classic RPG. Join forces with your companions to defeat other adventurers and monsters, and acquire equipment and treasures. Then, escape safely from the witch's curse!
row.notes: The game contains blood and violence, mainly from being attacked and killing other characters and monsters. Some characters' costumes can be revealing.

row.name: Eggsplosion
row.detailed_description: Eggsplosion allows up to 4 players to compete through both Steam Remote Play and local multiplayer. You can play from your computer, tablet, phone or even TV! So make sure to get your friends together and make them eggsplode! The game supports every major controller as well as (probably) almost all others! Use one of the many power-ups to spice up your gameplay! The various different items and combinations allow for fresh and exciting experiences every session! The game currently holds the following power-ups: Freeze Egg, freezes your opponents in place Bounce Egg, will accumulate damage for every bounce so get your angles right! Eggsplosive Egg, yeah this is the big one! Wall Dash, allows you to dash through walls Rapid Fire, removes the fire rate cap Speed Boost, makes you go fast brrrrrrrr Health Boost, will restore some of your health Competitive Mode Last one standing wins! In this mode all that counts is you surviving. Still, it might come in handy to eliminate your opponents while you're at it! Casual Mode Lean back and relax a bit! This mode allows you and your friends to customise the game to your liking. Choose a map, your favourite power-ups and decide on a winning condition. All that's left is having fun!
row.short_description: Eggsplosion is a free local multiplayer twin-stick arena brawler with fighting chickens, bouncing eggs, tons of power-ups and heaps of fun. Eggcellent for a fun evening with your friends!

row.name: Mortanis Prisoners Prologue
row.detailed_description: Mortanis Prisoners Prologue is a first part of the full game: Mortanis Prisoners. Mortanis Prisoners - a survival horror game set in a Third Reich concentration camp where the camp's leadership, upon discovering a planned rebellion, orders the execution of all accomplices. Two main protagonists encounter an even more terrifying fate. Will they be able to escape the nightmare?
row.short_description: Mortanis Prisoners Prologue is a first part of the full game: Mortanis Prisoners.
row.notes: Violence Gore Dismemberment Killing, murder Display of weapon

row.name: Rune Seeker
row.detailed_description: Rune Seeker is a strategy card game with a turn-based format. Each match’s terrain will be generated at random, so players will almost never encounter the same field twice throughout their journeys. We added depth and value to Rune Seeker by incorporating strategy and tactics into almost every action. Not only in the layout of the squad at the beginning of the game, but also in how you construct your squad, develop your base, and collect Runes. In essence, Runes are useless without Heroes and almost so without suitable Heroes. Each Unit has a unique *capacity* specification that determines how many Runes you can bring into the game. There are Heroes with weak attack specs but a large capacity for Runes, and vice versa. Moreover, each Unit will belong to different races and possess distinct skill sets that can be activated passively when it is their turn or actively by Runes. These Heroes are infinitely upgradeable, and their form, strength, abilities, and types evolve over time. Rune sets in Rune Seeker consist of two randomly generated and distinct components. Combinations of 100 times 100 pieces of such can generate up to 10,000 unique Runes. Therefore, players will rarely encounter players with Runes similar to theirs. Besides this factor, the value of Runes also depends on the game meta and their compatibility with player strategies, as opposed to rarity or power. The outcome of battle on the frontline is greatly influenced by what happens in the rear. This is where commanders can build a base system to upgrade and evolve their troops through appropriate utilization of resources.
row.short_description: Uncover the secrets of a world created and destroyed by Runes.

row.name: Tales of Spark: Probation
row.detailed_description: Follow and join us For inquiries about applying for trial play or the latest information about 'Tales of Spark,' please join the wishlist and enter our official group! Discord account: Your attention is welcomed, and your valuable suggestions and feedback are appreciated. About the Game ⛧WISHLIST THE FULL GAME⛧ Game Features: Young warrior, welcome to 'Tales of Spark: Probation.' Here, you will embark on a unique adventure. As a martial artist, you possess dozens of skills, diverse talents, and builds. Master them skillfully, freely combine them, and defeat formidable foes. The probation version offers multiple maps, a wealth of monsters, and powerful bosses that match your abilities and their treasures. Random common equipment, along with dozens of exquisite special gear and items, a 4-hour storyline, and 4 optional difficulty levels.
row.short_description: Dear players, become a young swordsmaster and enter 'Tales of Spark: Probation'! This is a world filled with real-time combat, abundant treasures, a rich storyline, and diverse character builds. Of course, the challenges are also immense, so best of luck to you!

row.name: Pirates of Rectangular
row.detailed_description: 'Shapes are what our world is made of' The Shape Alliance is seeking brave sailors to combat the rebellious Pirates of Rectangular. Can you restore order to the geometric world and end the conflict? Navigate Your Ship! A true captain always has the ship under control! Dodge obstacles and skillfully navigate around your enemies. Utilize Your Weapons! Use the available cannons and rockets to fight against the pirates. Sometimes, it takes more than just words for others to understand you. Don't Let Them Board! Cannonballs are scarce for the pirates, so they'll try to ram your ship and board it! Keep an Eye on Your Surroundings! There are things you'd better avoid! That includes leaking oil barrels that restrict your ship's movement. What are you waiting for? Show us who the one true captain is! Join the fight against the Rectangulars and lead the Shape Alliance to victory!
row.short_description: Pirates of Rectangular is a small indie game in which you fight against pirates in the Rectangular Seas on behalf of the Shape Alliance. Maneuver your ship as skillfully as possible and sink your opponents to end the discussions about the best shape of the geometric world once and for all!

row.name: Cones in Space
row.detailed_description: Welcome, to CONES IN SPACE. The single greatest survival game you will ever play in your lifetime. Cones in Space is a sci-fi survival game where you play as a cone, and you guessed it: in space! In Cones in Space you are tasked with surviving a year on this planet, but it isn't as easy as it seams! After summer a thick poisonous fog covers the planet, and you must plunder the surrounding planets in search of recourses to craft a cure, or suffer a terrible fate.. What can you do in Cones in Space? A good question! There are many epic features in cones in space, these include: >Building Cones in space has many fun building mechanics >Fighting There are many dangerous enemies and bosses available for your fighting! >Crafting In Cones in Space there are many ways to craft epic items >Sailing Since the 2.5 update, the oceans in Cones in Space have been refurbished, with many fun sailing mechanics >trading There are many npcs you can trade with in Cones in Space >exploring In Cones in Space there are over 30+ planets, can you explore them all? >farming Cones in Space features many crops to farm >Building epic auto farms There are many gizmos in Cones in Space, have fun tinkering! If you like super cool space themed survival games, then Cones in Space is a must play for you!
row.short_description: Cones in Space: Literally the best survival game you will ever play.

row.name: Jumpah
row.detailed_description: You're a futuristic alien species on earth and your objective is to make it to the finish line in the fastest time possible, however on your way to the finish line you will encounter obstacles and sharp objects that will send you back to where you started. . Send screenshots to the discord and compare with other players to see who is the best jumpah! (i am not liable for any broken computer equipment) I am a new developer with big plans for this game, if you encounter any bugs i strongly encourage you share them to the discord and i will fix it ASAP. New levels coming very soon. Multiplayer is in beta and you can play with your friends today!
row.short_description: Take the title for the fastest Jumpah alive, and in the process make your friends hate their lives! Parkour, Spleef, Rage, anger, frustration, despair, depression, and lots of colors! What more could you ask for? New maps and game modes coming soon :)

row.name: Worldwide Battle Royale
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Worldwide Battle Royale, the ultimate multiplayer third-person battle royale game that brings together a realistic world, iconic maps, and famous characters! Step into the fray and compete against players from across the globe as you fight for survival and strive to become the last person standing. Explore vast and immersive play areas set in meticulously crafted realistic environments. From sprawling cities to dense forests, desolate deserts to icy tundras, each map offers its own unique challenges and strategic opportunities. Utilize the terrain, seek cover, and outsmart your opponents as you navigate through dynamic landscapes that demand both skill and adaptability. What sets Worldwide Battle Royale apart is the inclusion of legendary characters from various walks of life. Play as renowned heroes, adventurers, and even historical figures, each with their own distinct abilities, strengths, and play styles. Whether you prefer the agility of a nimble assassin, the brute strength of a mighty warrior, or the tactical prowess of a cunning strategist, there's a character perfectly suited to your preferred playstyle. Engage in heart-pounding battles with up to 20 players in free-for-all arenas. Form alliances, forge rivalries, or go it alone as you scavenge for weapons, armor, and resources to bolster your chances of survival. The intense combat mechanics, coupled with the unpredictable nature of the battlefield, will keep you on the edge of your seat as you make split-second decisions and engage in adrenaline-fueled firefights. Compete on a global scale as you climb the ranks, earn prestigious rewards, and showcase your skills to the world. Prepare for an epic battle unlike any other in Worldwide Battle Royale. Join the fray, conquer the competition, and emerge as the ultimate champion in this thrilling multiplayer third-person battle royale game that combines realism, iconic maps, and famous characters for an unforgettable gaming experience. Are you ready to stake your claim in the worldwide arena?
row.short_description: Battle royale game with realistic world maps and characters.

row.name: Unnamed Space Idle
row.detailed_description: Unnamed Space Idle is an unfolding, sci-fi idle game that plunges you into a relentless battle against an alien menace that has decimated humanity. Customize your ship with an array of progressively unlocked weapons and defenses, strategically tailored to counter specific enemy types. With a plethora of unfolding systems and abundant options, you'll face crucial choices as you steadily increase you power through progression and prestige. Discover over 10 distinct systems, each offering unique mechanics that evolve and expand over time. Core - Upgrade your Weapon, Defense and Utility cores with salvage gathered from enemies. Compute - Improve your combat stats over time in traditional Idle Game fashion Synth - Craft and improve modules and recipes to increase your power in various ways. Void Device - Slot in void shards dropped by enemies for different combinations of upgrades. Prestige - Unlock different ships, weapons, defenses and utilities. Reactor - Feed void matter into your reactor to power various system boosts. Research - Harness the research data obtained from different sectors to unlock various upgrades. Warp - Warp to special enemy locations to harvest essence for upgrades in a massive tree. And More... Choose wisely when equipping your ship with weapons and defenses, selecting power-altering modules, or determining the optimal combination of shards to use. The distinction between optimal and sub-optimal choices can significantly impact your progress. But while there are a lot of decisions to be made, they are all plainly understandable so that the optimum, or at least very near optimum decision making is within your grasp! Well paced progression combined with the amount of different systems, upgrades and enemies, means something new is frequently just around the corner.
row.short_description: Destroy endless waves of alien ships that have all but wiped out humanity in this long form, unfolding, sci-fi idle game. Customize your ship with different weapons and defenses to defeat specific enemy types and utilize a ton of different systems to increase your overall power.

row.name: Lost Connections
row.detailed_description: Lost Connections is a visual novel that's based on a true story about self improvement and courage. Play through this beautifully illustrated game and see if you have what it takes! Will you build up the courage to get her number, or will everything end up going wrong? Find all the secrets and all the endings! Written by Amber Pearl and Nofar Evyoni Art by Nofar Music and programming by Amber “Lost Connections OST” on all streaming platforms.
row.short_description: If she leaves now you will never see her again. Would you have enough courage to take a step, or would you stay quiet and regret it? Experience this story about love and loss.

row.name: [E]ISLAND HOP - Academic Version
row.detailed_description: Overview You are trapped in a bay surrounded by rocks. You must find and collect all the portal shards scattered across different islands to gain the chance to escape! Are you able to rebuild the portal in time, or will you stay trapped forever? The Game You play as a little Cube trapped in a bay with many small islands and rocks, trying to escape. You cannot swim, but you can drown. Fortunately, you have two other abilities that are more useful than that: jumping and summoning ice blocks from water. In order to escape, you need to hop from [e]island to [e]island, collect all portal shards and reach the goal before time runs out. How to Play Summon ice blocks by clicking on a grid tile containing only water. You can only spawn five blocks of ice at a time. After that, the oldest blocks will disappear with every new summoning, so be careful not fall into the water! Hop on islands and ice blocks by clicking on them. You cannot jump infinitely far; islands and blocks need to be in close proximity for you to be able to jump onto them. You can neither jump onto rocks nor jump through or between them. Pick up shards simply by jumping into them. Time as a Resource As with magical abilities, there is a price to pay for using them. For every ice block summoned, you sacrifice two seconds of your precious time. But don’t worry, you will gain 30 seconds back for every portal shard you pick up. Reach the goal island before time runs out, or stay trapped forever in [E]ISLAND HOP ! Note This game was created as our final project of our computer science degree and will likely not receive any updates.
row.short_description: You are trapped in a bay surrounded by rocks. You must find and collect all the portal shards scattered across different islands to gain the chance to escape! Are you able to rebuild the portal in time, or will you stay trapped forever?

row.detailed_description: Immerse yourself in the enchanting world of Sap, a unique meditative single-player game about nurturing an ever-evolving ecology. Witness the wonder of a bizarre, expanding and collapsing environment that you control with strategic tile placements. Choose from biomes, mechanical elements, and a plethora of organisms to adorn your board, and marvel as surprising interactions unfold. Experiment and explore layer upon layer of complex mechanics, unfolding new challenges and strategic avenues as you progress. Keep in mind, with each turn, you surrender control over your tiles - so think ahead and plan your layout carefully. Each turn you'll be offered 5 new tiles to select from, and with limited energy to pay for them per turn, you'll have to be strategic. The goal of sap is to explore, more than to win - but let the board fill up and it's game over! Try and balance the ecology to prevent system-wide collapse while seeing how many tiles you can discover! Designed not to be obtuse, but to foster curiosity, Sap invites you to lose yourself in its unique ecosystem, stimulating your mind while soothing your senses. Venture into this extraordinary game, where strategy meets serenity, and every playthrough reveals something new!
row.short_description: Be the unseen hand, guiding surreal life across a grid of possibility. Plant the seeds of biomes, creatures, and whimsical machines. Watch your strategic decisions etch vibrant stories. How long can your world survive?

row.name: Gash
row.detailed_description: Gash is a hack-and-slash roguelike game. You play as a ronin seeking the strongest swordsman in the Sengoku era of Japan. You start weak; over time, you will become more robust to challenge the strongest swordsman. Gash has up to 5 possible maps where players can explore and endure. Each map has its unique enemies and challenges the players must face! There are 5 known legendary warriors in the world of Gash, each unique, creating a legendary battle between you and the enemy. Every enemy, boss, and map has their loot pool of trophies for you to collect. Depending on its type, each trophy will grant you strength and blessings to make you stronger. Strong enough to eventually take down the strongest swordsman.
row.short_description: Gash is a hack-and-slash roguelike game. You play as a ronin seeking to become the strongest swordsman in the Sengoku era of Japan. Battle legendary foes to take on your challenge to become the greatest!

row.name: Under the Water Depths
row.detailed_description: What will the depths of the sea be like? And more importantly, what is in them? Under the Water Depths is a first-person game in which you will dive into a trench in the middle of an unknown ocean. The depths of the sea hide sinister yet mystical secrets that invite to explore them. However, to do so, you must learn to navigate through its ecosystem, discovering its terrain's and its peculiarities while adapting to the oppressive atmosphere of the environment. Features: Explore the depths of a sea trench in total darkness. Keep an eye on your flashlight's battery and use the sonar effectively to orient yourself. Feel the pressure of sea creatures lurking in the darkness. Enjoy suspense without violence: losing isn't an option here, if you are lost you just need to find your way. Note: Under the Water Depths is a prototype resulting from a project done by students Lia Puigmitjà, Agustín Kohan, and Victor Langa during the 2022/23 academic year at the Barcelona Institute of Technology.
row.short_description: Under the Water Depths is a first-person game in which you will dive into a trench in the middle of an unknown ocean. The depths of the sea hide sinister yet mystical secrets.

row.name: Flow State - Max Chill Edition
row.detailed_description: Welcome to your Flow State! Feel free to stay as long as you want and immerse yourself in a serene, focus-driven environment. Have you been procrastinating on tackling those daunting tasks? Flow State was designed to assist you in taking the first step. Upon entering the game, enter flow state and get to work! Embrace the soothing ambiance to help you get started on any task you've been avoiding. Build up your relaxing environment with plants and other desk customizations that will help increase your focus! Calming Lo-fi Soundtrack Flow State features fantastic lo-fi tunes from various talented musicians. To enhance the tranquil atmosphere, you can choose to turn the rain sounds on or off. Don't forget to explore more of their creations! Earn Focus Earn focus points for keeping Flow State open, earn even more when you're focusing on something! Up your Focus Game! Purchase upgrades to your study space with your Focus Points. Add plants and other trinkets to your room to help you concentrate. Achieving your goals The only way to stop the timer is by exiting the game. Once you've started an activity, commit to it and begin! Your Flow State journey awaits. row.name: COVID 23 : Test Labs
row.detailed_description: Embark on a heart-pounding journey as you step into the shoes of a courageous agent tasked with infiltrating Test Labs. Within these sinister walls, failed experiments on COVID patients have unleashed a terrifying aftermath – the birth of mutated creatures lurking in the shadows. Your mission is clear: navigate dangerous corridors, strategically plant explosive charges at critical areas, and obtain valuable sample evidence that could shed light on this catastrophic ordeal. But that's not all; you must also become a beacon of hope for survivors trapped within this labyrinth, rescuing them from this living nightmares. Prepare to face the unknown, for each mission will test your skills and resilience to the limit. As you delve deeper into the Test Labs, prepare to square off against abominations of unimaginable strength. Arm yourself with an arsenal of diverse weapons, each carefully crafted to counter the grotesque entities that stand in your way. 'Covid-23: Test Labs' immerses players in a high-stakes battle for survival, where quick reflexes, strategic thinking, and a brave spirit will be your greatest allies. Are you ready to face the horrors within, conquer the unknown, and reclaim humanity from the clutches of despair? The fate of countless lives rests in your hands. The time to act is now. Join the fight against the unforeseen and shape the future.
row.short_description: Infiltrate hazardous facilities, plant explosives, gather vital evidence, and save survivors while battling against nightmarish mutations. Brace yourself for an intense and action-packed mission to overcome the unexpected horrors that await.

row.name: Wyrmicide
row.detailed_description: Check out our Discord server for information on upcoming beta tests! Wyrmacide is a thrilling, fun, and competitive 1v1 tactics game that combines strategic turn-based tactics with intense real-time action. Defeat the opposing Wyrm as you climb to the top of the Rankings. In Wyrmicide, you'll engage in a unique dual-phase gameplay experience. You will enter the Tactical Board as you harness strategic decision-making and careful planning to place or move your units into advantageous positions. When your units encounter the enemy, the battle is a skill based 1v1 duel to the death, where the victor inches ever closer toward slaying the enemy's Wyrm. ⠀⠀⠀ ⠀ Strategize... Similar to a chess board, your units will be displayed on the Tactical Board. Players take their turns simultaneously, anticipating each other's move. Pieces have unique movement ranges and pattern. Additionally, some pieces are Quick, allowing them to slip past or ambush slower pieces. Players are awarded coins which are used to purchase buffs and pieces that allow them wrest control of the board AND the battlefield. Buffs are a powerful tool than can grant a piece a unique advantage on the board or in combat. ⠀⠀⠀ ⠀ ...and Conquer. In combat, each piece has access to two unique attacks. Learning how pieces counter one another in combat is vital to exploiting your opponent's weaknesses. Damage pieces take in battle carries over afterward. So even if a battle seems hopeless, you can endeavor to weaken your opponent's piece. ⠀⠀⠀ Key Features: Unique blend of turn-based tactics and real-time dueling action. Engage in intense 1v1 battles against skilled opponents. Harness strategic thinking and plan your moves carefully. Enhance your pieces with Buffs Stop foes in their tracks with traps and hazards Hire new pieces to aid you in battle from a colorful cast of characters Defeat the enemy Wyrm and climb the leaderboard in your conquest to be the True King of Wyrms Prepare to unleash your tactical brilliance and combat prowess in Wyrmicide. Will you crush your foes, claim victory, and become the One True Wyrm King? ⠀⠀⠀
row.short_description: There may only be one true Wyrm King and you're tasked in ensuring his succession! Engage in an exciting blend of turn-based tactics and real time 1v1 duels as you Stab, Shoot, Magic and Fireball your way to Victory!

row.detailed_description: Welcome to the doodle world! Armed with nothing but a pencil, play as Stickman as you explore a brand-new world. Solve intricate puzzles by drawing into the game, meet new friends while dodging scribble monsters, and make memories that’ll never be erased! Draw is a 2D sidescroller–an artistic story-rich journey of grief and acceptance through the doodles of Nathan, a high schooler dealing with the grief of a recently lost friend. As “Stickman,” you will navigate a lined-paper world of fun puzzles and doodle monsters. You’ll encounter different characters representing unique individuals in Nathan’s life who play a vital role in his journey of self-sabotage, isolation, depression, acceptance, and recovery. In creating Draw, we set out to tell a meaningful and impactful story through simple artistic means, drawing heavily from the art style of iconic stick-figure fighting Flash games popular in the late 2000s. Taking inspiration from indie devs in the past who have tackled heavy and emotional topics with maturity and thoughtfulness despite their limited creative and programming resources, we hope to pay tribute to them in our own way through Draw . This game contains mature themes/topics that may be upsetting to some viewers. Features 1-2 hours of total gameplay with 600+ lines of dialog Draw with your mouse to create objects that interact with the environment An original soundtrack featuring 9 songs Explore over 30 different puzzles with 3 unique object physics 30 different hand-drawn animations and cutscenes Visual novel-style cutscenes deep-diving into the characters' lives

row.name: A murder of crows
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the sinister world of A Murder of Crows, a horror game that will take you to an eerie forest. Your mission is to find five mysterious crows in this nightmarish environment and uncover a dark secret that terrifies the forest. You'll take on the role of a brave explorer who is fascinated by the stories about the eerie disappearances in this forest. Your journey begins at an abandoned, dilapidated entrance gate shrouded in swirling mist. The gate creaks ominously as you slowly open it and venture into the darkness. The forest welcomes you with an eerie silence. The cracking of branches beneath your feet echoes through the trees, while the wind carries mysterious whispering voices. Your only ally is a flashlight, which gives you limited light in the pitch black night. The outlines of the trees seem threatening and eerie shadows lurk around every corner. As you advance deeper into the forest, you keep encountering disturbing signs. Gruesome symbols are carved into the bark of the trees, and the remains of abandoned campfires bear witness to past events. Ominous sounds make you freeze while you try to orient yourself on your way. Suddenly you hear the fleeting flutter of wings and the shrill cawing of crows. You follow the sounds and discover a weathered map with the positions of the five crows marked on it. They are the key to solving the mystery of the forest and the only way to survive. Your search for the crows will take you through deeper and deeper realms of horror. You will be pursued by eerie creatures that emerge from the shadows and seek your life. They are creatures that are alienated from human nature and strive only for darkness and fear. You must be skilled and sharpen your senses to escape them. The crows themselves are not easy to find. They are masters of camouflage and have hidden in the darkest and most inaccessible places in the forest. You'll have to solve puzzles, overcome traps and fight your way through dangerous environments to discover them. Each crow you find will bring you closer to the mystery of the forest and reveal another layer of terror.
row.short_description: Try to get all the crows before disaster comes for you

row.name: Duskborn
row.detailed_description: Duskborn has started as a university project at Stuttgart Media University in Germany. It has been developed by an interdisciplinary team of students over the course of two semesters (about 8 months) and further polished by a small team afterward. We hope you enjoy our final results! It's the year 2114. Humanity is on the brink of extinction. An unknown organism spreads across the earth and annihilates the whole ecosystem. The cause of this catastrophe lies deep in the Abyss, a giant crater in which an abandoned city has been built. As an Abyss-Diver, your mission is to discover the secrets of the Abyss and search for a way to prevent humanity's extinction. Explore, collect items, and fight against enemies and bosses. Race against time You're not welcome in the Abyss. The unknown organism will do everything to protect itself. The longer you stay, more enemies will appear and they're stronger than before. So do not linger too long, or you will be overwhelmed. Good luck! Level up Throughout the world, you may find items, which can be combined into powerful upgrades for your character. There are nearly limitless combinations, so every run is a unique experience. Also, with every level up, you can upgrade the stats of your character. Enemies Face different types of enemies, each with an unique set of movement and attacks. Equipped with cutting-edge technology, these enemies are trained to eliminate you as quickly as possible. So watch out for swarms of drones or the deadly sound of the big laser. Boss fight Guarding the end of each stage lies a powerful enemy that must be defeated to progress further. These elite units are powerful and deadly, so make sure you perpare yourself before you face them! Sponsoring Special thanks to Randstad Digital Germany AG for sponsoring the game and made it possible to have merch and nice teamevents for our team.
row.short_description: Duskborn is a 3rd-person roguelite game. Descend into the Abyss as fast as possible, level up by defeating various enemies, collect and combine items to upgrade your player. Maneuver through the Abyss with your jetpack and grappling hook. The race against time is on.

row.name: 免费游戏 THE GAME FOR FREE
row.detailed_description: About This Game THE GAME FOR FREE  is a sci-fi card survival game that combines card matching, strategic planning, and roguelike elements. Players must match key cards, avoid curse cards and monster pursuits, and gather various collectibles to influence the game’s outcome — all while managing health to survive until the end. “THE GAME FOR FREE?” Maple’s eyes linger on this mysterious game on Steam, unaware that the room around them has already started to change. Key Features · Dual Modes : Choose between 'Story Mode' and 'Endless Mode.' Story Mode introduces you to the world’s rules and its underlying story, while Endless Mode offers endless challenges tailored for roguelike enthusiasts. · Innovative Card Gameplay : Matching key cards requires both quick memory and tactical avoidance of curse cards, including monsters, traps, and bombs. Use collectibles wisely to survive long enough to match all key cards, open the exit, and escape. · Rich Collectible System : Successfully pairing cards unlocks a variety of collectibles such as “Undying” (immortality) and “Self-Healing” (HP restoration), as well as “Seek Guidance” for location hints. In Endless Mode, collectibles can even be leveled up, creating more options for survival. · Varied Environment Maps : Multiple environments, including toxic fog zones and eternal night levels, make each game unique and every exploration filled with suspense and the unexpected. · Diverse Monster Types : The game includes unique monsters, each with distinct traits. From the sticky, poison-leaving “Goo” to the heavy yet powerful “Colossus,” each creature requires a flexible approach to evade or defeat. Gameplay Overview 1. Match Key Cards : Locate and match pairs of key cards to unlock the door to the next level. 2. Avoid Curse Cards : Encounter a variety of curse cards, including monsters, traps, and bombs, that introduce different hazards to overcome. 3. Collect and Use Power-Ups : During each run, unlock and choose from an array of collectibles, each providing unique advantages at critical moments. Who This Game Is For THE GAME FOR FREE  is crafted for players who enjoy sci-fi narratives, survival games, and strategic card-based gameplay.

row.name: MetaStrike
row.detailed_description: Metastrike is a FPS game where every second counts and every move can turn the tide of battle. In a world plunged into chaos, you and your squad are the last line of defense against complete collapse. From crumbling city streets to secret military installations, every location becomes a high-stakes battleground where teamwork is your greatest weapon. Metastrike, hesitation is not an option. Each match pits two elite teams against each other in a relentless contest of reflexes and coordination. Master a cutting-edge arsenal of modern weaponry, from assault rifles and sniper rifles to tactical gadgets, all customizable to fit your playstyle. Key Features: High-Paced Action: Experience relentless, fast-paced combat where every action can make or break the outcome in an instant. Team-Based Excellence: Victory depends on seamless teamwork and strategic coordination. Adapt and execute plans on the fly to outsmart your opponents. Diverse and Complex Maps: Battle across various environments, from bustling urban areas to abandoned military outposts, each requiring creative and adaptable strategies. Authentic Combat Experience: Immerse yourself in intense firefights with realistic sound effects, detailed graphics, and visceral combat that brings the FPS experience to life. Competitive Ranked Mode: Climb the ranks in a fierce competitive mode where every match presents new challenges and opportunities to prove your skills. Metastrike is more than just a shootout – it’s a test of strategic thinking, speed, and team synergy. Step into the fray and become a legend!

row.name: Death Slayer
row.detailed_description: Death Slayer is a 2D Metroidvania-style platformer with frenetic action, the objective is to defeat all the enemies in the room in order to unlock access to the final boss of each level. Immerse yourself in this adventure where you control Asura, a young swordswoman whose goal is to eradicate the evil that torments her lands. Features: · Wide variety of enemies and bosses, each with their own unique design and attack pattern. · Different character moves that you will need to master in order to progress through the game. · Intuitive controls that are easy to learn. · Retro style level design and artwork that will take you back to the 90's. · Excellent soundtrack that will immerse you in every level.
row.short_description: Death Slayer is a 2D Metroidvania-style platformer where you control Asura, a young swordswoman whose goal is to eradicate the evil that plagues her land.

row.name: Zombiolence
row.detailed_description: In a rotten world consumed by a mass fungal virus infection only the strongest and most committed survive. You are an outcast, having long lost your family you had nothing to live for until this apocalypse. It is up to you to defend what's left of your life. Survive up to 100 progressively more challenging rounds in this defensive survival shooter. Upgrade your arsenal and improve your income by killing more zombies. Buy permanent buffs that will make you a zombie killing machine. Do not let your power make you underestimate your enemies though, for they will grow stronger too with every round. Fight four unique types of zombies. Collect up to ten weapons and place traps during the daytime. Fun yet tactical and involved. Die once and your save file is reset! How long will you last? Day night cycle based on rounds. Players will begin at night during round one with only the glock and the knife. After beating round one, the daytime scene will play automatically where the player will have access to the shop and the building system to place traps. There is no time limit in the day time and any weapons fired will not use ammo. Once the player is ready for the next round, the bed inside the RV can be used to sleep and turn it back to night wherein the next round will start. Quitting mid-round will reset the player back to the start of that round and dying will cause the entire game to be reset to round one. The player has four resources to manage: Health, Stamina, Ammo and Money. Money is gained by killing zombies with any weapon or trap. Stronger zombie types will grant more money upon death. Zombies will sometimes grant drop rewards upon death which can give the player extra health, ammo or money. The ammo drop will exclusively increase the ammo of the weapon the player is holding. Traps can be played in a grid in the entire play area. To place a trap, players must buy said trap and access the inventory menu pressing “I”. Then they can click on the trap to place it and click on it again once on the ground to move it to the desired location. Buffs can also be obtained from the shop which will grant the player a permanent advantage in the run, such as extra health or stamina. Weapons bought can be selected from the weapon rack in the RV. The player can hold four weapons at once: a melee, a pistol, a main weapon and a heavy weapon. Additionally the player can buy an unlimited amount of grenades, deployed during rounds pressing “G”. Zombies Regular: Most common zombie, moderate speed and damage. Fast: Less common, much faster and dangerous. Explosive: Slow and with no melee attack. Will explode when in range and upon death causing damage. Giant: Slow but extremely dangerous. Can take many shots and will cause lots of damage. Face them all, in order to save humanity from its end. Buy, improve and plan a strategy to kill each and every one of them. Do you have what it takes to get it?

row.detailed_description: ZOMBIE ARENA SURVIVAL Kill as many zombies as you can before they kill you. row.name: Timemelters - Friend Pass
row.detailed_description: What is Friend's Pass? A Friend's Pass lets you play the full Co-op campaign and the Speedrun Mode for free with a friend WHO OWNS THE FULL GAME! NOTES: - This game is online co-op only: THE OTHER PLAYER MUST OWN THE FULL VERSION OF TIMEMELTERS (link below). - There are no achievements on this free version of the game. Created by the co-designer of Sang-Froid: Tales of Werewolves , TimeMelters brings you to a mythical land of dreams and nightmares, where witch trials seem the only answer to the preternatural forces threatening the land. TimeMelters is a strategy-adventure game that features a unique game mechanic: Time Travel, which allows the players to go back in time and fight alongside themselves. You play as Teagan, a witch whose powers were just recently unleashed by an unwelcome guest. Now, you must venture forth in a desperate effort to cleanse the countryside from the seeping evil that is corrupting it. It's not an RPG (although it has some features we normally see in RPGs, such as a skill tree, a great storyline and an eerie soundtrack), it's not an open world either (although we have a campaign with 20 huge, unique maps to defend), it's really a game that mixes strategy and action with all kind of other game mechanics (tower defense, puzzles, boss fights, survival missions, escort missions, etc.). Features: Unique Time Shift game mechanic! Hybrid Action-Strategy gameplay: Plan a strategy and execute it all in real time! Puzzle maps, boss fights, escort missions, survival, etc. -- each mission has distinct objectives and brings unique twists on the time travel mechanic! Co-op mode: Play the full campaign and the Speedrun Mode with a friend who owns the game (2 players)! Startling storyline: Engaging campaign with all the twists, turns, nooks, crannies and what-the-bleep-just-happened moments you would -- and should -- expect from a story based on Time Travel!
row.short_description: Strategy, witches, time travel... and online Coop! Download the Friend's Pass and play the full Coop campaign for free with a friend who owns the full version of TimeMelters!

row.name: float: champions

'Features' anvils use your anvil to send players flying, but if timed incorrectly, they can be used against you wall jumping against certain surfaces your able to zoom up them by jumping continuously, doing this allows you to quickly get to the top ground slam holding shift sends the player downward while also making them bouncy, use this to gain lots of height and sometimes pass parts of the course if used correctly. customization with a variety of different items for your bean to wear you can make your bean the drippiest of them all. online multiplayer go up against your friends or find random people to play against bean bean Reviews If your not yet convinced, just see what our reviewers have to say! albert: I like 10/10 john: It changed my life 10 beans/ 10 beans

row.name: Shan Hai Express
row.detailed_description: 'Shan Hai Express' is an interactive narrative game inspired by the nonlinear structure of the ancient Chinese mythological text, 'Shan Hai Jing'. In this game, player wake up on a mysterious train which is moving in an painting. Player can freely explore its carriages, uncover the hidden secrets of this train. row.name: Bongus Bright-eye & The Great Axe-stravaganza
row.detailed_description: After countless years of waging war against the Demon threat, the dwarves enjoyed a century of peace. But after the centuries of silence, Antagon Stonegaze, the Demon King, has finally returned to the Dwarven Kingdom of Mount Tungsten and turned all the dwarves into stone. Our protagonist Bongus Bright-Eye the Rockbroker was met with a bad stomach after having a feast for himself at the local Rock'o'bell, and had occupied the bathroom for some time, all while his whole kingdom was being attacked and turned into stone by the Demon King and his henchmen. The only thing that can kill Angaton Stonegaze, is the Axe of Kindness, which was destroyed during the battle between Antagon and the Dwarf King, Wolfram Rockbottom. Bongus’ only possible way to save the kingdom and his people is by seeking out Durlin Twinkletoes, the human Wizard, to help him fix the broken Axe of Kindness, and defeat Antagon Stonegaze once and for all. Exploration Go on an adventure to explore the kingdom of Mount Tungsten, the city of Babblebrook and the beautiful meadow, learning new faces and making new friends along the way. Features The game includes full voice acting and music to accompany you throughout your adventure. 13 unique characters are featured to guide you towards your destination, bringing along comedy and great company to keep your mind occupied. Team We're a small team of 3 with minimal programming knowledge, who have worked on this game for a couple of months and decided to release it on steam. We hope you enjoy our little project!
row.short_description: Bongus Bright-Eye & The Great Axe-stravaganza is an homage to the classic Point & Click Adventure games. It's a comedy induced fantasy game, where you follow our protagonist Bongus Bright-Eye on his journey to save the Dwarven Kingdom.

row.name: Pepper Blast
row.detailed_description: The Spiciest, Most Explosive Match-3 Game Ever! Get ready to ignite your puzzle-solving skills with Pepper Blast! This fiery match-3 game takes the beloved genre to new, explosive heights. Whether you’re seeking classic fun or adventurous twists, Pepper Blast has the perfect mode for you. With 5 sizzling game modes to match every mood, you're in for a scorching good time! Key Features: 5 Ways to Play: From timeless match-3 gameplay to thrilling new challenges, Pepper Blast offers a spicy experience for every type of player. Classic Mode: Enjoy the timeless fun of match-3 gameplay with a hot twist. New, powerful chili peppers and ultra-smooth action make this mode a blast! Rock Mode:  Navigate through rocky obstacles and blast your way to success. Only the most strategic players will overcome these solid challenges! Ice Block Mode: Freeze and thaw your way through icy puzzles. Melt the ice blocks with blazing matches and keep the game moving! Thief Mode: Outsmart sneaky thieves trying to steal your precious peppers. Match quickly and strategically to foil their plans and claim your rewards! Fusion Mode: Experience the ultimate challenge as multiple elements — rocks, ice, and thieves — combine in one explosive mode. Can you handle the chaos? High-Definition Graphics:  Experience the vibrant, explosive world of Pepper Blast with stunning visuals and immersive sounds. Ultra-Smooth Action: Enjoy seamless gameplay with multiple matches happening simultaneously as new chili peppers fall into place. Get ready to turn up the heat and dive into the most explosive match-3 game ever. Whether you're a seasoned player or new to the genre, Pepper Blast offers endless fun and challenges to keep you coming back for more. Are you ready to feel the burn?
row.short_description: Experience explosive match-3 gameplay with 5 sizzling modes: Classic, Rock, Ice Block, Thief, and Fusion. Overcome unique challenges across 85 fiery levels. Ready to feel the burn? Chili Blast is waiting!

row.name: 絶体絶命少女 虚空の方程式
row.detailed_description: ■ストーリー 少女の絶命まで、あと30分…。 『絶体絶命少女』は、'冷たい方程式'や'トロッコ問題'をオマージュした短編SFビジュアルノベルです。 母親に会いたい一心で火星行きの宇宙船に密航した少女 [六条アカネ] は、船の制御AI [クロ] から、『間もなく船がワープ空間に入り、人間は神経系が破壊されて死ぬ』と伝えられます。 アカネが密航した船は火星で起きた災害事故の救助に向かう救助船であり、救助者の中には最愛の母親も含まれているのでした。 クロがアカネを保護して地球へ引き返せば火星にいる母親は死亡し、火星へ救助に向かえば密航した少女は死んでしまいます。 密航した少女か、火星で待つ救助者たちか。救える命はどちらか片方だけ。 あなたはどちらの命を救い、どちらの命を見捨てますか？ 命を選び、それぞれの運命を見届けましょう。 ■キャラクター紹介 【六条アカネ】CV：月城セシル (YouTubeにて配信中) 宇宙船に密航した少女。 元気いっぱい天真爛漫な性格で、火星で仕事をしている母親を驚かせるためにサプライズで会いに行く計画を立てたが、絶体絶命のピンチに陥る。 船の進路選択まであと30分。つまり、少女の絶命まであと30分。 少女は何を考え、どんな結末に辿り着くのか？ 【クロ】CV：闇クロ (YouTubeにて配信中) 宇宙救助船の制御AI。自律思考型の人工知能。 ワープ空間へ出入りできるように機械制御で無人化された船を操り、遠く離れた火星へ遭難者の救助に向かう。 船に密航した少女を助けるべきか、少女を見捨てて遭難者の救助に向かうか…。 心や感情を持たないはずの人工知能は苦悩し、救う命と見捨てる命を選ぶことになる。 ■ゲームについて プレイ時間：2時間程度 ルート：全3種+ユーザー希望による追加ルート1種 ※希望のルートへ到達するためには絶望を否定する操作が必要です。 ※ゲームの演出上、テキストの自動送りがONになる場面があります。 ボイス：メインパートはフルボイス、サブパートはボイスなし 出演声優：新進気鋭のVTuber『月城セシル』と『闇クロ』が担当 公式ハッシュタグ：#絶体絶命少女 実況プレイ：大歓迎です！ ■実況プレイ配信に関するガイドライン 以下の事を守っていただければ、個人・法人、配信プラットフォーム問わずゲーム実況を行うことを許可いたします。 ・動画の概要欄など、動画ページ内のいずれかに以下の著作権者の表示明記と本ページのURL記載をお願いいたします。 ----------------------- 絶体絶命少女 虚空の方程式 (C)+LIVE ※このページのURLを記載してください ----------------------- ・各種動画配信サイトが公式に定めるパートナー機能であれば、収益化を伴うプレイ配信は問題ございません。 ・公序良俗に反しない良識あるプレイ/配信をお願いいたします。 ・ゲーム中に楽曲『迷子の流れ星』が流れる場面がありますが、楽曲の権利を制作側が有しており、常識的な配信内容であれば権利侵害の申し立ては行いません。実況プレイ中はそのまま流していただいて問題ございません。 ■その他 ・ガイドラインに関する個別の問い合わせにはお答えいたしません。 ・当作品の動画投稿/配信によって発生した不都合及び損害について制作側は一切の責任を負いません。 ・ガイドラインの内容は予告なく変更する場合がございます。

row.name: BloodMoon
row.detailed_description: Introducing BloodMoon, an immersive indie multiplayer horror experience seamlessly powered by Steam Relay connectivity. Embark on a chilling journey with a group of five players, one of whom assumes the sinister role of the killer. Every playthrough unveils a unique, procedurally generated map, ensuring every game is a fresh experience.
