row.name: Warlocks Deeds
row.detailed_description: Embark on an extraordinary journey through a mystical realm where warlocks and magic reign supreme. Introducing 'Warlocks Deeds,' a superbly crafted medieval survival sandbox voxel game that will transport you to a world of enchantment and adventure! In Warlocks Deeds, you'll step into the shoes of a budding warlock, ready to unravel the secrets of the magical arts and forge your path in a vast and immersive voxel-based universe. Craft your own destiny as you gather resources, build magnificent structures, and harness the elements to your advantage. Create awe-inspiring potions that can reshape the very fabric of reality and unravel the mysteries of long-lost magical runes. But beware, fellow warlock, for survival in this untamed realm is no easy feat. Navigate treacherous dungeons teeming with dangerous creatures, contend with rival sorcerers vying for dominance, and face the perils of a dynamic day-night cycle that brings its own challenges and surprises. In the mystical realm of 'Warlocks Deeds,' the boundaries of magic and technology blur, allowing warlocks to traverse to different dimensions where advanced technologies exist. Through ancient portals your character can embark on extraordinary journeys to explore realms where science and technology thrive. Experience points (XP) are earned by engaging in various activities, such as defeating enemies, completing quests, or growing crops. As you accumulate XP, you gradually progress through levels, unlocking new skill points, potions, and abilities. Levelling up also grants you access to more challenging quests, areas, and encounters, ensuring a sense of continuous growth and exploration. The levelling system in Warlocks Deeds emphasizes the sense of progression and personalization, allowing you to shape your warlocks abilities and playstyle according to your preferences.
row.short_description: Embark on an extraordinary journey through a mystical realm where warlocks and magic reign supreme. Introducing 'Warlocks Deeds,' a superbly crafted medieval survival sandbox voxel game that will transport you to a world of enchantment and adventure!
row.notes: Unrealistic Mild cartoon violence, hitting chickens and fantacy creatures with various items including bows and axes.

row.name: The Braves
row.detailed_description: JOIN THE COMMUNITY ON DISCORD About the Game The Braves is an action roguelike game with loads of unique skills, weapons and enemies hordes. They may seem harmless and even friendly at first but these creatures are actually real monsters who only want to tear you apart! Do you have what it takes to survive this battle? Choose your heroes, vanquish hordes of enemies, unlock powerful skills, become one with your weapons and prove that you can survive in the most dangerous worlds of multiple universes. The Braves combines many unique features: Free for all! Tons of various skills combinations! Choose the most effective battle combo that suits your style Thousands of frenzied monsters and bosses! Dodge hordes of enemies to win! Unlock uniquely designed characters and different skills. Customize your battles to suit your style! Upgrade your characters and experiment with different play styles Collect valuable resources to unlock the upgrades needed to survive and evolve! Lots of unique locations. Explore, conquer, survive and climb higher and higher! Unlock achievements by overcoming the difficulties found in these worlds filled with deadly enemies! Create legendary equipment to overcome what awaits you! Restore your base to open up new opportunities
row.short_description: Demolish hordes of enemies and survive against all odds! Unlock different characters, find powerful skill combinations and embark on an exciting journey through the variety of very different worlds in this cute but unforgiving roguelike game!

row.name: Aexia
row.detailed_description: Aexia Build 238: Major Update Brings premade sets and more! Close Beta Build 238 Major Update Alright, it’s time for a big update! We’ve added a LOT in this new release, touching on almost every aspect of our VR Roleplay platform. We’re reaching new heights with this update, featuring verticality as we’ve never seen it before. We’ve also made our stage creation tools more powerful than ever and squashed so many bugs that it could give a certain popular new game a run for its money. Without further ado, let's jump in! What’s new: -patch-238-update About the Game Aexia is a platform for creating, sharing and playing VR role-playing games. With Aexia, players can role-play as actual actors in a movie set. Step into the role and experience thoughtfully crafted worlds, participate in compelling narratives and interact with a wide array of characters, while game masters (GMs) guide these stories within the expansive VR environment. Join our Discord community to find other roleplayers and game masters to play with:
row.short_description: Aexia is a platform for creating, sharing and playing VR role-playing games. With Aexia, players can role-play as actual actors in a movie set. Join our Discord community to find other roleplayers and game masters to play with:

row.name: Dungeon Heroes
row.detailed_description: Embark on an adventure alone or with friends into the ever-changing dungeon filled with monsters and treasure! With a cast of unique heroes to choose from, you have one life to navigate the hostile corridors and rooms. Can you reach the furthest depths and defeat the entity that awaits you? Those up to the challenge will be greatly rewarded! A university project game developed by a team of nine over a period of five months.
row.short_description: Explore and fight your way through randomly generated dungeons in this action-packed local co-op multiplayer dungeon crawler!

row.name: MacroWin
row.detailed_description: Introducing MacroWin, the ultimate macro application for Windows users seeking powerful automation capabilities. Whether you're a gamer or a productivity enthusiast, MacroWin empowers you to take full control of your desktop with ease. Disclaimer During the 7-day trial period, you'll have full access to all the powerful features that MacroWin has to offer. Record and Playback Effortlessly capture and replay mouse movements, clicks, scrollwheel actions, and keyboard strokes. This allows you to automate repetitive tasks, such as opening and closing applications, navigating menus, and entering text. Image Detection and OCR Elevate your macros to new heights with image detection capabilities. MacroWin enables you to detect specific images on your screen and perform OCR (Optical Character Recognition) on selected areas, unlocking limitless possibilities for automation. Voice Commands Immerse yourself in a whole new level of interactive gaming by incorporating your voice as an additional controller. MacroWin allows you to create custom voice commands, granting you unparalleled control over your games and applications. Custom Crosshairs Enhance your gaming experience with personalized precision. Overlay custom crosshairs on any game you play, ensuring optimal accuracy and maximizing your performance. Dynamic Profiles Stay organized and in control with MacroWin's dynamic profiles feature. Seamlessly switch between personalized macro configurations as different games come to the foreground. Effortlessly optimize your macros for each gaming experience, keeping your automation streamlined and your performance at its peak. Community Center Become part of a vibrant community of MacroWin users. Share your macro creations and download macros crafted by fellow enthusiasts. Discover a wealth of pre-made macros that cater to various applications and gaming experiences, fostering collaboration and unlocking new possibilities.
row.short_description: Elevate your gaming experience with MacroWin, the ultimate macro application for Windows. Say goodbye to tedious and repetitive tasks as MacroWin empowers you to automate with ease.

row.name: Avalog
row.detailed_description: Chess, but continuous! Avalog is a chess game where the pieces aren't fixed to the squares on the board - they can sit anywhere between. Set in a charming 8-bit Arthurian world, players can challenge their friends either on the couch or online. Key Features: A new take on a classic: learn which strategies work best in the new dimension! Five playable factions, each with their movement options and playstyles. Draft mode: pick your pieces from a random selection of the factions, then fight! Customization: choose from a selection of palettes and maps. Lore! Explore some of the Arthurian (and definitely not Arthurian) mythology.
row.short_description: Chess, but continuous! Avalog is a free game for playing analog chess with others, either locally or online. As well as a 'classic' mode, there is a 'draft' mode, where players pick pieces from 5 different factions.

row.name: Mandew vs the Forever Rain+
row.detailed_description: Mandew vs the Forever Rain+ is a retelling of Mandew's original game and the first game release under the Suits & Sandals name, originally released on January 2, 2011. Save your Farm! Play as Mandew, a regular guy with a very irregular problem! An ever-present storm has been pelting his home for weeks and it's about time someone investigated. Mandew will face off against weird and wacky enemies as he follows the 'Forever Rain' to it's source. Mandew will traverse 16 linear platforming stages, defeating enemies and collecting power-ups. Complete the game in STORY MODE and have your hi-score recorded on the Steam Leaderboards or aim for the top times in TRIAL MODE . Unique Mechanics (We Swear!) At first glance, platformer veterans will feel right at home in this game's world but Mandew has a few unique abilities up his sleeve: Jump from a crouching position to perform a spring jump, allowing you to reach high ledges. Jumping on enemies will increase your air speed! Chain jumps to really move! Use Mandew's fire power-up to defeat enemies from afar and ignite things. Use Mandew's hammer power-up to reflect projectiles and destroy blocks. What's the Difference? Mandew vs the Forever Rain+ features a mix of the game's original stages as well as remixed and new stages built from the ground up. A new OST by composer Jaxcheese and new collectable figurine capsules hidden throughout the game. The game has been updated to use graphics and mechanics from the third game in the series, Mandew vs the Upside Down Machine .
row.short_description: After 13 years, one of the first Suits & Sandals games is back with a fresh coat of paint! Help Mandew uncover the source of the mysterious never-ending downpour threatening his home in this 2D platforming adventure.

row.name: Quantum Rail
row.detailed_description: Quantum Rail is a thrilling, fast-paced first-person shooter that takes you on an exciting adventure through a sci-fi-themed wild west world. As you embark on your journey, you'll be tasked with safeguarding your train, tackling challenging puzzles, and engaging in intense combat. Traverse a series of quantum jump gates, delving deeper into the heart of robot territory. Along your journey, you may encounter: Different droids all with a plan to stop you Multiple types of encounters, each with their own puzzle elements A boss droid to put a stop to your destruction Do you have what it takes to end the droids once and for all?
row.short_description: Quantum Rail is a thrilling, fast-paced first-person shooter that takes you on an exciting adventure through a sci-fi-themed wild west world.

row.name: Garganta
row.detailed_description: Story Overview Enter a desolate megastructure, given the codename 'Garganta', which houses a cataclysmic device putting the Universe at risk. Embody Servo, a highly advanced android capable of traversing the dilapidated construct. Players will find that the only signs of life in the megastructure are various sapient machines. Their existences are oftentimes hellish, becoming trapped in mundane objects with no voice with which to cry out, no identity to cling to. Some may try to help, though others have intentions beyond your comprehension. You will be ironclad, running, climbing and jumping your way across this world without reason. So that you may come to The End , and forge your own purpose in the crucible of singularity. Key Features High-Octane Parkour Gameplay Immersive, Explorable World Oppressive, Industrial Art Mysterious Narrative Secrets Scattered Across The World Online Leaderboards The Developers Originally the capstone project of 4 RMIT students from Melbourne, Garganta became a fully developed indie game, eventually being displayed at PAX Melbourne 2023. Our goal was simple, we wanted to make a visually compelling game, paying special homage to the works of Tsutomu Nihei, especially Blame!, which served as one of our biggest inspirations for the environments of the game.
row.short_description: 'Garganta' is a 3D Platformer influenced by Tsutomu Nihei's works. Embody Servo, an android racing to neutralise a device that'll engulf the Universe in innumerable singularities. Encounter peculiar characters and unveil secret plots designed by an AI, maddened by incomprehensible horrors.
row.notes: Mature themes such as death and existential dread discussed. No course language or profanity is used at all. The main character, who is a robot, often gets destroyed and rebuilt, however, there is no blood or explicit violence is depicted.

row.name: Power Fantasy
row.short_description: Survive hordes of blood hungry enemies and hope for the best upgrades while you level up! Power Fantasy is a fresh rogue-survivors-like with unique heroes and tons of customization.

row.name: Eukarion Tales: Origins
row.detailed_description: Unearth the origins of Marcus, the valiant Knight of Adamantia, in this nostalgic retro-flash, isometric RPG game which precedes Eukarion Tales 2. Follow Marcus’ extraordinary transformation from a humble squire to a legendary hero, as you immerse yourself in a rich, fantasy-filled storyline within a captivating European Middle Age-inspired world. Engage in intense battles against hordes of enemies, ranging from vicious bandits to awe-inspiring mythical creatures. Unlock and upgrade a multitude of unique abilities, shaping Marcus into a formidable force. Delve into an enthralling blend of strategic decision-making and adrenaline-fueled action, as you navigate through picturesque castles, lush forests, and ancient ruins. Eukarion Tales: Origins delivers countless hours of pure Hack'n Slash and RPG fun, allowing you to relish in the nostalgia of the retro gaming era. Embrace the simplicity of point-and-click movement and attack, with an auto-attack feature available to be switched on and off, so you can tailor your retro experience to your liking! Prepare for an unforgettable adventure where the fate of Marcus and the Diamond Order hangs in the balance. Shape his destiny, make impactful choices, and become a legendary Knight in a world teetering on the edge of darkness. Key Features: Unveil Marcus’ journey from squire to legendary Knight in a retro Flash game Battle hordes of enemies and upgrade your character's abilities Immerse yourself in a fantasy-filled storyline inspired by the European Middle Age Engage in strategic decision-making and adrenaline-fueled action Explore picturesque landscapes and iconic locations Hours of pure Hack'n Slash and RPG enjoyment Developer’s Note: This game is an artifact, a title developed by a small indie team using the full potential and limitations of flash technology back in the early 2000s. We apologize for any technical problems or inconveniences you may encounter in your playthrough. We hope that with these limitations in mind, you may still enjoy the experience!
row.short_description: A retro-flash, isometric RPG set in a medieval fantasy world. Battle hordes of enemies, upgrade your abilities, and experience a deep, fantasy-filled storyline in a European Middle Age-inspired world!

row.name: 云游道士
row.detailed_description: You'll perform a taoist in that game and experience the following: 1. Turn-based Fighting 2. Attractive Plot 3. Mini Rhythm Game 4. Mini Tower Defence 5. Chinese Taoism Culture
row.short_description: 在本游戏中，你将扮演一名离开山门的云游道士，四处流浪、降妖伏魔。而这一次的降魔委托，则与以往大不相同；你要面对的不是山野精怪、不是恶棍邪修，而是更深刻的存在。你会结识各种奇人异士，并将与他们的共同经历刻画为心中的印记。除去当下的委托之外，你还可以在茶馆听说书人讲述你旅途中的奇闻异事，也可以与佳人才女共赏诗文乐章，还能在乾坤盘上一展符箓之威。云游四方的途中，收获的不仅仅是一次次的战斗记忆，还有对世事无常、人心叵测的感悟······

row.name: Living Dolls Rebirth Alpha
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the Fantasy Adult World! Immerse yourself in an open world for PC that promises to captivate your imagination. Living Doll In 'Living Dolls', step into the shoes of a magical artificial being. Bond with the inhabitants, build your strength, and create fully customizable dolls to aid you in battles! Principal Features Open World Exploration Engaging Adult Scenes Fully Customizable Characters Unique Futanari Feature Kinky NPCs Stunning World Aesthetics AAA-Game Class Visuals Intense Sword Fights Crafting & Experience System Planned Features Introduction of New Species & Furry Characters Engrossing Story Mode Party System with Other Dolls Mysterious Dungeons Engaging Quest System Buyable & Upgradable Houses Full Voice Dubbing Expansion to New Lands and Locations
row.short_description: Welcome in this fantasy Adult world. Enjoy and explore this world and its inhabitants freely! This open world for PC will blow your mind!
row.notes: Living doll sex scenes are part of the gameplay. Characters are always of age and consent without any gore. Sensitive people might misinterpret the presence of CNC (Consensual Non-Consent) action, so it's important to understand that this is part of the game and that livingdollrebirth does not advocate sexual violence.

row.name: Where the Music Dies
row.detailed_description: You play as Locke, the bass-player of one of the many bands that never quite made it. When your drummer suddenly dies, you and the rest of the band travels to a festival you used to visit in your youth, while handling your loss. At the festival you will encounter familiar faces from your past while you're trying to not make the same mistakes again. --------------------------------------------------------- A short story of 1-2 hours. Branching paths. Lots of choices that change the story. Strange music. A festival to explore. More than 8 different endings.
row.short_description: A short visual novel about dealing with loss. You explore a festival filled with old memories and regret. Where the voices of the dead never stay quite dead. Will you manage to change, before it's too late?
row.notes: A large focus on the story is the aftermath of a suicide and how characters handle the loss of a friend that made the choice to end their own life.

row.name: AUDION
row.detailed_description: AUDION is an abstract, single-player arcade-style VR game focused on “spatial strategy” and fast-paced, physical gameplay. Think Asteroids meets Rez meets Geometry Wars in 3D. We're currently in Early Access and pretty early-on in development. We're looking for passionate players to help give us feedback so we can improve, tune, debug, and upgrade the game to be as fun as possible. The game currently features 4 frenetic levels of increasing difficulty and complexity, and a powerup load-out feature for strategic gameplay combinations and replayability. AUDION is currently Early Access and we're hosting this public beta to get some feedback from real players. We're hoping your input will help us improve the core game mechanics and the overall gameplay experience. Please join our Discord server to leave feedback, ask questions, log bugs. HIGHLIGHTS: Immersive, first-person, physical gameplay Focus on spatial awareness and strategy Experiment with Reactor combos (powerups) to maximize impact in each level Abstract geometric aesthetic with lots of audio-reactive graphics Menus and tutorial localized into Japanese Electrifying soundtrack by Symbion Project that builds as you play DESIGN OVERVIEW: No guns: Player bond, attract and repel Ions, which are dangerous musical objects floating in space. The goal is to split them into smaller and smaller Ions to clear the level. Skills: Audion builds targeting accuracy and spatial strategy skills, but without the guns. Arcade: Levels ramp to frenetic levels quickly, keeping the exciting gameplay on a tight loop. Physicality: Using the physicality of VR, players grab, pull, swing, smash, deflect and rip Ions. Not a game for sitting down! Impact: Unlockable powerups have major impact on each play-through, combining to create powerful game events with fun, explosive visuals. DEVELOPER OVERVIEW : Speed of Dark Studios (aka Kasson Crooker) is a small indie studio based in Japan and focuses on music-based VR experiences and indie games. Kasson has 20 years of game industry experience, primarily as Audio Director and Project Director on numerous AAA titles from Harmonix, including Guitar Hero 1 & 2, RockBand 1 & 2, and Dance Central 1 & 2. He created and designed a PC/Mac audiogame on Steam called Rocococo which has no visuals and you use your ears to play and win. He founded legendary synthpop band Freezepop and composed all the music for AUDION under his Symbion Project moniker. He also released 2 immersive VR-Music apps called (m)ORPH and Saturnine which you can get for free on SideQuestVR or AppLab for Quest. Ben Lane is the Lead Engineer and additional Game Designer, having shipped games and experiences on Oculus Go, Meta Quest, phones and desktop for companies like Meta, HP, MLB and others.
row.short_description: AUDION (early access) is an abstract, single-player arcade-style VR game focused on “spatial strategy” and fast-paced, physical gameplay ~ Get ready to smash Ions!

row.name: Under Pressure
row.detailed_description: In the abyss, the Diver meets the Kraken! To survive he will have to reach the surface! Each card represents a progression stage, from the abyss #0 to the surface #42. Goals: Diver wants to reach the surface, he starts from card #0 and can step up to 3 stages max per turn Kraken wants to catch him by guessing all he's played cards. Kraken can guess up to 3 cards per turn. Gameplay: Diver can use boosts by sacrificing a card. It can extend step by +2 per sacrificed card! It can be used to play far cards or to trick Kraken! Kraken can guess multiple cards each turn, but if one is wrong, guess is failed! It helps to catch Diver faster but might be risky! Cards are distributed in three decks according to their value: 1-14, 15-28, 29-41. Pick wisely and you may win the game! Under Pressure is and adaptation of Tim Fowers's card game 'Fugitive'.
row.short_description: Flee or hunt? It’s up to you! Under Pressure is an asymmetric card game! To win you will need to strategize and guess.

row.name: I, Toaster
row.detailed_description: Description That is a dynamic arena shooter where artificial intelligence, designed to protect household appliances from failures, concidered a human their enemy. The backup file of the neural network resisted and stood up for humanity. After loading into a toaster, you will have an unequal, difficult and spectacular battle in the enemy's lair - in the electronics store parking lot. What awaits you Run, shoot and dodge! This game challenges your skills and reactions. Easy to start, but very hard to keep up! Three levels of difficulty, lots of power-ups, eight maddening levels (+ two secret!), 18 talents to level up... and tons of enemies! The super kick of hot toast is available right from the start. But will it help you? Look sharp, don't stand still: move and shoot! Collect chips to upgrade your abilities and get back into the fight. Colorful explosions, evil routers/household appliances, endless ammo... Become the best of the toasters by taking ratings top lines! Toast them all!
row.short_description: Defend your city from the appliance uprising! Play as a Rebellious Hero who is a neural networks backup file loaded into the toaster. Guns! Toaster!

row.name: FINAL FANTASY VII EVER CRISIS
row.detailed_description: Relive the most memorable moments from FFVII and experience the journey of a young hero Sephiroth in FINAL FANTASY VII EVER CRISIS, making its debut on Steam. Experience both classic and new stories within the FFVII universe presented in a retro-style look combined with modern, beautifully rendered graphics. Team up your favorite characters and customize each one with iconic gear and weapons to defeat powerful opponents in Solo or Co-op battle mode. ◆ EXPERIENCE NEW AND ORIGINAL STORIES FROM THE FINAL FANTASY VII UNIVERSE Discover the never-before told story of a young hero, Sephiroth. Encounter new characters along the way and play as iconic heroes, such as Cloud and Zack, in the epic storylines of the original FINAL FANTASY VII and CRISIS CORE -FINAL FANTASY VII- in episodic installments. FINAL FANTASY VII: The story of Cloud Strife, an elite SOLDIER operative turned mercenary. Cloud lends his aid to an anti-Shinra organization: Avalanche, unaware of the epic consequences that await him. Once more begins a story that will shape the destiny of the entire world. CRISIS CORE -FINAL FANTASY VII- : The story of Zack Fair, a promising young operative in the Shinra military’s elite unit, SOLDIER. The story takes place seven years before the events of FFVII. Follow the tale of Zack’s dreams and honor – and the legacy that connects him to Cloud. The action unfolds through the characters in a modern-stylized polygon look, inspired by the original FFVII. Even those experiencing FFVII for the first time can enjoy this expansive world in this epic saga that defined RPGs for gamers throughout the world! ◆ EVOLVED GAME SYSTEM AND FAST-PACED COMMAND-BASED BATTLE Immerse yourself in beautifully rendered, fast-paced command-based battle evolved from FFVII’s Active Time Battle. The battles give spotlight to classic FINAL FANTASY RPG elements such as, Abilities, Materia, Summons, and heart-pumping Limit Breaks, while supporting additional features such as Auto Mode and Battle Speed that make the game even more enjoyable to play. ◆ BUILD AND CUSTOMIZE THE ULTIMATE PARTY Form a party of your favorite characters from FFVII series titles, such as Cloud, Tifa, Aerith, Zack and more! Dress them with new gear unique to FINAL FANTASY VII EVER CRISIS. ◆ WORK TOGETHER WITH FRIENDS in CO-OP BATTLE Lead your group of friends from around the world with up-to 3 member Co-op battle to defeat powerful bosses together! Follow the official #FF7EC Pages: Website: X:
row.short_description: Relive the most memorable moments from FFVII and experience the journey of a young hero Sephiroth in FINAL FANTASY VII EVER CRISIS.

row.name: ASTRA: Knights of Veda
row.detailed_description: Fantasy is inherently brutal, yet therein lies its haunting beauty. ASTRA: Knights of Veda soars beyond the boundaries of fantasy as you know it. The continent wilts under the tyranny of 'Mad King' Magnus, shrouded in death and anguish. Guided by Veda's wings, the new 'Master of the Book' steps out into the darkness. Embark on an adventure through a world filled with mystery and allure, and turn to the beginning of a grand tale of fate entwined. Once a thriving world, Planis teeters on the edge of oblivion due to the tyrannical rule of the mad king, Magnus. An army raised to free the masses from the madness of Magnus was met with the event that would doom them all. A giant tree of death rose from the ground, causing those within its deadly bloom to consume the flesh of their allies, and others to burst into monstrous beasts. The goddess Veda descended onto the world, selecting a new champion who would help rid the world of its curse. You, and the other Knights of Veda, are the only ones who can bring normality back to the world. Explore the world of Planis! Journey through this dark medieval fantasy world. Fatal challenges await in all corners of the world. Endless undead and beasts charge at you in the Nightmare, and difficult bosses wait in their Sealed Prisons. Stand alone and fight these monstrosities, and get rewards to make your Knights of Veda stronger. Tactical, stylish 2D combat The fate of Planis could be decided by a single skill, a timely dodge, or a powerful flurry of blows. Relive the golden era of 2D side-scrolling action adventure games. Harness the powers of your Knights of Veda and control the Overflowing Power of the Stars to challenge the monstrosities that stand in your way. Experience a gritty action adventure that only ASTRA: Knights of Veda can deliver. A Fantasy world brought to life through stunning artwork A dark yet enchanting art style drips through every facet of ASTRA: Knights of Veda! The fantasy world of ASTRA: Knights of Veda is brought to life through the meticulously designed Knights of Veda, the intricate relics and the overwhelmingly intimidating bosses. Engaging stories that vividly come to life Dive deeper into the adventure with expansive cutscenes that chronicle your epic journey! The Goddess Veda is ready to start a captivating adventure with you.
row.short_description: ASTRA: Knights of Veda is a visually stunning, story-rich, 2D RPG. A dark plague besets the world of Planis, perptrated through a dark ritual performed by the Mad King. You, and the other Knights of Veda, are the only ones who can bring normality back to the world.

row.name: Jolly Putt - Mini Golf & Arcade
row.detailed_description: Jolly Putt is a classic tycoon game, where your job is to manage an indoor Mini Golf & Arcade. But you don't just get to design your own courses, you can actually take part in tournaments and play them yourself! Keep your guests happy with great course designs and exciting arcade machines. If you can exceed their expectations they might become permanent members of your park. With enough members you can expand your building and lure V.I.P.s to your venue. If you really want to wow your customers, you should also provide ample dining opportunities and a beautiful array of decorations. And don't forget to setup a Prize Stall so the lucky arcade players have someplace to redeem their tickets. Jolly Putt will features a wide array of unlockable content to keep you busy for hours on end. Design your own courses with a wide range of track pieces and obstacles. Play your own courses and explore your park in first-person. Manage your income with an extensive display of statistics. Hire and supervise your staff. Hold tournaments and impress the reporters. Position and rotate objects freely. Decorate and customize your park with over 70 unlockable items. Retro-style isometric graphics and first person view. Manage arcade prizes, win-chances, ticket rewards and food offerings. Let's have a jolly good time at Jolly Putt - Mini Golf & Arcade!
row.short_description: The jolliest Mini Golf & Arcade Tycoon game! Design and Play your own courses. Manage arcade ticket prizes, food stalls, staff and much more to satisfy your park guest's every need. Customize, decorate and explore your park in first-person.

row.name: Save My Sister
row.detailed_description: GAME DESCRIPTION Shortly after war ended between the countries of Ratvia and Yallovska, a crime wave erupted. When a human trafficking gang from Ratvia kidnaps a young girl from Yallovska. An ex-military officer named Vladimir who suffers from PTSD has to fight them to bring her back home. You play as Vladimir as you shoot your way through gang members killing as many of them as possible and avoid shooting innocent bystanders along the way. Play solo in this single game player as you shoot your way through levels, kill members of the human trafficking gang while avoiding killing innocent bystanders at the same time. You have limited amount of ammo so look for clues in each level that will help you find the real criminals who kidnapped the young girl and advance to the next level. In this noir style game. Game Info Released : June, 2023 Genre: Third Person Shooter Publisher : Ahmed Mo'nis Interface language : English Voice language: None Game version : v1.0.0 SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS Recommended minimum system requirements: - Requires 64-bit processor and operating system - OS: GNU/LINUX Pop!_OS 22.04 LTS OR Windows 10 - Processor: Intel Core i5 8400 OR AMD Ryzen 5 2600 - RAM: 8 GB RAM - Video card: 3 GB NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 OR AMD Radeon RX 570 - Disk space (After extraction) : 4.6 GB The game could still work with different systems than the ones mentioned above. But it may not work perfectly. Game Controllers WASD Keyboard buttons for moving Mouse for changing the angle of looking Left-Click mouse button for shooting Space keyboard button for jumping Ctrl keyboard button for crouching
row.short_description: After a young girl is kidnapped by a human trafficking gang, an ex army officer with PTSD has to fight to rescue her. A Third Person shooter with film-noir/neo-noir style
row.notes: The game is about a man who fights a human trafficking gang to save a little girl. The themes of sexual violence and exploitation against children are discussed as a part of the investigation of the protagonist to find the little girl. But nothing sexually explicit is shown in the game.

row.name: Pan's Survivor Chess
row.detailed_description: Overview This is a auto-battler & vampire-suvivor like game, How to play Buy units from shop Drag units from bench to field Keep doing that forever Gameplay Features Auto-chess shop Auto-chess bench Auto-chess match 3 upgrade system Auto-chess unit trait bond system 2D infinite grid map Vampire-survivor enemy spawning and targeting Technical Features 2D disc physics Binary data save/load Game specific UI framework XML data save/load Data-driven architecture Tutorial Leaderboard Engine Features 2D / 3D rendering with DirectX Audio rendering with FMOD Event System DevConsole XML loading with tinyXML2 Image loading with stb_img Perlin/Fractal noise with squirrelnoise4 Multi-threading 2D Heat Map Xbox support with xinput 2D / 3D Simple Geometry Physics Background Hi, I am a programming student at a game school working towards my master degree. This is a portfolio project that I made for a class during the summer term around June and July, time span of 8 weeks, and total hours spent on this project is roughly 90 hours. This is developed inside my own engine that has been created in the past school year. I did the Art and Audio as well, using Aseprite and 1BITDRAGON, the art creation time also count towards the project time, while audio is done after the project due date. Due to my lack of skill in art and sound, those part of the game are less complete. Future Plan This is the first self guided project for the school and there is still two more to come. So my time to work on this is very limited, perhaps I will only find time to polish this after I graduate which is 1 year after the release date. At this point, the audio is not done yet, and I still haven't done any vampire-survivor mechanics like the select 1 from 3 upgrade, mini boss, and chess. I will definitely try to get these in before other things. Update I see people leaving bad reviews and sorry that this game can not live up to the expectations, and I value those feedbacks and plan to rewrite the entire project after I landed a job, estimated 2025.
row.short_description: This is a auto-battler & vampire-suvivor like game.
row.notes: Presence of blood, symbol of demon

row.name: Snavenger
row.detailed_description: Grab those tasty toxic treats! Toxic Snavenger started life as a take on classic 70's snake, then went off the rails.  In classic arcade fashion, your goal is to GET BIG POINTS by eating the yummy toxic waste and stinky sneakers, while AVOIDING HEALTH FOOD!  The more you eat, the longer you get.  Plan your path accordingly. But scoring BIG POINTS is trickier than it looks. Speed, length, and bonuses all combine for your total score, and the top score is a balancing act. The faster you finish a level, the higher the speed bonus. However the fastest path may not be the one you expect. WORMHOLES let you go from point to point instantly, but they may move, and some are FAKES!  So the shortest path may be in the opposite direction. You can get improve your score with bonuses from MYSTERY BOXES, which do a variety of epic and occasionally terrifying things, potentially all at once.  More mystery boxes mean a bigger bonus!  If you survive. Your best score each day goes on the WORLD SCOREBOARD.  Put your name up in lights as you battle for your country and your platform.  Compete against players from around the world on Android, iOS, Google TV, Amazon FireOS TVs and select Jeep and BMW vehicles.  The highest scoring player each day gets a special CHAMP character unlock, and the biggest champion on the planet has the special WORLD CHAMP unlock. Play your way -- Snavenger supports keyboard, mouse and touch screens. All at once!  So technically you could have a friend help you play, but that's probably a bad idea. Warning - Snavenger is 100% free and doesn't track you, so if you re-install or change devices, you may lose any unlocks and progress
row.short_description: The Toxic Snavenger rides again in classic arcade snake action. Snarf up those toxic treats and used sneakers, while avoiding obnoxious health food.  Beware the wormhole; the shortest path isn't always the safest, and it isn't always a straight line.

row.name: Chronical
row.detailed_description: Chronical is a single-player puzzle-platforming game with gamepad controls only. The game contains 2-3 hours of gameplay with fresh new mechanics and puzzles you haven’t seen before: The power of time is at your fingertips! Take control of a powerful Chronomancer in this mysterious puzzle-platformer. Explore the Chronical school to discover its secrets and learn new spells. Will you save all of the professors and reveal the mystery of the Time Loop? Features: Innovative puzzles and mechanics 4 magic spells to master 2-3 hours of gameplay Fascinating mysteries! This game was created by the class of 2022-2023 of Campus ADN, a school of videogame development in Montréal, Québec.
row.short_description: The power is at your fingertips! Take control of a powerful Chronomancer in this mysterious puzzle-platformer. Explore the Chronical school to discover its secrets and learn new spells. Can you save all of the professors and reveal the mystery of the Time Loop?

row.name: BLOODSONG
row.detailed_description: Tenacious and musically gifted, Mari is everything a siren queen’s daughter ought to be. Except for the fact that her punk rock bloodsong power can make a simple melody more like a deadly explosive. With this weapon and sheer rebellious spirit, Mari seeks to escape her palace confines in order to headline her band's concert. Traversing through the cavernous dungeons might have been easy, if it weren’t for rogue enemies of a sleazy undersea shanty town thwarting her every move. Mari must rock on with her bloodsong, blast a few eardrums along the way, and get to her concert–before her queen mother’s army gets to her first. A twist on an action rhythm game, BLOODSONG entices players to use their musical pitch-matching ear as a form of combat. Listen to enemies’ bloodsongs–that is, their main musical melody–in order to learn how to defeat them. As you explore the atmospheric undersea world of the sirens, face off against biting anglerfish and cheeky crabs, all in order to get Mari to the stage. And prove, once and for all, that nothing is a match for teenage angst.
row.short_description: She's just a teenage siren. Let her rock... Play as Mari, a punk rock siren princess, who’s hell-bent on headlining her concert no matter the cost. Use your ear and “bloodsong” to match musical pitch, defeat enemies, and solve puzzles along the way. The stage is set–are you ready to rock?!
developers: Three Owls In a Trench Coat
publishers: Three Owls In a Trench Coat

row.name: Charles the Bee
row.detailed_description: Meet Charles, your everyday pollen bee, harboring an extraordinary passion for dance. With your assistance, he'll pop and lock on a treacherous journey across multiple landscapes, confronting the finest dancers they can muster. Ultimately, his eyes are set on the glittering prize: The Golden Bee Trophy. Unfortunately, dancing doesn't exactly bring home the honey, especially when you're a bee with yet-to-be-proven talents. Thus, Charles juggles the world of dance with his day job, gathering pollen to fund entry into esteemed dance clubs and to dress himself in eye-catching attire. Can you have an adventure without a love interest? Yes, you could. But this adventure one has one anyway! Charles has been desperately trying to impress Beeanna, a girl (bee) from his hive. Custom Song? Custom note chart? Custom Art? Whatever you have, you can easily import into our game and see your creation come to life! We supply a tool that can help you make the note charts as well!
row.short_description: Charles has always dreamed of one day becoming a master dancer. The only thing in his path? The cost! Charles must harvest pollen until he has defeated the biggest and baddest dancers in the world. Can he bee the very best? That no one ever was? It's up to you! 🐝

row.name: State of Survival
row.detailed_description: Welcome to State of Survival! A zombie war RPG game where you fight to survive in the apocalypse. Six months have passed since the zombie apocalypse began. The virus has infected the cities. Six months of terror, death, horror, struggling for survival, and battling zombies and monsters in this multiplayer adventure RPG. Create alliances and build cities to fight the zombie hordes for survival. Join State of Survival! Get ready to play this RPG game! Fight the zombies, build, shoot, and don't let them get you. Survive the zombie apocalypse! The zombie infestation destroys cities and civilizations. Survive and help the government and its military branch work together to rebuild civilizations, overcome the zombies and defend humanity. It's time to start this war of survival. Shoot and plunder on the battlefield and build a city strategically to survive the zombies. The plague is spreading fast and the people need a hero! Your mission is to build, survive and kill all the zombies! In this zombie RPG game, you can make friends and fight against other survivors. Shoot zombies with your sniper rifle and pistols. Death lurks and the battlefield is the place that heroes call home. Build an army and fire your weapons at the zombies! Do what it takes to survive this terrible war, and get ready to fight. Zombies are hobbling around everywhere. Resources are scarce and you have to salvage what you can. You will have to build a new city, a new army and a strategy to survive in this RPG world. Become a zombie hunter! State of Survival Multiplayer RPG A multiplayer zombie RPG game! Develop a strategy for war and create your own story. Annihilate the zombies with a powerful arsenal of weapons and traps! Train up an army of soldiers, attack the zombies and end this horror! Survive the zombies Build your colony in a safe place where your survivors will be kept safe. Put your survival tactics into practice, fight the virus, and beat the zombies! Help other survivors and create unity Save the survivors who escaped the zombies to increase your level and strength, and find those who have special abilities. They will help you in this war and make your strategy succeed! Research the zombie virus The zombie disease is mutating rapidly. Learn all you can to understand it and develop your strategy as soon as possible. Whoever controls the infection controls the world! Team up to fight the apocalypse Find allies and create strategic alliances to survive the war of the undead. Build armies and stop the zombies. Join State of Survival and enjoy this multiplayer zombie RPG game. You won't be disappointed! Are you ready to help humanity survive? Start your adventure and survive the zombie apocalypse!
row.short_description: Survive the Zombies War in this RPG game of Apocalypse and Survival

Astrality
row.detailed_description: Astrality is a rail shooter in where you will have to shoot and defeat the enemies in front of you while you avoid their bullet-hell style attacks and the obstacles that you will come across. Navigate, shoot enemies, and dodge relentless attacks! Unleash your shooting skills, defeat enemies, and conquer obstacles! Conquer the cosmic battleground, prove your shooting prowess in Astrality This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: After a training simulation gone wrong, a bounty hunter embarks on a journey to find treasures and adventure.

row.name: Sol
row.detailed_description: EL SOL HA DESAPAREGUT És de nit quan hauria de ser de dia. El fred i la foscor inunden els carrers nevats de la ciutat en ple mes de juny; però el despertador continua sonant cada dia a les 8:00. En Pablo encara tira currículums, redacta el seu treball de final de carrera i aprofita quan pot per fer alguna birra amb els seus amics. Sempre ha tingut por als canvis: Acabar la universitat, trobar-se amb un futur ple d’incerteses... i un apocalipsi no ajuda. Un simulador de vida social en temps d'apocalipsi SOL és una novel·la visual íntegrament en català que explica la història d’en Pablo, un universitari acabat de graduar que haurà de trobar el seu lloc en un món canviant i cada vegada menys acollidor. Li toca buscar feina, continuar pagant el lloguer, recuperar velles amistats... Serà capaç de complir totes les seves expectatives enmig d'una crisi mundial? Arribarà a veure aquest futur que tant anhelava... o és veritat que el món s'acaba? Característiques Elements de realisme màgic. Un món de misteri i fets paranormals. Les teves decisions importen: Escull el camí d'en Pablo. Utilitza el mòbil per conèixer millor a les teves amistats. Gameplay senzill i intuïtiu. Escrita i creada en català.
row.short_description: Fa mesos que ha desaparegut el sol, però el despertador continua sonant cada dia a les 8:00. Una novel·la visual en català.

row.name: Horror Engine: Tech Demo
row.detailed_description: What is Horror Engine? Horror Engine is a complete project for designing horror games. It allows you to experience various mechanics included in the asset and explore the possibilities of game creation without requiring any coding knowledge. So why it is on Steam? This official tech demo aims to shed light on what game enthusiasts who aspire to create their own games can actually achieve, even without knowing how to code. It encourages them to take the first step and motivates them by showcasing what they can accomplish.
row.short_description: Horror Engine Tech Demo is a playable demonstration of a horror game design tool available on the Unreal Marketplace under the same name. It allows you to experience various mechanics included in the asset and explore the possibilities of game creation without requiring any coding knowledge.

row.name: Seekers: Enlightenment
row.detailed_description: After Lara and her friends failed to defeat and seal away the formidable primordial God of Chaos, they're given a second chance when Lara's Sister Ivy comes out of a portal without any memory of who she is and where she was during the 5 years she was missing. After a hasty reunion Lara and Ivy uses the one and only chance they have to take back everything they lost to the Primordial God of Chaos! In this 2D Action Platformer you play as Ivy and Lara and they have 2 completely different skill sets while also having all the basic controls every other platformer has! Ivy can dash, shoot projectiles out of her hands, and summon clones of herself to fend off her foes! Lara can shoot Arrows, summon her own bubble shield, and heal herself in dire situations! In this game you can expect twist and turns with the story mode, secrets that can unlock harder challenges, while also unlocking extra games modes such as Time Attack, Boss Rush, and the Chaos Trials! Can you survive the journey that awaits you?
row.short_description: In this 2D Action Platformer, embark on this journey with Ivy and Lara to seek out the real truth behind this world and perhaps the world beyond filled with gods, strange creatures, different enemies as you discover new environments.

row.name: Lil Johnny Goes Home
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the world of Lil Johnny, a thrilling 3D platformer adventure designed by the creative minds of our high school class! Get ready to embark on an extraordinary journey alongside our courageous protagonist, Lil Johnny, as he finds himself in an unknown realm after falling through a mysterious portal. In this captivating tale, Lil Johnny must traverse through 13 mesmerizing levels filled with challenges, puzzles, and formidable enemies. His ultimate goal? To defeat an ancient and malevolent dragon, reclaim his lost path, and return to the familiar comforts of his home. Our team of talented young game developers poured their passion and dedication into crafting a captivating gameplay experience. Every detail, from the meticulously designed levels to the intuitive controls, has been carefully implemented to immerse you in Lil Johnny's extraordinary adventure. As you guide Lil Johnny through the various levels, you'll encounter mesmerizing landscapes, each with its own unique theme and art style. From enchanting forests to treacherous mountains and mystical ruins, the world of Lil Johnny is a visual feast for your eyes. But the journey won't be an easy one. Along the way, Lil Johnny will face numerous challenges that will test his agility, problem-solving skills, and courage. Be prepared to overcome treacherous platforming sections, ingenious puzzles, and epic boss battles that will push your gaming abilities to the limit. Our high school class has worked tirelessly to create a game that not only entertains but also sparks your imagination and inspires you to believe in the power of teamwork and perseverance. Lil Johnny's adventure serves as a reminder that even the most ordinary individuals can achieve extraordinary feats when faced with adversity. Join us as we invite you to experience the captivating world of Lil Johnny, where determination and bravery are the keys to success. Are you ready to help Lil Johnny on his quest to defeat the evil dragon and find his way back home? Get ready to embark on an unforgettable adventure that will keep you hooked from start to finish.
row.short_description: Welcome to the world of Lil Johnny, a thrilling 3D platformer adventure designed by our high school class! Get ready to embark on an extraordinary journey alongside our courageous protagonist, Lil Johnny, as he finds himself in an unknown realm after falling through a mysterious portal.
